recipes.name: 15-Minute Butter Chicken Curry in a Hurry
recipes.description: A rich and creamy butter chicken curry made with tender chicken, aromatic spices, and served with fresh garlic naan, perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Heat oil in frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry.
Cook chicken for about 6 mins, tossing occasionally, until browned.
Add butter curry paste, measure of spices, coconut milk, peas, sugar and canned tomatoes to the pan.
Bring to the boil.
Simmer for about 4 mins, until sauce is slightly reduced.
Stir through spinach, until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
While curry cooks, microwave naan for 1-2 mins, until hot.
Bowl up chicken curry.
Serve naan on the side.
Keen for some heat?
Add some chilli flakes.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Asian Saucy Pork Noodles with Cashew Crunch Salad
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender pork noodles in a rich, savory Asian-inspired sauce, paired with a refreshing cashew crunch salad for a delightful contrast in textures and flavors.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Thinly slice bok choy.
Grate carrot.
Toss all salad ingredients in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt.
Use hands to separate noodles.
Place noodles in pot of boiling water, stir to separate strands and cook for 5 mins, until just tender.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook pork, stirring, for 6-8 mins until browned.
Add cornflour, soy sauce and water measure and cook for 1 min, until coated.
Drain noodles, refresh under cold water, drain again and add to pan.
Add char siu sauce and chilli flakes (if using) to noodles.
Toss and fry for 1 min, until coated.
Season to taste with soy sauce.
Plate up pork noodles.
Don't forget the salad!

recipes.name: 20-Minute BBQ Chicken Pitas
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender chicken pitas topped with a creamy corn slaw and a tangy BBQ sauce, perfect for a satisfying lunch or light dinner.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Drain corn and cook for about 6 mins, until charred.
Toss in a bowl with remaining slaw ingredients.
Save pan.
Season slaw to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Return saved pan to heat with oil.
Pat chicken dry and add to pan with measure of spices and a pinch of salt.
Cook for 6-8 mins, tossing occasionally, until cooked through.
Add BBQ sauce to pan and cook for 1 min, until coated and sticky.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Cut pitas in half and heat in microwave for 2-3 mins, until warmed through.
Alternatively, toast pitas in the toaster.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill pitas with chicken, slaw and yoghurt.
Alternatively, serve in a bowl with pita for dipping.
Grab a pita and enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Beef Cheeseburger Pasta Bowls
recipes.description: A quick and comforting pasta dish featuring tender beef, Colby cheese, and penne pasta, topped with a creamy cheese sauce and served with a fresh side salad.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Add boiling water into a pot with a pinch of salt.
Bring back to a rapid boil with a lid on.
Add pasta to pot and cook for 8-10 mins, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Grate carrot and add to pan along with beef, measure of spices and salt measure.
Cook for about 6 mins, breaking up beef, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, grate cheese.
Add passata and cook for another 2-3 mins, until thickened.
Top with cheese, cover with a lid and cook for 1 more min, until melted.
Alternatively, if you don't have a lid, cover with foil and cook for 1 min.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Dice tomato.
Divide pasta, cheesy beef and veggies between bowls.
Drizzle over burger sauce.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Beef Gnocchi Bolognese with Parmesan
recipes.description: A quick and comforting dish featuring tender gnocchi tossed in a rich beef Bolognese sauce, topped with grated Parmesan cheese for a savory and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Dice onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat butter and oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion and carrot for about 3 mins, until softened.
Add garlic and tomato pastes and salt measure and cook for 2 more mins, until fragrant.
Add beef, measure of spices and measure of chilli blend (if using) and continue to cook for about 5 mins, until browned.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Add sugar, tomato passata, stock and fish sauce (if using) to pan and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 4-5 mins, until slightly reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, add gnocchi to pot and cook for 3-4 mins, until gnocchi start floating.
Drain and return to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Stir gnocchi and spinach through beef, until gnocchi is coated and spinach wilted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon gnocchi into bowls and top with Parmesan.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Beef Spag Bol with Parmesan
recipes.description: A quick and comforting pasta dish featuring tender beef, rich tomato sauce, and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese, perfect for a satisfying meal in under 20 minutes.

instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook pasta for 8-10 mins, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Grate carrot.
Dice onion.
Add both to pan along with measure of spices and tomato paste and cook for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add beef and cook for 5 mins to brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add canned tomatoes, stock, sugar and salt measure to pan and bring to a simmer.
Cook for a further 4-5 mins, until sauce is thickened.
Remove pan from heat.
Stir through spinach and cooked pasta, until warmed through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pan not big enough?
Add Bolognese to pot with pasta instead.
Plate up pasta and sprinkle over Parmesan.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Blackened Chicken Burgers
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful blackened chicken burgers topped with a zesty smoked paprika aioli, perfect for a satisfying and easy meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Mix sweet chilli sauce and vinegar in a bowl.
Add all slaw ingredients and toss to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Set aside for later.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Toss in a bowl with measure of spices and flour.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut burger buns in half horizontally and place on an oven tray.
Grill in oven for 2-3 mins, until warm through.
Take care not to burn!
Alternatively, place buns on a heatproof plate and microwave for about 1 min, until warmed through.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill buns with slaw, chicken and smoked paprika aioli.
Leftover slaw?
Serve it on the side!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Char Siu-Glazed Chicken Pitas with Cashews
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender chicken glazed with a savory Char Siu sauce, paired with fresh vegetables, creamy feta, and crunchy cashews, all served in warm pita bread.

ingredients.name: telegraph cucumber
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry and add to pan.
Cook chicken with a pinch of salt for 5-6 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden.
Pour over first measure of char siu sauce and turn chicken to coat.
Add first measure of cashews.
Cook for a further 2 mins, until sticky.
Meanwhile, cut cucumber in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Grate carrot.
Thinly slice bok choy.
Toss in a bowl with vinegar and chilli flakes (if using).
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, mix remaining char siu sauce and mayonnaise together.
Cut pitas in half.
Heat pitas in microwave for 1-2 mins, until warmed through.
Alternatively, toast pitas in the toaster.
Stuff pitas with veggies, chicken, mayo and remaining cashews.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Cheesy Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Quick and easy cheesy beef tacos made with ground beef, cheese, fresh vegetables, and a zesty dill sour cream topping, perfect for a fast and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Grate carrot.
Add carrot to pan with beef, salt measure, measure of BBQ spices and first measure of tomato sauce.
Cook for about 7 mins until browned, breaking up the beef as it cooks.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, mix together sour cream, second measure of tomato sauce and measure of ranch spices in a bowl.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Dice tomato and grate cheese if required.
Place stack of tortillas on a plate and microwave for about 1 min to warm.
Have a gas stovetop and looking for extra charred flavour?
Heat tortillas directly over the gas hob flame for about 5 secs each side.
Load up your tacos with beef, lettuce and tomato.
Top it all off with cheese and sauce.
Chow down!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Chicken & Rice Noodle Salad with Peanut Dressing
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful salad featuring crispy chicken, rice noodles, fresh vegetables, and a rich peanut dressing, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Mix all peanut dressing ingredients in a saucepan.
Place on medium heat and bring to a simmer.
As soon as it simmers, remove from heat.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Add noodles to pot of boiling water, stir, cover and turn off heat.
Leave for 8-10 mins, until tender.
Drain, rinse with lukewarm water and drain again.
Cut in a few places to make them easier to eat.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Toss chicken in a bowl with second measure of curry paste, honey and soy sauce.
Like it a bit spicier?
Add an extra teaspoon of curry paste.
Add chicken to frypan and cook for 6-8 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Cut cucumber in half and thinly slice on an angle.
Toss in a bowl with cooked noodles, slaw, vinegar, sweet chilli sauce and fish sauce.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top noodle salad with chicken.
Drizzle over peanut dressing.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Chimichurri Chicken Salad with Corn Chips & Sour Cream
recipes.description: A vibrant and fresh salad featuring grilled chicken tossed in a zesty chimichurri sauce, mixed with crisp lettuce, creamy avocado, and colorful bell peppers, served with crunchy corn chips and a dollop of sour cream.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry and add to pan with measure of spices and soy sauce.
Cook for 6-8 mins, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Chop It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, roughly chop lettuce.
Dice tomato and avocado.
Toss in a bowl with vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.
Season to taste with salt.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up salad and top with chicken, sour cream and chilli flakes (if using).
Serve corn chips on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Creamy Basil & Bacon Spaghetti with Parmesan
recipes.description: A quick and creamy pasta dish featuring spaghetti tossed in a rich basil sauce, crispy bacon, and topped with grated Parmesan cheese. Perfect for a simple yet satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.

Drain and return to pot with oil to prevent sticking.
Thinly slice bacon.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook bacon and carrot for about 7 mins, until browned.
Add measure of spices and peas and cook for a further 2 mins.
Remove from heat.
Add basil drizzle, sour cream and spinach.
Stir well to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Add pasta and saved pasta water to pan (S2: 1/4 cup, S4: 1/4 cup, S6: 1/2 cup).
Toss to coat pasta in sauce.
Pan not large enough for the pasta?
You can add the sauce and the drained pasta back into the pot to combine the yummy goodness!
Plate up basil and bacon pasta.
Sprinkle over Parmesan.
Delish!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Creamy Chicken Gnocchi
recipes.description: A quick and comforting dish featuring tender chicken gnocchi in a rich, creamy sauce with fresh basil drizzle, peas, and spinach, perfect for a satisfying meal in under 20 minutes.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.

Drain and return to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Grate carrot and pat chicken dry.
Add carrot, chicken, measure of spices, flour and salt measure to pan and cook for 6-8 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden and almost cooked through.

Once chicken has cooked for 6-8 mins, add garlic to pan and cook for 1 more min, until fragrant.
Add peas and stock to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for a further 3-4 mins, until peas are bright green and tender and chicken is cooked through.
Remove pan from heat.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Add chicken and sauce to pot with drained gnocchi.
Stir through basil drizzle, sour cream and spinach, until spinach is wilted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon gnocchi into bowls.
Delish!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Creamy Garlic Chicken
recipes.description: A rich and comforting creamy garlic chicken dish, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. Served with cheesy ciabatta toast, it's a delightful blend of savory and cheesy flavors.

Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Pat chicken dry and add to pan with measure of spices.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook for about 5 mins, turning occasionally, until almost cooked through.
While chicken cooks, slice mushrooms.
Add mushrooms and stock to pan.
Cook for a further 5 mins, until cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir through spinach and sour cream.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, cut bread in half horizontally.
Drizzle oil onto cut sides of bread.
Place on an oven tray and sprinkle over Parmesan.
Grill in oven for 2-3 mins, until golden.
Take care not to burn!
Slice bread before serving.
Plate up creamy chicken.
Don't forget the cheesy toast!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Herby Chicken & Orzo Salad with Feta
recipes.description: A fresh and flavorful salad featuring tender orzo pasta, juicy chicken, and a medley of herbs, all tossed with a zesty dressing and topped with crumbled feta cheese.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook orzo in pot of boiling water for about 10 mins (until tender).
Add peas for final 3 mins of orzo cook time.
Drain and return to pot with oil.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Grate carrot and mince garlic.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high and pat chicken dry.
Add chicken, carrot and garlic to pan with a pinch of salt and pepper and cook for 6-8 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Once chicken is cooked, crumble in feta, and toss through spinach, basil drizzle, salt measure, cooked orzo and peas into pan with chicken.
If needed, use a large bowl to toss together if pan is not big enough.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Divide chicken and orzo salad between bowls and dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Honey Chipotle Chicken Rolls
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful chicken rolls seasoned with honey and chipotle, served with a fresh salad and a zesty dipping sauce. Perfect for a fast and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Toss with measure of spices.
Cook chicken for 6-8 mins (S6: 8-10 mins), tossing occasionally, until golden and cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix first measure of chipotle sauce and honey in a bowl.
When chicken has cooked, remove pan from heat.
Add chipotle mixture to pan and stir to combine.
Set aside to serve.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Drain corn.
Toss in a bowl with roasted capsicum, slaw and vinegar.
Season to taste with salt.

instructions.heading: Warm It
instructions.text: Microwave rolls on a heatproof plate for 1 min, until warm.
Slice rolls lengthways down the middle, leaving a hinge.
Mix mayo and remaining chipotle sauce in a bowl.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill rolls with veggies, chicken and chipotle mayo.
Serve leftover salad on the side.
Enjoy!

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Grate carrot and cut broccoli into small florets.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a large frypan on high.
Cook carrot, broccoli, chicken and curry paste for 6-8 mins (S6: 9-12 mins), tossing occasionally, until browned and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Separate noodles.
Put noodles in pot of boiling water.
Cook for 5 mins, stirring often, until just tender.
Save measure of pasta water.
Drain and rinse noodles with cold water.
Toss noodles together with oil so they don't stick.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Add kecap manis, soy sauce and tomato sauce to pan with chicken and mix well.
Add noodles and mung bean sprouts to pan and stir together.
Want it saucier?
Add a splash of the reserved noodle water.
Season to taste with soy sauce.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill up a bowl with chicken noodles.
Grab chopsticks or a fork and dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Korean Sticky Bacon Noodles with Sesame & Bok Choy
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful noodle dish inspired by Korean cuisine, featuring crispy bacon, tender bok choy, and a savory sesame sauce that coats the noodles perfectly.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Separate noodles.
Add noodles to pot of boiling water.
Cook for 5 mins, stirring often, until just tender.
Save measure of noodle water (S2: 1/4 cup; S4: 1/3 cup; S6: 1/2 cup).
Drain and rinse noodles with cold water.
Toss noodles together with oil so they don't stick.
Thinly slice bacon.
Slice bok choy 2cm.
Slice onion 1cm.
Thinly slice spring onion and set aside to serve.
Heat sesame oil in a frypan on high.
Cook bacon, onion, sesame seeds and peas for 4-5 mins, tossing occasionally, until bacon is cooked through and onion is tender.
Add gochujang miso paste, brown sugar, soy sauce and chilli flakes (if using).
Cook for 1-2 mins, until sugar has dissolved.
Add bok choy, cooked noodles and measure of reserved noodle water and cook for 1-2 mins, until hot.
Season to taste with soy sauce and toss to combine.
Plate noodles, sprinkle with spring onion and drizzle with Korean sticky sauce.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Korean-Style Beef Noodles with Broccoli & Sticky Chilli Sauce
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful noodle dish inspired by Korean cuisine, featuring tender beef, vibrant vegetables, and a rich, spicy chili sauce that adds a kick to every bite.

instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Bring a kettle to the boil.
Heat oil in a frypan (or wok) on high heat and thinly slice mushrooms.
Cook mushroom and mince with a pinch of salt for about 6 mins, breaking up with a wooden spoon until browned.
Use hands to separate noodles.
Place noodles in pot of boiling water, stir to separate strands and cook for 5 mins, until just tender.
Reserve 1/2 cup of noodle water.
Drain noodles, refresh under cold water and leave to drain again.
Toss with oil to prevent sticking.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Place in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Cover with a plate and leave for 5 mins, until bright green and tender.
Peel carrot into ribbons.
Drain broccoli and toss with carrot and sesame dressing.
Add Korean sticky chilli sauce and noodles to pan with beef mince.
Toss to combine.
Season to taste with soy sauce.
Top beef noodles with a sprinkle of Korean chilli flakes (if using) and broccoli on the side.

instructions.heading: Chop It
instructions.text: Roughly chop lettuce.
Thinly slice capsicum.
Cut tomato into wedges.
Add all to a serving bowl.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Toss with measure of spices.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Slice chicken before serving.

instructions.heading: Toast It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a second frypan on medium-high.
Dice bread and cook with a pinch of salt for 2 mins, turning often, until all sides are browned.

instructions.heading: Eat It

Drizzle over dressing and sprinkle over Parmesan.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Peanut Satay Chicken Pitas with Crunch Slaw
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender chicken marinated in a rich peanut satay sauce, served in warm pita bread with a refreshing crunch slaw. Perfect for a satisfying and easy-to-make dinner.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Pat chicken dry and add to pan.
Cook chicken with a pinch of salt for 6-8 mins, until golden.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: While chicken cooks, combine peanut butter, curry paste, soy and coconut milk in a small bowl.
For a milder satay use half the amount specified, and for spicier, add an extra teaspoon.
When chicken cook time has finished, drop heat to medium.
Add sauce to pan and cook for 2-3 mins, until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Season to taste with soy sauce.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Peel carrot into ribbons.
Toss in a bowl with slaw, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Warm It
instructions.text: Cut pitas in half.
Heat in microwave for 1-2 mins, until warmed through.
Alternatively, toast pitas in the toaster.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Stuff pitas with slaw and chicken satay.
Looking for more spice?
Sprinkle over a pinch of chilli flakes.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Pulled Beef Nachos with Corn Chips & Sour Cream
recipes.description: A quick and satisfying meal featuring tender pulled beef, corn chips, and a variety of fresh toppings like lettuce, tomatoes, and sour cream, perfect for a casual dinner or snack.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Drain and rinse beans.
Drain corn.
Add corn, beef, measure of spices, beans and stock to the pan.
Don't want the full amount of spice?
Add less to suit your preferred heat level.
Bring to a simmer.
Drop heat to medium and simmer, stirring to break up beef as it heats, for about 3 mins, until thickened.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Sprinkle cheese over beef.
Place a lid on the pan and cook 2 mins more, until cheese has melted.
Shred lettuce.
Dice tomato.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top beef with lettuce, tomato and sour cream.
Serve corn chips on the side for dipping.
Grab a chip and dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Pulled Beef Ragù with Penne Pasta & Parmesan
recipes.description: A quick and hearty pasta dish featuring tender pulled beef in a rich tomato-based sauce, paired with penne pasta and topped with grated Parmesan cheese. Perfect for a satisfying and comforting meal.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Add pasta to pot and cook for 8-10 mins, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Grate carrot.
Add to pan along with measure of spices and tomato paste and cook for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add canned tomatoes, pulled beef, stock and sugar to pan and bring to a simmer.
Cook for a further 4 mins, breaking up with a wooden spoon, until sauce is thickened.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Remove pan from heat.
Stir through spinach and cooked pasta, until warmed through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pan not big enough?
Add ragù to pot with pasta instead.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up pasta and sprinkle over Parmesan.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Pulled Pork Tacos
recipes.description: Quick and flavorful tacos made with tender pulled pork, topped with a fresh pineapple salsa and a tangy Texas sauce, perfect for a satisfying and easy meal.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Add pork, measure of spices and stock to pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium.
Simmer for about 3 mins, until thickened, breaking up meat as it heats.
Add Texas sauce and cook for 1 min, until mixed through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Save pineapple juice in a bowl (S2: 1 Tbsp, S4: 2 Tbsp, S6: 3 Tbsp) and drain pineapple chunks.
Add pineapple chunks to bowl with saved juice.
Dice tomato.
Roughly chop spinach.
Add all salsa ingredients to bowl with pineapple.
Season to taste with salt.
Gently separate tortillas.
Microwave 3-4 tortillas at a time in the microwave for 20 secs, until warm.
Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Fill tortillas with cabbage and pork.
Spoon over salsa.
Dollop over mayo.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Smoky Pulled Pork Nachos
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful dish featuring crispy tortilla chips topped with smoky pulled pork, melted cheese, sour cream, and fresh vegetables, perfect for a satisfying and easy meal.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Drain and rinse beans.
Drain corn.
Add corn, pork, measure of spices, beans and stock to the pan.
Bring to a simmer.
Drop heat to medium and simmer, breaking up pork as it cooks, for about 3 mins, until thickened.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Grate cheese and sprinkle over pork.
Place a lid on the pan and cook 2 more mins, until cheese has melted.
Shred lettuce and peel carrot into ribbons.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top pork with lettuce, carrot and sour cream.
Serve corn chips on the side for dipping.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Smoky Pulled Pork Nachos with Cheese & Sour Cream
recipes.description: A quick and satisfying dish featuring crispy tortilla chips topped with smoky pulled pork, melted cheese, fresh vegetables, and a dollop of sour cream for a creamy finish.

instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Drain and rinse beans.
Drain corn.
Add corn, pork, measure of spices, beans and stock to the pan.
Bring to a simmer.
Drop heat to medium and simmer, breaking up pork as it cooks, for about 3 mins, until thickened.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Sprinkle cheese over pork.
Place a lid on the pan and cook 2 mins, until cheese has melted.
Shred lettuce and peel carrot into ribbons.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top pork with lettuce, carrot and sour cream.
Serve corn chips on the side for dipping.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Teriyaki Beef Tacos
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender beef in a savory teriyaki sauce, served in soft tortillas with a refreshing slaw and a creamy mayo topping.

ingredients.name: telegraph cucumber
ingredients.prep: cut in half & thinly sliced on an angle

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Grate carrot and add to pan along with beef.
Cook for about 7 mins, until cooked through, breaking up the beef as it cooks.
Add teriyaki sauce and soy sauce to pan and toss to coat.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Toss slaw in a bowl with vinegar.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Wrap stack of tortillas in a damp tea towel.
Heat in microwave for 1-2 mins, until warm.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Cut cucumber in half and thinly slice on angle.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill tortillas with beef, slaw, cucumber, mayo and chilli flakes, if using.
Dig in!

recipes.name: 20-Minute Teriyaki Beef Tacos with Cucumber & Slaw
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender beef in a teriyaki sauce, served in soft tortillas with a refreshing cucumber slaw and a creamy dipping sauce.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Cut cucumber in half and thinly slice on an angle.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Add carrot and beef to pan.
Cook for about 7 mins, until cooked through, breaking up the beef as it cooks.
Add teriyaki sauce to pan and toss to coat.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: While beef cooks, toss slaw in a bowl with vinegar and sesame oil.
Season to taste with pepper.

instructions.heading: Warm It
instructions.text: Place stack of tortillas on a plate and microwave for about 1 min to warm.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill tortillas with beef, slaw, cucumber, mayo and chilli flakes.
Tip If you have a gas hob, try this cool trick!
Heat tortillas directly over the gas flame for about 5 seconds each side, for an authentic charred flavour.

recipes.name: 20-Minute Teriyaki Pork & Beef Tacos with Cucumber & Slaw
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful taco recipe featuring tender pork and beef in a savory teriyaki sauce, served with fresh cucumber slaw for a refreshing contrast.

ingredients.name: telegraph cucumber
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Grate carrot and add to pan along with mince.
Cook for about 7 mins, until cooked through, breaking up the mince as it cooks.
Add teriyaki sauce to pan and toss to coat.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: While mince cooks, toss slaw in a bowl with vinegar and sesame oil.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Gently separate tortillas.
Microwave 3-4 tortillas on a heatproof plate for 20 secs, until warm.
Repeat with remaining tortillas.

instructions.heading: Cut It
instructions.text: Cut cucumber in half lengthways and thinly slice.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill tortillas with mince, slaw, cucumber, mayo and chilli flakes (if using).

recipes.name: 20-Minute Thai Red Chicken Tacos with Creamy Coconut Curry Sauce
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful meal featuring tender chicken tacos infused with Thai red curry spices, served with a creamy coconut curry sauce and fresh slaw for a burst of freshness and spice.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Cook chicken for about 5 mins, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Add red curry paste, coconut milk, soy sauce and water measure (S2 only).
Like it spicy?
You can add less or more red curry paste to suit your preferred heat level.
Bring to a simmer.
Simmer for about 3-5 mins, until sauce is slightly reduced.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Cut cucumber in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Toss with slaw and vinegar in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Warm It
instructions.text: Place stack of tortillas on a plate and microwave for about 1 min to warm.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load tortillas with slaw, chicken and coconut sauce from the pan.
Fold it up and enjoy!

recipes.name: American Hotdogs
recipes.description: A classic American dish featuring hot dog rolls filled with beef Frankfurters, topped with caramelized onions, spinach, cheese, and served with apple slaw, tomato sauce, and mustard. A hearty and flavorful meal perfect for casual dining.

instructions.text: PREHEAT oven to 220°C.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.

instructions.heading: Cook Onions
instructions.text: Thinly slice all onion and set second measure aside.
Heat a little oil in a small fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook first measures of onion for about 5 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add paprika (if using), salt, sugar and chilli flakes (if using), and cook a further 2 minutes, until onions are caramelised.
Set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep Rolls
instructions.text: While onions are cooking, slice hot dog rolls lengthways, 3/4 of the way down through the top, leaving a hinge.
Place rolls on a lined oven tray and set aside.
Roughly chop first measure of spinach and set aside.

instructions.heading: Pickle Onion
instructions.text: Place second measure of red onion in a small bowl with vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Mix to combine and set aside to marinate.

instructions.heading: Make Slaw
instructions.text: Mix mayo and mustard together in a large bowl.
Grate carrots; cut courgette and apple into matchsticks (or grate); add to bowl with the mayo along with second measure of spinach.
Mix to combine and set aside.

instructions.heading: Cook Frankfurters
instructions.text: Add Frankfurters to pot of boiling water, reduce to a simmer and cook for about 5 minutes, until hot through.
Drain and return to pot.

instructions.heading: Bake Hotdogs
instructions.text: Fill rolls with Frankfurters and top with caramelised onions, chopped spinach and cheese.
Bake in oven for about 5 minutes, until buns are toasted and cheese is melted.
TO SERVE, divide hotdogs between plates, top with quickled onions, tomato sauce and mustard and serve slaw on the side.

recipes.name: ASIAN CHICKEN SKEWERS
recipes.description: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in a savory Asian-inspired sauce, served with a fresh salad of corn, capsicum, onion, and spinach, perfect for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Skewers
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Bring a small pot of salted water to the boil.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Soak bamboo skewers in water for 10 minutes.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Potatoes
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm and toss on a lined oven tray with first measure of chicken and potato spices and a little oil.
Season and roast for 25-30 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Turn once during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Marinade & Chicken
instructions.text: Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl and season with pepper.
Pat chicken dry and cut into long 1cm strips.
Add to marinade, mix to combine and set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Add corn to pot of boiling water and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Drain and add to a large bowl.
Thinly slice capsicum and onion and add to bowl along with sour cream.
Mix to combine and set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Thread 2-3 chicken strips onto each skewer.
Place on a lined oven tray and bake for 10-12 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Alternatively, cook on BBQ grill or hot plate for 10-12 minutes, turning regularly so all sides cook evenly.

instructions.heading: Mix Salad
instructions.text: When potatoes are cooked, add to salad bowl along with spinach.
Toss and season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide salad between plates and top with Asian chicken skewers.

recipes.name: Asian-Style BBQ Chicken Steaks with Creamy Potato Salad
recipes.description: A flavorful dinner featuring grilled chicken steaks marinated in an Asian-inspired barbecue sauce, served alongside a creamy potato salad with fresh greens and colorful vegetables.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high, if using.
Dice potatoes 3cm.
Add potatoes to a pot and cover with hot tap water.
Cook for 15-20 mins on high heat, with the lid on.
Add peas to pot and cook for a further 3 mins, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Set aside to cool down.
Dice capsicum and set aside.

instructions.heading: Slice It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks, placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Heat oil on BBQ hot plate and cook chicken for 4-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Cook capsicum on hot plate for about 4-5 mins, until tender.
Rest chicken for about 2 mins, then slice.
Toss chicken in a bowl with Korean sticky chilli sauce.
Alternatively, use same method to cook chicken in a frypan with a drizzle of oil.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Just before serving, toss all potato salad ingredients together in pot with potatoes.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate chicken with potato salad on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: BACON 'N' EGG PIE
recipes.description: A savory pie filled with crispy bacon, tender eggs, and a mix of vegetables like corn, spinach, and tomatoes, topped with flaky filo pastry. Served with a fresh honey mustard vinaigrette salad, this hearty dish is perfect for a comforting meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Grease a large baking dish (measuring about 20 x 40cm).
Chop bacon about 2cm and thinly slice onion.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Cook bacon and onion for about 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Dice tomatoes 2cm and set aside.
Add corn to pan with bacon and onion and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until any liquid is evaporated.
Stir through tomatoes and spinach and season.
Transfer to prepared dish.
In a small bowl, whisk eggs, salt and milk and pour over bacon mix.
Season with pepper.
Lay sheets of filo out on a flat surface, lightly brush or spray with a little oil and loosely scrunch up.
Place pieces of filo on top of pie mix, in a single layer, until the pie is covered.
Bake (on bottom oven rack) for 20-22 minutes, until egg is cooked through and pastry is golden.
Turn dish halfway through cooking.
Let stand for about 3 minutes before serving.

instructions.heading: Looking Good
instructions.text: Whisk honey, oil, mustard and vinegar in a medium bowl.
Roughly chop lettuce, peel and dice orange 1cm and add to a bowl with dressing, along with almonds.
Season to taste.
To serve, cut pie and serve with salad on the side with your favourite relish or tomato sauce.

recipes.name: BACON PESTO PASTA
recipes.description: A flavorful pasta dish featuring penne tossed in a creamy sauce made with bacon, pesto, and sour cream, topped with grated cheese and fresh spinach.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Dice bacon 1cm, thinly slice onion and capsicum and cut broccoli into small florets.

instructions.heading: Cook Pasta
instructions.text: Cook pasta in pot of boiling water for 9 minutes, add broccoli and cook a further 3 minutes, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot with a little oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook bacon for about 5 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add onion, capsicum and garlic and cook for a further 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Reduce heat to medium-low and add pesto, salt, sour cream, drained pasta and broccoli.
Mix to combine and cook a further 1 minute, until warmed through.
Seasón to taste and stir through spinach.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Top pasta with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Bacon Ravioli
recipes.description: A hearty pasta dish featuring spinach and ricotta ravioli, sautéed bacon, leeks, and a rich tomato-based sauce. Topped with grated cheese, this comforting meal is perfect for a satisfying dinner.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Thinly slice onion and leek; roughly chop tomato; dice bacon 2cm; cut broccoli into small florets.
Set aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Cook onion and bacon for 4-5 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add leek and a pinch of salt, reduce heat to medium-high and cook a further 5 minutes, until softened.
Add ravioli herbs and cook a further 1 minute, stirring until fragrant.
Add stock, tomato passata and tomato.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low and cook for 5-6 minutes, scraping the bottom to lift any brownings, until thickened.
Stir through butter and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Cook Pasta
instructions.text: While sauce is simmering, cook pasta and broccoli in large pot of boiling water for about 4 minutes, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot with a little oil and a pinch of salt.
SERVE ravioli and broccoli topped with sauce and cheese.

recipes.name: BACON RISOTTO
recipes.description: A creamy risotto infused with savory bacon, tender vegetables, and a rich blend of Parmesan cheese, sour cream, and aromatic herbs. Perfect for a comforting and indulgent meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Risotto
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Finely dice onion; thinly slice mushrooms; dice bacon 2cm.

instructions.heading: Cook Risotto
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large pot (with a lid) on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and mushrooms for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add garlic, risotto herbs, salt and rice and cook for about 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add water and stock and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low- medium, cover with lid and cook for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until nearly tender.

instructions.heading: Cook Topping
instructions.text: While risotto is simmering, toss pumpkin and bacon on a line oven tray with a drizzle of oil.
Season and roast for 15-20 minutes, until golden and tender.
Turn once during cooking.

instructions.heading: Finish Risotto
instructions.text: When rice is nearly tender, remove lid, add peas and cook a further 3-4 minutes, until rice is tender, and peas are bright green and tender.
Stir through spinach, first measure of Parmesan and sour cream and season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon risotto into bowls.
Top with bacon, pumpkin and remaining Parmesan.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful baked chicken dish with tender chicken thighs, aromatic vegetables, and a creamy lemon yoghurt sauce, perfect for a comforting and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken & Veggies
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Thinly slice onion and capsicum and grate carrot.
Pat chicken dry, cut in half lengthways, rub with first measure of baked chicken spices and season with salt.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large, deep oven proof fry-pan on medium high heat.
Cook chicken for about 2 minutes each side, until browned but not cooked through.
Remove chicken from pan and set aside.
Return pan to medium high heat with a little more oil if needed.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies & Rice
instructions.text: Cook onion and capsicum for about 3 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add remaining baked chicken spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add stock, water, rice, carrot, salt and lemon zest.
Stir to combine and return chicken to pan (placing on top of rice and veggies) along with any resting juices.

instructions.heading: Bake Rice
instructions.text: Bring to a simmer, cover tightly with foil or an oven proof lid and bake in oven for 25 minutes.
If you don't have an oven proof fry-pan, simply transfer rice and stock mix to a baking dish before adding the chicken and covering.
Set aside to rest for 5 minutes before removing foil.
Stir though spinach.

instructions.heading: Prep Yoghurt
instructions.text: In a small bowl combine lemon juice and yoghurt.
SERVE baked chicken rice with a dollop of lemon yoghurt.

recipes.name: Balanced BBQ Pork Meatballs with Kūmara Wedges & Slaw
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dinner featuring BBQ pork meatballs paired with roasted kūmara wedges and a refreshing slaw, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan bake).
Cut kūmara into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the oven for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Swap trays halfway through to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Shape It
instructions.text: Grate first measure of carrot.
Combine with pork, breadcrumbs, measure of spices and salt measure in a bowl.
Use a tablespoon measure and damp hands to shape mixture into balls.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium heat.
Cook meatballs for about 10 mins, turning frequently, until cooked through.
Remove from heat and add BBQ sauce.
Toss to coat and rest, covered, for 2-3 mins.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Peel second measure of carrot into ribbons.
Toss all slaw ingredients in a second bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate wedges and BBQ meatballs with slaw.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Beef Italian Meatballs with Fresh Salad & Feta
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring tender beef meatballs in a rich tomato sauce, served with a fresh salad and crumbled feta cheese, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Peel and dice potatoes.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water.
Bring to the boil and cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine all meatball ingredients (except oil), until well combined.
Use a Tbsp measure and damp hands to shape mixture into balls.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook meatballs for 5-6 mins, turning frequently, until browned.
Add tomato passata, soy sauce and sugar to pan.
Gently stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 5-7 mins, until reduced and meatballs are cooked through.
Remove from heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Thinly slice cucumber.
Toss in a bowl with measure of vinegar and set aside for serving.
Top mash with saucy meatballs.
Crumble over feta and serve salad on the side.
Dinner is ready!

recipes.name: Balanced Beef Pot Pie with Tomato Chutney
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender beef in a rich tomato chutney sauce, topped with a golden, flaky crust. Perfect for a satisfying and balanced meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
If you don't have an ovenproof frypan, set aside a baking dish.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Peel and dice potatoes and carrot 2cm, place in a second pot and cover with hot tap water.
Cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very soft.
Drain and return to pot with milk.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Finely dice onion.
Heat oil in an ovenproof frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion for about 6 mins, until starting to brown.
Add beef mince, salt measure and measure of spices and cook for another 5-6 mins, stirring to break up beef, until beef is browned.
Add flour and cook for 1 min.
Add water measure and soy sauce to pan, bring to a simmer and cook for 6-8 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Transfer to baking dish, if using.

instructions.heading: Top It
instructions.text: Spoon topping over filling and smooth out.
Use a fork to drag deep lines into the topping.
Transfer to oven and grill for about 5 mins, until browned.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets.
Cook broccoli in pot of boiling water for about 4 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Allow pie to cool slightly before serving.
Dollop with tomato chutney and serve broccoli on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Beef Pot Pie with Tomato Jam
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender beef, vegetables, and a rich tomato jam topping, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
If you don't have an ovenproof frypan, set aside a baking dish.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Peel and dice potatoes and carrot 2cm, place in a second pot and cover with hot tap water.
Cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very soft.
Drain and return to pot with milk.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Finely dice onion.
Heat oil in an ovenproof frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion for about 6 mins, until starting to brown.
Add beef mince, salt measure and measure of spices and cook for another 5-6 mins, stirring to break up beef, until beef is browned.
Add flour and cook for 1 min.
Add water measure and soy sauce to pan, bring to a simmer and cook for 6-8 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Transfer to baking dish, if using.

instructions.heading: Top It
instructions.text: Spoon topping over filling and smooth out.
Use a fork to drag deep lines into the topping.
Transfer to oven and grill for about 5 mins, until browned.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Trim ends from green beans.
Cook green beans in pot of boiling water for about 3 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Allow pie to cool slightly before serving.
Dollop with tomato jam and serve green beans on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Bunless Beef Patties
recipes.description: A hearty and nutritious meal featuring crispy beef patties served with colorful veggie wedges and a fresh crunch salad, perfect for a satisfying and healthy dinner.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes and carrot into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 25-30 mins, until golden and tender.
If using 2 trays, swap halfway through cook time to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: In a bowl, mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, salt measure and measure of herb blend together, until well combined.
Divide patty mixture and roll into balls (S2: 3 balls, S4: 6 balls, S6: 9 balls).
Flatten into patties, about 2cm thick.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook patties, in batches if needed, for 4-5 mins each side until browned.
Add more oil between batches if needed.
Set aside, covered, to serve.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Mix honey, vinegar and olive oil in a salad bowl.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Thinly slice tomato Add to salad bowl and toss to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Stack up wedges with patties on the side.
Drizzle over garlic aioli and tomato sauce or use for dipping.
Serve salad on the side.
Yum!

recipes.name: Balanced Cajun Pork Wedges with Sweet Chilli Yoghurt
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring cajun-seasoned pork wedges served with a sweet chili yogurt sauce, perfect for a hearty and zesty meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Add corn and cook for about 5 mins, until charred.
Meanwhile, dice tomato.
Transfer charred corn to a bowl, saving pan.
Add remaining salsa ingredients to bowl and toss.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Heat oil in saved frypan on high heat.
Add carrot, cornflour and measure of spices and cook for about 2 mins, until soft.
Add pork and cook, stirring to break it up, for a further 5 mins.
Add canned tomatoes and salt measure and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for about 5 mins, until thick.
Season to taste with pepper.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Grate cheese.
When wedges and chilli are cooked, remove wedges from oven, pour pork chilli over top and sprinkle with cheese.
Return to the oven to cook for 5 mins, or until cheese has melted.
Meanwhile, mix yoghurt and sweet chilli sauce together in a bowl.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon loaded wedges onto plates and top with salsa.
Drizzle over sweet chilli yoghurt.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Balanced Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich tomato sauce with mushrooms, bell peppers, and served with roasted potatoes and a garlic cream sauce.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Dice potatoes 2cm.
Toss potatoes with oil on a lined oven tray and spread in an even layer.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 20-25 mins, until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Sear It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
Finely dice onion and cut mushrooms into quarters Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Sear chicken with a pinch of salt for 2 mins each side, until golden but not cooked through.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Add onion, mushrooms, measure of spices and flour to pan with chicken and cook for 3 mins, until soft.
Add remaining ingredients.
Bring to a boil and simmer for a further 3-4 mins, until thickened and cooked through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Bowl up potatoes and chicken cacciatore.
Top with garlic cream.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Chinese-Style Sticky Chicken
recipes.description: A savory and sweet Chinese-inspired dish featuring tender chicken coated in a sticky, sesame-infused sauce, served with brown rice and peanuts for a balanced and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a pot of water.
Add rice to pot of boiling water.
Bring back to the boil and cook rice (ensuring a rapid boil) for about 25-30 mins, or until grains are tender.
Drain well through a sieve.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Toss on a lined oven tray with oil, season with salt and pepper and roast for 10 mins.
Meanwhile, slice bok choy.
After broccoli has had 10 mins cook time, add bok choy and sesame oil to tray and cook for a further 5-7 mins, until tender.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and dice 3cm.
Toss in a bowl with cornflour and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 6-8 mins (depending on thickness), turning occasionally, until cooked through and golden.
Set aside in a heatproof bowl and save pan.
Finely grate ginger and combine in a bowl with soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, honey, sesame oil and water measure.
Return pan to low-medium and cook sauce for about 2 mins, until slightly reduced.
Return chicken and any resting juices to pan and toss to coat.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill bowls with rice and top with chicken and veggies.
Drizzle with sauce from the pan and sprinkle over peanuts.

recipes.name: Balanced Citrus Chicken Steaks
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring citrus-marinated chicken steaks served over a bed of bulgur pilaf with fresh vegetables and a dollop of yogurt, offering a light and refreshing meal.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Grate carrot.
Dice courgette 1cm.
Heat butter and oil in a pot on medium-high.
Cook carrot, courgette and salt measure for about 4 mins, until soft.
Add bulgur and boiling water measure and bring to the boil.
Once simmering, cover with a lid, drop heat to low and cook for 10 mins.
Remove from heat, leave lid on, and steam for 10 mins.
Liquid should be absorbed and grains tender.
Once cooked, fold through spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Mince garlic.
Zest lime.
Pat chicken dry.
Cut chicken into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Add all chicken ingredients (except oil) to a bowl and mix to combine.

instructions.heading: Sear It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side, or until golden and cooked through.
Set aside to rest.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine yoghurt, lime juice and honey.
Thinly slice chicken.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Serve bulgur topped with chicken.
Dollop over honey yoghurt.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Balanced Garlic & Citrusy Chicken with Wedges
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring chicken marinated in garlic and citrus, served with crispy potato wedges and a fresh salad, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays and spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.
Swap trays halfway to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Marinate It
instructions.text: Mince garlic.
Add to a bowl with lime zest and first measure of lime juice, honey, soy sauce, measure of spices and salt measure.
Cut chicken into 1-2cm strips.
Toss through marinade to coat.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy.
Grate carrot.
Chop spinach.
Toss in a bowl with remaining slaw ingredients.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches if needed, for about 6 mins, stirring, until browned and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken with wedges and slaw.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Glazed Chicken Soba Noodle Salad with Peanuts
recipes.description: A vibrant and flavorful noodle salad featuring glazed chicken, soba noodles, crunchy peanuts, and a mix of fresh vegetables like edamame and shredded cabbage, all tossed in a savory glaze.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
Heat oil in frypan on medium-high.
Add chicken to pan with a pinch of salt and cook 6-7 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden.
Add lime & lemongrass glaze to pan and cook for 2 mins more, until glaze has thickened and cooked through.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Cook noodles and edamame beans in pot of boiling water for about 4 mins, until tender.
Drain, rinse under cold water and drain again.
Return to pot with first measure of sesame oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Add to a bowl with cabbage, vinegar and second measure of sesame oil.
Add noodles, edamame beans and chicken to bowl.
Toss until well coated.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Bowl up chicken noodle salad.
Sprinkle with peanuts and chilli flakes, if using.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Italian Beef Meatballs with Super Veggie Mash & Feta
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring tender Italian beef meatballs served with a vibrant super veggie mash and topped with crumbled feta cheese, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Peel and dice potatoes.
Dice carrot 2cm.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water.
Bring to the boil and cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Shape It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine all meatball ingredients (except oil), until well combined.
Use a Tbsp measure and damp hands to shape mixture into balls.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook meatballs for 5-6 mins, turning frequently, until browned.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Add tomato passata, soy sauce and sugar to pan.
Gently stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 5-7 mins, until reduced and meatballs are cooked through.
Remove from heat and stir through spinach, until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top mash with saucy meatballs.
Crumble over feta.
Dinner is ready!

recipes.name: Balanced Lemony Chicken Steaks with Bulgur & Yoghurt
recipes.description: A flavorful and nutritious dish featuring tender chicken steaks seasoned with lemon, served over a bed of bulgur pilaf mixed with carrots and spinach, and topped with a dollop of creamy yogurt.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Grate carrot.
Cut cauliflower into small florets.
Heat butter and oil in a pot on medium-high.
Cook carrot, cauliflower and salt measure for about 4 mins, until soft.
Add bulgur and boiling water measure and bring to the boil.
Once simmering, cover with a lid, drop heat to low and cook for 10 mins.
Remove from heat, leave lid on, and steam for 10 mins.
Liquid should be absorbed and grains tender.
Once cooked, fold through spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Mince garlic (if using).
Zest lemon.
Pat chicken dry.
Cut chicken into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Add all chicken ingredients (except oil) to a bowl and mix to combine.

instructions.heading: Sear It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side, or until golden and cooked through.
Set aside to rest.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine yoghurt, lemon juice and honey.
Thinly slice chicken.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Serve bulgur topped with chicken.
Dollop over honey yoghurt.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Balanced Middle Eastern Lamb Loaded Wedges
recipes.description: A flavorful twist on loaded fries, featuring crispy potato wedges topped with spiced lamb, melted cheese, and a refreshing yoghurt and cucumber salsa. Perfect for a hearty and satisfying meal with Middle Eastern flair.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined trays with measure of spices and oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.
Want crispy potatoes?
Swap trays halfway through cook time.

instructions.heading: Chop It
instructions.text: Dice cucumber.
Roughly chop spinach.
Add all salsa ingredients to a bowl.
Toss to combine.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook carrot, lamb and salt measure for about 5 mins, stirring to break up lamb, until browned.
Add measure of spices and tomato paste and cook for about 2 mins, until fragrant.
Add stock and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for about 3 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Add yoghurt, mayo and honey to a bowl.
Mix to combine.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load up wedges with lamb and salsa and drizzle over yoghurt.

recipes.name: Balanced Southern Beef Loaded Wedges with Smoked Paprika Aioli
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring crispy sweet potato wedges topped with savory beef, fresh greens, and a creamy smoked paprika aioli, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut kūmara into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.
Swap trays halfway through cook time to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook carrot, beef and salt measure for about 5 mins, until browned.
Add measure of spices, flour and tomato paste and cook for about 2 mins, until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for 3-5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Stir through spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load up those wedges!
Top with beef chilli and dollop over smoked paprika aioli.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Balanced Southern Pork Wedges with Sweet Chilli Yoghurt
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring crispy pork wedges topped with a savory crumb and paired with a sweet chili yogurt dip, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Drain corn and cook for about 5 mins, until charred.
Meanwhile, dice tomato.
Transfer charred corn to a heatproof bowl and save pan for next step.
Add remaining salsa ingredients to bowl and toss to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Heat oil in saved frypan on high.
Add carrot, cornflour and measure of spices and cook for about 2 mins, until soft.
Add pork and cook, stirring to break it up, for a further 5 mins.
Add canned tomatoes and salt measure and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer for about 5 mins, until thick.
Season to taste with pepper.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: When wedges and chilli are cooked, remove wedges from oven, pour pork chilli over top and sprinkle with cheese.
Return to the oven to cook for 5 mins, or until cheese has melted.
Meanwhile, mix yoghurt and sweet chilli sauce together in a bowl.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon loaded wedges onto plates and top with salsa.
Drizzle over sweet chilli yoghurt.
Dig in!

recipes.name: BBQ Beef Steaks
recipes.description: A hearty dinner featuring juicy beef steaks seasoned with garlic, soy sauce, and pepper, served with a fresh potato salad and sautéed vegetables. The meal is perfect for a satisfying and flavorful dinner experience.

instructions.text: PREP & COOK POTATO SALAD.
Preheat BBQ hot plate or grill to medium-high (if using).
Dice potatoes 2cm, add to a medium pot and cover with hot tap water.
Cook for 20-25 minutes on high heat with the lid on, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Thinly slice spring onions, cut cherry tomatoes in half and finely dice onion.
Add to a large bowl and set aside.
When potatoes are cooked, add to bowl along with mayo and mustard.
Gently mix to combine and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Prep Beef & Veggies
instructions.text: Pat beef dry, season with pepper and mix with garlic, soy sauce and oil in a bowl.
Cut courgette in half lengthways, then slice 1cm and cut asparagus into thirds, COOK BEEF.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook beef for 3-4 minutes each side for medium (depending on thickness), or until cooked to your liking.
Set aside, covered, to rest.
Alternatively cook on the BBQ.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Return pan to heat with a little more oil and cook veggies for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Slice beef thinly against the grain, then toss back through any resting juices.
SERVE potato salad with steak, veggies and your favourite relish or sauce.

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork Loaded Wedges
recipes.description: A hearty and indulgent dish featuring crispy potato wedges topped with BBQ pulled pork, melted cheese, and a dollop of sour cream, perfect for sharing or as a comforting meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Spread in a single layer on a lined oven tray and toss with oil.
Season with salt and pepper and roast on upper rack for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.
Grate carrot and drain corn.
Drain and rinse beans.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook carrot for 3-4 mins, until soft.
Add measure of spices and tomato paste and cook for about 30 secs, until fragrant.
Add kidney beans, pork, BBQ sauce, stock, canned tomatoes, corn and chilli flakes (if using) to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook on low-medium for about 3 mins, until pork is hot through.
Stir occasionally.
Add a splash of water if sauce dries out.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Grate cheese.
When wedges are cooked, remove from oven and switch oven to high grill.
Spoon pork evenly over wedges and sprinkle with cheese.
Return to oven to grill for about 3 mins, until cheese is melted.
Top wedges with sour cream.
Grab a wedge and enjoy!

recipes.name: BEEF 'N' BACON MEATBALLS
recipes.description: A hearty and savory dish featuring meatballs made with beef and bacon, served with a rich tomato-based sauce and a side of couscous. The dish is infused with Italian herbs, creating a flavorful and comforting meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Meatballs
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Add to a medium bowl with beef, bacon, first measure of meatball herbs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Mix well and roll into golf ball-sized balls.

instructions.heading: Cook Meatballs
instructions.text: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook meatballs for about 4 minutes, turning often, until browned on all sides (but not cooked through).
Transfer to a large baking dish in a single layer.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Wipe pan clean and return to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil.
Cook pumpkin and salt for about 5 minutes, until soft.
Add a splash of water if pumpkin sticks.
Add remaining meatball herbs and tomato paste and cook a further 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add stock, canned tomatoes and sugar.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 minutes, until thickened.
Season to taste, stir through spinach and pour over meatballs.
Shake dish a little to evenly distribute sauce then crumble over feta.

instructions.heading: Bake Meatballs
instructions.text: Bake meatballs for 15-18 minutes, until cooked through.

instructions.heading: Cook Couscous
instructions.text: When meatballs have about 5 minutes remaining, combine boiling water, couscous and a pinch of salt in a heat-proof bowl.
Stir, cover and leave to swell for 5 minutes, then fluff up grains with a fork.
SERVE couscous topped with beef 'n' bacon meatballs.

recipes.name: Beef 'n' Bean Nachos
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring a rich beef and bean chili served over crispy corn chips, topped with fresh lettuce, tomato, sour cream, and sweet chili sauce.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Rinse and drain beans COOK BEEF 'N' BEANS.
Heat a little oil in a large, deep fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and carrot for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add beef mince, nacho spices, chilli flakes and salt and cook for 5-6 minutes, until mince is browned.
Add all remaining beef ingredients to pan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low-medium and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Thinly slice lettuce and dice tomato 1cm.
SERVE chips topped with beef, lettuce, tomato, sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Beef 'n' Cheese Pie
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting pie filled with a savory beef mixture, topped with a creamy cheese mash, and served with vibrant greens. This dish combines rich flavors and a satisfying texture, perfect for a cozy meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Set aside a medium baking dish.
Bring two medium pots of salted water to the boil.
Dice kumara and potatoes 2cm.
Cook kumara and potatoes in first pot of boiling water for 15-20 minutes, until soft.
Drain and mash with first measure of butter and milk.
Season to taste and set aside.
While kumara and potatoes are cooking, finely dice onion and dice carrots 1cm.
Heat a little oil in a medium fry-pan on high heat.
Cook onion, carrots and salt for about 3 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add beef and garlic (if using) and cook for about 7 minutes, breaking mince up as it cooks, until browned.
Reduce heat to medium, add pie herbs and flour and cook a further 1 minute, stirring until fragrant.
Add stock, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce and tomato sauce.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 3 minutes, until thickened.
Season to taste.
Transfer to reserved dish.
Spoon mash on top of mince, spreading out to cover.
Sprinkle over cheese and grill on middle- upper oven rack for 5-7 minutes, until cheese is golden.

instructions.heading: Cheesy Goodness
instructions.text: While pie is grilling, cut broccoli into small florets.
Add to second pot of boiling water along with peas and cook about 4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain and return to pot with second measure of butter (if using).
Toss to combine and season to taste.
To serve, divide pie between plates and serve greens on the side.
Serve with tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Beef 'n' Feta Flatbreads
recipes.description: A savory flatbread topped with Texan beef grind, crumbled feta cheese, and a spicy tomato sauce, served with a fresh spinach salad.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat two oven trays.
Thinly slice onion and courgette.
Mix tomato paste, sweet chilli sauce and oil together in a small bowl, then spread evenly over flat breads.
Pinch teaspoon-size amounts of beef grind and divide evenly between flatbreads.
Sprinkle over onion and courgette and crumble over feta.
Season.
Cut one flatbread in half and place two and a half breads onto each tray (use a fish slice to help with this) and bake for 12-15 minutes, until golden and crispy.
Switch trays halfway through cooking.

instructions.heading: Nice
instructions.text: While flatbreads are baking, finely dice tomato and peel carrot into ribbons.
Add to a bowl with spinach, vinegar and oil and toss just before serving.
Season to taste.
Whisk all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside (if using).
To serve, cut flatbreads into pieces, drizzle with sauce (if using) and top with spinach salad.
Serve in the middle of the table for everyone to help themselves.

recipes.name: Beef 'n' Pumpkin Bake
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting casserole featuring a rich beef and pumpkin filling, layered with tortillas and topped with a creamy yoghurt and sweet chilli sauce, finished with grated cheese.

instructions.heading: Prep Filling
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Grease a casserole dish (about 20x30cm) with oil.
Finely dice onion; grate carrot; peel and dice pumpkin 1cm.

instructions.heading: Cook Filling
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and garlic for 2-3 minutes, until soft.
Add beef, beef spices and chilli flakes and cook, stirring for about 5 minutes, until browned.
Add pumpkin and carrot to pan with beef and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.
Add tomato paste, tomato passata, stock, soy sauce, sugar and salt.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and cook for about 8 minutes, until thickened.

instructions.heading: Assemble
instructions.text: Cut 3 tortillas into quarters and keep 3 tortillas whole.
Lay 1 whole tortilla and two quarter pieces into the base of the casserole dish in a single layer.
Spread over a third of the filling and repeat with tortillas and filling for two more layers, finishing with remaining tortillas on top.

instructions.heading: Bake
instructions.text: Mix yoghurt and sweet chilli sauce together and spread over top.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for about 15 minutes, until topping is golden.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions.heading: Cook Corn
instructions.text: Bring a small pot of salted water to the boil and cook corn for about 4 minutes, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with a little butter.
Season to taste.
SERVE beef 'n' pumpkin with corn on the side.

recipes.name: Beef Cheeseburger Stacks
recipes.description: A creative twist on classic cheeseburgers, these stacks combine crispy potato patties, savory beef patties, melted cheese, caramelized onions, fresh salad, and a variety of sauces for a hearty and flavorful meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Potato
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to high (if using).
Grate potatoes and use hands or a tea towel to squeeze out excess liquid.
Toss in a bowl with a drizzle of oil and salt, season with pepper and scatter in a thin layer on a lined oven tray.

instructions.heading: Cook Potato
instructions.text: Bake potato for 30-35 minutes, until golden and crispy.

instructions.heading: Prep Burgers
instructions.text: Finely dice first measure of onion.
Add to a medium bowl with all burger ingredients (except cheese) and season with pepper.
Mix well to combine.
Use a ½ cup measure and damp hands to form mix into patties, about 1.5cm thick.

instructions.heading: Cook Burgers
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook patties, in 2 batches, for 2-3 minutes each side, until browned.
Transfer to a lined oven tray and sprinkle with cheese.
Place on rack above potatoes and cook for 8-10 minutes, until cheese is melted, and patties are cooked through.
Alternatively, cook patties and second measure of onion on BBQ hotplate.
Grill cheese with BBQ lid down.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Grate beetroot and carrots and toss in a bowl with vinegar.
Tear lettuce into large pieces.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Onion
instructions.text: Thinly slice second measure of onion.
Return same pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and butter and cook onion for 4-5 minutes, until golden.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide potato between plates, stack with burgers, onion, salad and lettuce.
Dollop with awesome sauce, mustard and tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Cheeseburgers
recipes.description: Classic beef burgers topped with melted cheese, fresh lettuce, tomato, and served with crispy fries. A hearty and satisfying meal perfect for any occasion.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Potatoes
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C.
