Cut potatoes into 1cm thick chips and toss on a lined oven tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for 25-30 minutes, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Prep Burgers
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Mix all burger ingredients in a large bowl.
Use a 1/3 cup measure to scoop out mix into 8 even sized balls.
Flatten into patties about 1cm thick.

instructions.heading: Cook Burgers
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook patties for about 2 minutes each side, until browned (they do not need to be cooked through yet).
Transfer to a second lined oven tray (with a lip).
Cut buns in half horizontally; thinly slice tomatoes and cheese; tear lettuce; cut cucumber in half and thinly slice.
Place buns, closed, on tray with patties.
Top patties with cheese and cook in oven, on rack below potatoes for about 4 minutes, until patties are cooked through and buns are warm.
SERVE buns filled with patties, lettuce, tomato, cucumber and sauces.
Serve chips on the side and any remaining patties with salad.

recipes.name: Beef Chilli Bowls with Rice & Sour Cream
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting meal featuring a rich beef chili served over fluffy rice, topped with a dollop of sour cream and shredded cheese for a satisfying twist.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Dice onion.
Grate cheese.
Drain and rinse beans and corn.
Thinly slice spring onion.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook onion with a pinch of salt for 3-4 mins, until softened.
Add beef, chilli flakes (if using) and measure of spices and cook for 5-6 mins, stirring, until beef is browned.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Add beans, corn, tomato paste, canned tomatoes, tomato sauce, and stock to pan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low-medium and cook for about 15 mins, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill bowls with rice.
Top with chilli, cheese, spring onion, sour cream and sweet chilli.
Yum!
Don't have sweet chilli sauce?
Just use tomato sauce or relish instead or simply leave it out!

recipes.name: Beef Chilli Con Carne Pie
recipes.description: A hearty pie filled with a rich beef chili con carne mixture, topped with a golden puff pastry crust, and served with a charred corn salad for a comforting and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Start It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Set aside a baking dish.
Dice onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook onion, carrot and beef for about 8 mins, until browned.
Add salt measure, measure of spices and tomato paste and cook for 1-2 mins more, until fragrant.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Drain and rinse beans.
Add to pan along with canned tomatoes and stock.
Crush tomatoes with a fork and bring to a boil.
Simmer for a further 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Transfer chilli to baking dish.
Grate cheese if needed.
Sprinkle over chilli.
Unroll pastry onto a flat surface and lightly score with a sharp knife.
Place over top of filling and bake for 15-20 mins, until pastry is puffed and golden.
Want pastry to be golden and shiny?
Simply brush over the pastry with egg wash.
Wipe pan clean and reserve.

instructions.heading: Char It
instructions.text: Heat oil in reserved pan on high.
Drain corn, add to pan and cook for about 8 mins, until charred.
Set aside to cool.
Chop lettuce.
Just before serving, toss lettuce, corn and vinegar together in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Divide pie between plates.
Serve with salad, sour cream and a pinch of chilli flakes (if using).
Enjoy!

Tip If you want your pastry to be golden and shiny, simply brush over the pastry with egg wash. taco 'bout flavour Mexican spices smoked paprika, ground cumin, garlic powder, cornflour, sugar, vegan beef-style stock powder, ground coriander, tomato powder, onion powder, cocoa powder, chilli powder

recipes.name: Beef Cottage Pie
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring a rich beef filling topped with a creamy mashed topping of pumpkin and kumara, seasoned with classic cottage pie spices.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Bring a medium pot (with a lid) of salted water to the boil.
Set aside a medium casserole dish (measuring about 24 x 18cm).
Dice pumpkin and kumara 2cm; finely dice onion and celery.
Cook pumpkin and kumara in pot of boiling water, covered, for 12-15 minutes, until very soft.
Drain and return to pot with butter and milk and mash until smooth.
Season to taste.
While pumpkin and kumara cook, heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and celery for 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add beef and cook for 5-6 minutes, breaking up mince, until browned.
Add flour and cottage spices, and cook a further 1-2 minutes, until fragrant..
Add tomato paste, stock, Worcestershire/soy sauce and salt.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 8 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste and pour into casserole dish.
Spoon topping over mince filling and smooth out evenly.
Drag a fork over to create a pattern (if desired) and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for about 15 minutes, until topping is golden.
While pie is cooking, bring a small pot of water to the boil.
Cook peas in pot of boiling water for 2-3 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain.
To serve, spoon cottage pie onto plates and serve peas on the side.

recipes.name: Beef Lasagne
recipes.description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring layers of pasta, a rich beef and tomato filling, and a creamy cheese topping, perfect for a hearty and comforting meal.

instructions.text: PREHEAT oven to 200°C.
Set aside a baking dish (about 25 x 35cm).

instructions.heading: Make Filling
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and grate carrots.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook onion and carrots for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add lasagne herbs, salt and beef and cook for about 8 minutes, stirring, until browned.
Add tomato paste, canned tomatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 6-7 minutes, until slightly thickened and reduced.

instructions.heading: Make Topping
instructions.text: Melt butter in a small pot on medium heat.
Add flour and salt and cook, stirring constantly for 1-2 minutes.
Whisk in milk, 1½ cup at a time, until smooth.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for about 1 minute, until slightly thickened, Season and stir through spinach.

instructions.heading: Assemble Lasagne
instructions.text: Spoon half the filling into the baking dish and spread out evenly.
Top with 4 lasagne sheets and repeat with remaining filling and lasagne sheets.
Pour over topping and sprinkle with cheese.
BAKE for 25-30 minutes, until pasta is tender and cheese is golden brown.
Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions.heading: Cook Broccoli
instructions.text: Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil and cut broccoli into small florets and thinly slice stalk.
Cook broccoli in pot of boiling water for about 4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain and return to pot with garlic and butter and season.
TO SERVE, divide beef lasagne between plates and serve broccoli on the side.

recipes.name: Beef Peanut Satay & Coconut Rice with Bok Choy Salad
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring tender beef marinated in a rich peanut satay sauce, served over creamy coconut rice and accompanied by a fresh bok choy salad. This meal combines savory, nutty, and slightly sweet flavors with a refreshing crunch.

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Combine rice, coconut milk, water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, stir and cover with a lid.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 20 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 10 mins.
Once cooked, fluff up grains with a fork to combine coconut fat back into rice.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Add beef, curry paste and peanut butter and cook for 5-7 mins, until browned.
Add soy sauce, second measure of coconut milk and stock and bring to a simmer.
Reduce to medium heat and simmer for 2-3 mins, until thick.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Chop It
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy and capsicum.
Grate carrot.
Toss all in a bowl with vinegar and sweet chilli.
Season with salt.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Pile rice onto plates.
Spoon over beef satay.
Don't forget the salad!

recipes.name: Beef Quesadillas
recipes.description: Flavorful beef quesadillas filled with a savory beef mixture, mushrooms, and cheese, served with a fresh salad and a tangy sweet chili sauce. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Set aside two large oven trays.
Finely dice onion.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook onion for about 3 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add first measure of garlic (if using), beef, quesadilla spices, salt and chilli flakes (if using) to pan and cook for 5-6 minutes, breaking mince up as it cooks, until browned.
Add tomato paste, stock and corn, bring to a simmer and cook for 4-5 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste.
While beef is cooking, drain and rinse beans.
Place all bean smash ingredients (except oil) in a small pot on low-medium heat.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 3-4 minutes, until warmed through.
Add oil and mash with a potato masher or fork until smooth.
Thinly slice mushrooms.
Place a tortilla on the bench and spread with some bean smash.
Spoon 1/3-1/2 cup of the beef onto one side.
Sprinkle with mushrooms and cheese, drizzle with sweet chilli/BBQ sauce and fold over to close.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Place 3 quesadillas onto each tray.
Brush with a little oil and grill first tray for about 2 minutes each side, until golden and crispy.
Move to bottom rack and grill second batch.
While quesadillas are cooking, shred lettuce until you have 3 cups worth and grate carrot.
Toss in a bowl together with a little oil and vinegar.
To serve, cut quesadillas into wedges and dollop with sour cream and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce.
Place in the centre of the table with salad for everyone to help themselves.

recipes.name: Beef Rissoles
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful meal featuring crispy beef rissoles, golden roasted potato wedges, and a fresh broccoli and tomato salad, all served with a zesty tomato sauce and mayo.

instructions.heading: Cook Wedges
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat BBQ grill or hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Cut potatoes into wedges, season and toss with a little oil on a lined oven tray.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, until golden and tender.
PREP & COOK BEEF RISSOLES.
Grate carrot and add to bowl with all beef rissole ingredients.
Mix well.
Scoop out ¼ cup amounts and shape into 2cm thick rissoles.
Heat a little oil in a large fry- pan on medium heat and cook rissoles, in batches, for about 5 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Alternatively, cook beef rissoles on BBQ.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad & Sauce
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into florets and place in a heat-proof bowl.
Cover with boiling water and leave for 5 minutes before draining.
Refresh under cold water and return to bowl.
Slice tomato into wedges and crumble feta.
Add to bowl with a drizzle of red wine vinegar and oil and season to taste.
Mix mayo and tomatoes sauce together in a small bowl.
SERVE beef rissoles, wedges and salad with sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Sloppy Joe Stuffed Potatoes
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring baked potatoes stuffed with a savory beef mixture, cheddar cheese, and topped with BBQ sauce for a delicious twist on classic comfort food.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Tear a square of foil for each potato.
Place foil on the bench and place a potato on each, season with salt and drizzle with oil.
Wrap potatoes, place on an oven tray and bake on lower rack for 40-45 mins, until tender.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: While potatoes cook, heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook beef with measure of spices and salt measure for about 7 mins, until browned.
Add passata, tomato sauce and chilli flakes (if using) and simmer for about 5 mins, until slightly reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of salted water to boil.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add broccoli to pot of boiling water and cook 3 mins, until bright green and tender.
Drain and season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Grate cheese.
When potatoes have cooked, cut a cross on top of each potato, squeeze the sides and top each potato with beef and cheese.
Return potatoes to oven and cook for about 3 mins, until cheese has melted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Dollop potatoes with BBQ sauce.
Don't forget to serve broccoli on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: BEST BEEF BOLOGNESE
recipes.description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring tender beef simmered in a rich tomato-based sauce with aromatic herbs, served over spaghetti and topped with feta cheese for a creamy finish.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Finely dice onion and capsicum; grate carrot and mushrooms, then roughly chop so no large pieces remain; roughly chop spinach.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large pot or fry- pan on high heat.
Cook onion, garlic, capsicum, carrot and mushrooms for about 7 minutes, until browned and softened.
Stir occasionally.
Add Bolognese herbs, tomato paste, salt and beef and cook for about 7 minutes, until browned.
Add canned tomatoes, stock and soy sauce to pan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and cook for about 8 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Stir spinach through sauce and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Cook Pasta
instructions.text: Cook spaghetti in pot of boiling water for 8-10 minutes, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot and toss with a little oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide spaghetti between bowls, top with Bolognese and sprinkle with cheese.

recipes.name: Best Ever Crispy Chicken Drums
recipes.description: A delicious meal featuring perfectly crispy chicken drumsticks, served with a side of creamy coleslaw and garlic bread, offering a satisfying and flavorful dinner experience.

instructions.text: Preheat BBQ to medium-high or preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Mix measure of spices, salt measure and flour in a medium bowl.
Pat chicken dry, add to bowl and toss to coat.
Drizzle with oil and cook on the BBQ grill for 30-35 mins, turning every 5 mins until cooked through (if the chicken is burning before cooking through, pop the BBQ lid on).
Alternatively, place chicken on a lined oven tray, drizzle with oil and bake for 30-35 mins, until golden and cooked through, turning once.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Place butter in a small bowl and soften in the microwave for 10-15 secs.
Mince garlic and mix into butter.
Slice loaf in 2cm intervals, leaving a hinge at the bottom.
Slather butter into the slices and wrap in foil.
Heat on BBQ hotplate for 4-6 mins each side, until hot through.

instructions.heading: Sear It
instructions.text: Drain corn.
Cook corn with oil in a medium frypan on medium-high for 5-8 mins, until charred.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Toss slaw, mayonnaise and vinegar together in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken with corn, garlic bread and coleslaw as sides.
Grab a drumstick and get stuck in!
If the chicken is burning before cooking through, pop the BBQ lid on.

recipes.name: Bombay Chicken Curry
recipes.description: A flavorful Indian-inspired curry featuring chicken, pumpkin, and aromatic spices, served with basmati rice for a comforting and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a tight-fitting lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: No Peeking
instructions.text: Dice onion and pumpkin 1-2cm.
Pat chicken dry, dice 2cm and season.
While rice is cooking, heat a little oil in a large, deep fry-pan on high heat.
Cook onion, pumpkin and chicken for 5-6 minutes, until onion is browned.
Add tomato paste, salt, Bombay spices and chilli flakes (if using) and cook, stirring, for a further 1 minute until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and stock/water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for about 15 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Grate courgette and add to curry, along with vinegar and spinach.
Stir and season to taste.
To serve, spoon rice onto plates and top with Bombay chicken curry.

recipes.name: Braised Beef 'N' Green Smash
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender braised beef served over a creamy green mash made with potatoes, parsnips, broccoli, and peas, all topped with a rich sauce.

instructions.heading: Cook Beef
instructions.text: Bring two large pots of water (one salted) to the boil.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Place packet of beef, still sealed, into unsalted pot of boiling water, bring to a simmer, reduce to low-medium and cook for about 25 minutes.
Remove from water and set aside (in bag).
Drain pot, refill with boiling water from the kettle and bring to the boil.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Smash
instructions.text: Dice potatoes and parsnips 2-3cm.
Add to second pot of boiling water (salted) and cook for 15-18 minutes, until soft.
Cut broccoli into small florets and roughly chop.
When potatoes and parsnips are soft, add broccoli and peas to pot and cook for a further 4 minutes, until tender.
Drain, return to pot, cover and set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Carrots
instructions.text: Cut carrots in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cook carrots in pot of boiling water for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Drain and return to pot, cover and set aside.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Add second measure of butter to a small pot on medium heat.
When melted, whisk in a pinch of salt and flour and cook for about 1 minute.
Add milk and mustard and cook for 5-7 minutes, whisking until thickened.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Smash
instructions.text: Add all remaining smash ingredients to pot with drained potatoes, and roughly mash.
Season to taste.
Carefully drain beef and thinly slice.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon smash onto plates, top with braised beef, carrots and sauce.

recipes.name: Butterflied Lamb Leg with Greek Salad & Buttered Potatoes
recipes.description: A succulent butterflied lamb leg served with a refreshing Greek salad and creamy buttered potatoes, perfect for a hearty and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Preheat BBQ to medium, if using.
Dice potatoes 3cm.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Remove lid, then drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain well and return to pot.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pat lamb dry and season with salt and pepper.
Toss with oil and measure of spices.
Cook on BBQ for 7-8 mins each side for medium (depending on thickness), or until cooked to your liking.
Cover and rest before thinly slicing to serve.
Alternatively, use same method to cook lamb with a drizzle of oil in a frypan.
Dice cucumber and capsicum.
Toss in a bowl with spinach and dressing.
Crumble feta into a second bowl and whip with milk until smooth.
Plate up potatoes with slices of lamb.
Add salad and a dollop of feta dip on the side.

recipes.name: Cacciatore Spices with Vienna Loaf (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Grate carrot and cut mushrooms into quarters.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken and carrot with a pinch of salt for about 4 mins, until browned.
Add mushrooms, tomato paste and measure of spices.
Cook for another 2 mins, until fragrant.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Add tomato passata, salt and stock measure.
Bring to a boil and simmer for a further 3-4 mins, until thickened and cooked through.
Stir through spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut loaf in half horizontally.
Spread butter equally between both sides and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Place on an oven tray and grill for 2-3 mins or until golden.
Slice bread into dippers for serve.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon cacciatore into bowls.
Serve with bread dippers.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Cajun Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring crispy chicken thighs seasoned with Cajun spices, served with tender potatoes and a fresh salad, all drizzled with a creamy yogurt and mayo-based sauce.

instructions.text: 1. PREP & COOK POTATOES.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Dice potatoes 3cm, add to a medium pot with a pinch of salt and cover with hot water.
Cook for 20-25 minutes on high heat with the lid on, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with butter and season to taste.
2. PREP & COOK CHICKEN.
Pat chicken dry.
Add to a bowl with a drizzle of oil, a pinch of salt, first measure of Cajun spices and chilli flakes.
Toss to coat.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook chicken for about 6 minutes each side (depending on thickness), until cooked through.
Cover and rest for a few minutes before slicing thickly.
Alternatively, cook chicken on BBQ hot plate.
3. PREP SALAD & SAUCE.
Tear lettuce into bite sized pieces, dice cucumber and capsicum 1cm and crumble feta.
Toss all in a large bowl with a drizzle of oil and vinegar and season to taste.
In a small bowl, combine yoghurt, mayo and remaining Cajun spices.
4. SERVE potatoes topped with chicken and serve salad on the side.
Drizzle with sauce.

recipes.name: Cheat's Open Lamb Pie with Peas & Feta
recipes.description: A comforting and easy-to-make open pie featuring a savory lamb filling, fresh peas, crumbled feta, and a golden pastry top, perfect for a hearty meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (or 180°C fan bake).
Boil a pot of salted water.
Unroll pastry onto a flat surface and cut into rectangles (S2: 4 rectangles, S4: 6 rectangles, S6: 9 rectangles).
Place onto a lined oven tray.
Bake for about 15 mins, until puffed and golden.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Add lamb and carrot cook for about 7 minutes, until browned.
Add salt measure, flour and measure of spices and cook for about 1 min, until fragrant.
Add stock, tomato sauce and soy sauce.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cook peas in pot of boiling water for about 3 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with spinach.
Crumble in feta.
Mix to combine and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve up lamb and top with pastry lids.
Serve greens on the side.
Grab a fork and enjoy!

recipes.name: Cheeky Chicken Parma
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful meal featuring crispy chicken topped with a rich tomato sauce, melted cheese, and served with steamed vegetables and brown rice. The dish combines savory and slightly sweet flavors, making it a satisfying and comforting dinner option.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken & Sauce
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Season.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook chicken for about 2 minutes each side, until golden but not cooked through.
Transfer to a medium baking dish in single layer.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Return pan to medium-high heat with a little more oil and cook onion, carrot and salt for about 4 minutes, until soft.
Add tomato paste and Parma herbs and cook, stirring, for a further 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes, stock and sugar, bring to a simmer and cook for about 3 minutes, until thickened.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Bake Chicken
instructions.text: Top chicken with sauce, sprinkle with cheese and place on middle oven rack to cook for 7 minutes.
Switch oven to high grill and grill for 3-5 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and cheese is golden.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets and slice courgette 0.5cm.
Wipe pan clean and return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil.
Cook broccoli and courgette for about 3 minutes.
Add butter and almonds and cook for 1-2 minutes further, until veggies are tender, and almonds are toasted.
Season to taste.
SERVE rice topped with cheeky chicken Parma and veggies on the side.

recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken Drum Traybake
recipes.description: A comforting one-pot meal featuring crispy chicken drumsticks baked with a cheesy sauce and served with a side of roasted vegetables and smoked garlic aioli.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm.
Place on lined oven tray.
Pat chicken dry and add to tray with potatoes.
Toss with measure of spices and a drizzle of oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake on upper rack for about 30 mins, until nice and brown and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, cut broccoli into florets.
Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cut onion into quarters.
On a second lined oven tray, toss all vegetables with a drizzle of oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake on lower rack for about 20 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Remove trays from oven and switch oven to high grill.
Sprinkle Parmesan over potatoes and chicken.
Grill for 3 mins, until cheese is browned and melt.
Keep roasted veggie tray warm while chicken and potatoes are grilling.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Dish up chicken, potatoes and veggies with smoked garlic aioli and tomato sauce on the side.
The chicken juices from the tray have loads of flavour - don't forget to drizzle over your meal when serving.

recipes.name: Cheesy Mexi Bean Enchiladas with Sour Cream
recipes.description: A comforting and flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring soft tortillas filled with a hearty bean mixture, topped with a rich cheese sauce, and served with a dollop of sour cream for a tangy finish.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Grease a baking dish.
Drain and rinse beans.
Dice onion.
Mince garlic and drain corn.
Grate cheese if required.
Roughly chop spinach and set all aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion with measure of spices for about 2 mins, until softened and fragrant.
Add garlic and corn and cook a further 2-3 mins.
Add remaining filling ingredients to pan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and cook for about 8 mins, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Roll It
instructions.text: Lay out tortillas on a flat surface.
Divide filling between tortillas.
Roll up tortillas and place into baking dish.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Return pan to medium heat.
Add passata and first measure of chipotle sauce and cook for 2 mins.
The chipotle sauce packs a punch, so add more or less depending on your spice preference.
Stir through spinach and season with salt and pepper.
Pour over tortillas and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in oven for about 15 mins, until cheese is golden.
Allow to cool for a few minutes before serving.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top enchiladas with sour cream and remaining chipotle sauce.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Cheesy Mexi Chicken Loaded Wedges
recipes.description: A savory and indulgent dish featuring golden wedges topped with melted cheese, chicken, black beans, and a spicy kick, served with a side of sour cream for dipping.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with first measure of spices and oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, grate carrot.
Drain and rinse beans.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Set aside to rest and save pan.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Return pan to heat with oil.
Cook carrot, second measure of spices and chilli flakes for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add stock, beans and canned tomatoes.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Top It
instructions.text: Chop tomato.
Grate cheese.
Roughly chop cooked chicken.
When wedges are cooked, remove from oven.
Top with beans, chicken, tomato and cheese.
Return tray to oven for about 3 mins, until cheese is melted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Portion wedges topped with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Cheesy Mexi Chicken Loaded Wedges with Sour Cream
recipes.description: A savory and indulgent dish featuring crispy potato wedges loaded with melted cheese, chicken, black beans, and a spicy kick, served with a tangy sour cream dip.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with first measure of spices and oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, grate carrot.
Drain and rinse beans.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Set aside to rest and save pan.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Return pan to heat with oil.
Cook carrot, second measure of spices and chilli flakes for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add stock, beans and canned tomatoes.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Top It
instructions.text: Chop tomato.
Roughly chop cooked chicken.
When wedges are cooked, remove from oven.
Top with beans, chicken, tomato and cheese.
Return tray to oven for about 3 mins, until cheese is melted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Portion wedges topped with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Cheesy Potato Topped Chicken Pie with Greens
recipes.description: A comforting and hearty chicken pie topped with a creamy cheese sauce and crispy potato slices, served with fresh greens for a balanced meal.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Set aside a baking dish.
Cut potatoes into thick chips and cook in pot of boiling water for 10 mins, until just soft (the point of a knife will slide in easily).
Drain well and return to pot.
Grate cheese.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Cut leek in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Pat chicken dry and dice into 2cm pieces.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium heat and cook chicken for about 2 mins.
Add leek and salt measure and cook for about 5 mins, until softened.
Add butter and cook for about 1 min, until melted.
Add flour and measure of spices and cook for 1-2 mins, until fragrant.
Add milk, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring until sauce is smooth and combined.
Season to taste with pepper.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Transfer mix into baking dish.
Top with a layer of chips, season with a little salt and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in oven for about 15 mins, until cheese is melted and golden and chicken is cooked through.
Switch oven to high grill for final 2 mins cook time for an extra golden top.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: While pie is baking, bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook peas for about 3 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate chicken pie with peas on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Chicken 'n' Avo Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing and hearty salad featuring grilled chicken, creamy avocado, crisp lettuce, and a zesty lemon-mayo dressing, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Croutons
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Dice bread 2cm and toss on a lined oven tray with first measure of garlic and a little oil.
Season and bake for about 10 minutes, until golden and crunchy.
2. PREP CHICKEN.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Season and toss with lemon zest, juice, chilli flakes, oil and second measure of garlic.
3. PREP DRESSING & SALAD.
Mix all dressing ingredients together in a large bowl.
Roughly chop lettuce; thinly slice avocado and shallot, Cut courgette in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Add to a heat proof bowl, cover with boiling water and leave for 5 minutes before draining, Refresh under cold water and drain again.
4. COOK CHICKEN.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook chicken for 3-5 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Cover and rest for a few minutes before slicing thinly.
Alternatively, cook chicken and croutons on the BBQ hot plate.
5. FINISH SALAD.
Toss everything together in large bowl and season to taste.
6. SERVE chicken 'n' avo salad in bowls.

recipes.name: Chicken Breast with Chicken Or Veggie Stock (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Curry
instructions.text: Thinly slice onion; cut carrots in half lengthways and thinly slice; cut broccoli into small florets and thinly slice bok choy.
Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
Set aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook Curry
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan or pot on medium-high heat and cook onion for 3-4 minutes, until soft.
Add chicken, curry paste and chilli flakes and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in coconut milk, stock and carrots and bring to the boil.
Reduce heat to low-medium and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add broccoli, cover and simmer for about 3 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Stir through bok choy, soy sauce, sugar, fish sauce and vinegar and cook a further 1 minute.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Top rice with curry and sprinkle with peanuts.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: A hearty Italian-inspired dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich tomato-based sauce with herbs, vegetables, and Parmesan cheese, served over rice.

instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a tight-fitting lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: No Peeking
instructions.text: Finely dice onion.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Cook onion for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Add garlic (if using), salt and chicken and cook for about 5 minutes, until chicken is lightly browned.
Reduce heat to medium-high, add tomato paste and cacciatore herbs.
Cook tomato paste and herbs for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for about 10 minutes, until sauce has reduced and thickened.
While cacciatore is simmering, thinly slice capsicum and grate courgette.
When sauce has thickened, stir through capsicum, courgette and spinach and cook for a further 1-2 minutes, until warmed through.
Season to taste.
To serve, spoon rice into large bowls.
Top with chicken cacciatore and sprinkle with Parmesan.

recipes.name: Chicken Chilli 'n' Tortilla Chips
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty dish featuring crispy tortilla chips topped with a rich chicken chili made with vegetables, beans, and a blend of spices, served with a dollop of sour cream and sweet chili sauce.

instructions.text: PREP & COOK TORTILLA CHIPS.
Preheat oven to 220°C.
Cut each tortilla into 8 wedges and arrange tortillas on two lined oven trays in an even layer.
Drizzle with a little oil and bake for 8-10 minutes, until crispy and toasted.
Switch trays halfway to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Chilli
instructions.text: Finely dice onion, grate carrots and courgette.
Pat chicken dry and dice 1-2cm.

instructions.heading: Cook Chilli
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook onion and carrots for about 4 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add chicken, chicken chilli spices and salt and cook for 4-5 minutes, until chicken is white all over.
Stir occasionally.
Add stock, beans, sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce and bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and cook for 5-6 minutes, until sauce is thickened and reduced and chicken is cooked through.
Add courgette and spinach to chilli and cook a further 1 minute, until spinach is wilted.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide tortilla chips between plates.
Top with chicken chilli and dollop with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry 'N' Noodles
recipes.description: A flavorful chicken curry served over vermicelli noodles, featuring a rich coconut milk-based sauce with vegetables like broccoli, capsicum, and bok choy, topped with roasted peanuts and a lemon wedge for a zesty finish.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken & Veggies
instructions.text: Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
Toss in a bowl with curry spices, chilli flakes, a pinch of salt and a drizzle of oil.
Finely dice broccoli and thinly slice capsicum and bok choy.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken & Veggies
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in large, deep fry-pan or pot on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally until starting to brown on all sides.
Add broccoli, capsicum, coconut milk, stock, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce and bring to a simmer.
Scrape any brownings from bottom of pan and cook for about 5 minutes, until chicken is cooked, and sauce is slightly thickened and reduced.
Season to taste and stir through bok choy.

instructions.heading: Cook Vermicelli
instructions.text: Place vermicelli in a heat-proof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Leave to soak for 5 minutes before draining.
Snip noodles with scissors and toss with spinach and a little oil to prevent sticking.
Cut lemon into wedges.
SERVE vermicelli topped with curry, peanuts and a lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Chicken Drums 'N' Poutine
recipes.description: A comforting dish featuring crispy chicken drumsticks paired with golden fries, topped with a rich cheese gravy, and served with a side of steamed vegetables.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line two oven trays with baking paper (one with a lip).
Toss chicken with a little oil and first measure of chicken spices on first prepared tray (with a lip) and season.
Roast for about 40 minutes, until cooked through.
Turn once during cooking.
Allow to rest for about 5 minutes before serving.
Cut potatoes into 1cm chips.
Toss chips on second prepared tray with a little oil, season and roast (on rack below chicken) for about 40 minutes, until golden and tender.
Turn once during cooking, CRISPY.
Cut broccoli into small florets and thinly slice stalk and dice courgette 2cm.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil, When chicken has about 5 minutes cook time remaining, make gravy, Melt butter in a small pot on medium heat.
Add flour and second measure of chicken spices and cook, stirring for about 2 minutes, until sandy in texture.
Add stock, a little at a time, whisking until smooth and thickened.
Set aside, covered, to keep warm.
When chicken is resting, cook broccoli, courgette and peas in pot of boiling water for 3-4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Add any chicken resting juices to gravy, return to medium heat and bring to a simmer.
Once simmering, remove from heat and season to taste.
To serve, divide chips between plates and dot with small amounts of cream cheese.
Serve chicken and veggies on the side and spoon gravy over the chicken and chips.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring tender chicken, sautéed vegetables, and a spicy fajita seasoning, served in warm tortillas with fresh toppings.

instructions.text: 1. PREP VEGGIES & CHICKEN.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Thinly slice capsicum, drain and rinse beans and grate carrot.
Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
2. HEAT WRAPS.
Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven for about 20 minutes, until warmed through.
3. COOK VEGGIES.
Heat a little oil in a large fry- pan on medium-high heat and cook capsicums, corn and fajita spices for about 4 minutes, until softened.
Add beans, garlic, soy sauce, chilli flakes, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce and cook a further 1 minute, Transfer to a bowl and season to taste.
4. COOK CHICKEN.
Wipe pan clean and return to heat with a little more oil.
Toss chicken in a bowl with fajita flour and salt.
Shake off excess flour and cook chicken for 6-8 minutes, turning to cook on all sides until golden and cooked through.
Alternatively, cook chicken, veggies and tortillas on BBQ hot plate.
5. SERVE tortillas filled with spinach, carrot, veggie mix, chicken, sour cream and sweet chilli/hot sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
recipes.description: A vibrant and flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring stir-fried rice noodles, chicken, vegetables, and a savory Pad Thai sauce. This dish is known for its bold mix of sweet, sour, and savory flavors, making it a satisfying and aromatic meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Cut mushrooms into quarters, grate carrot; cut lemon into wedges.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.

instructions.heading: Cook Noodles
instructions.text: Place noodles in a large, heat- proof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Stir well to separate strands, cover and leave to soak for 7-8 minutes.
Drain and return to bowl with a drizzle of oil to prevent sticking.
Cut noodles in places with scissors to make noodles easier to eat.

instructions.heading: Cook Eggs
instructions.text: In a small bowl, lightly whisk eggs together with a pinch of salt.
Heat a little oil in a large, non-stick fry-pan on medium-high heat, add eggs to pan and tilt to spread out evenly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until set as an omelette.
Fold in half with a spatula, remove from pan and set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce & Chicken
instructions.text: In a small bowl, mix together all Pad Thai sauce ingredients.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Wipe pan clean and return to medium-high heat with a little oil.
Cook chicken for 2-3 minutes, add mushrooms and carrot and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add sauce to pan with chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Add mung bean sprouts, spinach and cooked noodles and cook for a further 2-3 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Slice omelette into thin strips and gently toss through dish.
Divide chicken Pad Thai between plates and top with roasted peanuts and a lemon wedge.
Season to taste, with soy sauce.

recipes.name: CHILLI BEEF WEDGES
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring crispy potato wedges topped with a rich beef chili mixture, fresh spinach, Mexican tomato salsa, and dollops of sour cream. Perfect for a satisfying and comforting meal.

instructions.text: 1. Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line a lipped oven tray or large baking dish with baking paper.
2. Cut potatoes into 1cm wedges.
Toss with a little oil on prepared tray and season.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Turn once during cooking.
3. Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Grate carrots and add to pan along with chilli beef spices, chilli flakes (if using) and salt and cook for about 2 minutes, until carrot is soft.
Add beef and cook a further 6-7 minutes, breaking up as it cooks, until browned.
4. Add stock, canned tomatoes and chilli beans to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook on medium heat for 10-12 minutes, or until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste.
5. When potatoes are cooked, remove from oven and switch oven to high grill.
Spoon beef chilli evenly over potatoes, crumble over feta and return to oven to grill for about 3 minutes, until feta is warmed through.
6. To serve, top wedges with spinach, Mexican tomato salsa and dollops of sour cream.

recipes.name: Chimichurri Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful chicken dish marinated in chimichurri, served with a zesty dressing, fresh salad, and fluffy basmati rice. The dish combines bold South American flavors with a fresh, vibrant twist.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium (if using).
Combine rice and stock/water in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
Stir butter through when finished steaming.

instructions.heading: Make Mayo
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine first measure of chimichurri and mayo.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Season and rub with a little oil and remaining chimichurri.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat and cook chicken for 3-5 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Set aside, covered, to rest.
Alternatively, cook chicken on BBQ hot plate.

instructions.heading: Prep Dressing
instructions.text: Whisk all dressing ingredients together in a large bowl.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Dice capsicum 1cm, cut cherry tomatoes in half and thinly slice spring onions.
When ready to serve, add to bowl with the dressing along with spinach, toss to combine and season to taste.
Slice chicken thinly and toss back through resting juices.
SERVE rice topped with salad, chicken and mayo.

recipes.name: Chinese-Style Sticky Chicken
recipes.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring tender chicken pieces coated in a glossy, sticky sauce, served with fluffy Jasmine rice and crunchy peanuts. This dish combines rich umami flavors with a hint of sweetness, perfect for a comforting meal.

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Fill kettle with boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Bring to the boil.
Heat and cook for 12 mins.
Leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Toss on a lined oven tray with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 10 minutes.
Slice bok choy.
After broccoli has had 10 minutes cook time, add bok choy and sesame oil to tray.
Cook for a further 5-7 minutes, until tender.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and dice 3cm.
Toss in a bowl with cornflour and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6-8 minutes (depending on thickness), or until cooked through, and golden.
Turn often to ensure even cooking.
Set aside in a medium bowl and reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Grate ginger.
Combine in a bowl with soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, honey, sesame oil and water measure.
Return pan to low-medium heat and cook sauce for about 2 minutes, until slightly reduced.
Return chicken and any resting juices to pan and toss to coat.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load bowls with rice with chicken, veggies, sauce and peanuts.

recipes.name: Chinese-Style Sticky Chicken with Jasmine Rice & Peanuts
recipes.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring tender chicken coated in a glossy, sticky sauce, served with fluffy Jasmine rice and crunchy peanuts. Perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Toss on a lined oven tray with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 10 minutes.
Slice bok choy.
After broccoli has had 10 minutes cook time, add bok choy and sesame oil to tray.
Cook for a further 5-7 minutes, until tender.
Pat chicken dry and dice 3cm.
Toss in a bowl with cornflour and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6-8 minutes (depending on thickness), or until cooked through and golden.
Turn often to ensure even cooking.
Set aside in a medium bowl and reserve pan.
Grate ginger.
Combine in a bowl with soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, honey, sesame oil and water measure.
Return pan to low-medium heat and cook sauce for about 2 minutes, until slightly reduced.
Return chicken and any resting juices to pan and toss to coat.
Load bowls with rice with chicken, veggies, sauce and peanuts.

recipes.name: Coconut Chicken Nuggets
recipes.description: A crispy and flavorful meal featuring breaded chicken nuggets coated in coconut, served with a side of steamed rice, stir-fried vegetables, and a drizzle of sweet chili sauce. The dish combines savory and sweet notes with a tropical twist.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine all rice ingredients in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, stir and cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 10 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Mix flour and salt together in a bowl, whisk egg and milk together in a second bowl, and mix breadcrumbs and coconut together in a third bowl.

instructions.heading: Crumb Chicken
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry, season and dice 2-3cm.
Add half the chicken to the flour and mix to coat.
Shake off excess and add to egg, mix to coat and add to breadcrumbs.
Mix to coat, shake off excess and repeat with remaining chicken.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry- pan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken, in two batches, for 6-8 minutes, turning to cook on all sides, until golden and cooked through.
Season and keep warm.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: While chicken cooks, cut carrots and courgette in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Trim ends from bok choy and thinly slice.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Wipe pan and return to high heat with a drizzle of oil.
Add carrots and cook for about 3 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add courgette and chilli flakes (if using) and cook a further 2 minutes, until veggies are tender.
Add bok choy and soy sauce, toss to combine then remove from heat.
TO SERVE, spoon rice onto plates, top with veggies, coconut chicken nuggets and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Coconut Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Rich and indulgent brownies infused with the flavors of coconut and chocolate, perfect for a sweet treat or dessert.

instructions.heading: Prep Brownie
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Line a baking dish (about 15x 20cm) with baking paper.
Melt butter in a small pot on medium heat and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Whisk in cocoa and cook a further 1-2 minutes then remove from heat.
Whisk in sugar, eggs, vanilla and coconut.
Sift in flour and baking powder and mix in until no lumps remain.
Pour into prepared dish.

instructions.heading: Bake Brownie
instructions.text: Bake for 15-20 minutes, until a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean.
Remove from oven and set aside for 5 minutes before removing from the tin.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Cut brownie into squares, dust with icing sugar and serve with fresh cream.

recipes.name: Coconut Curried Fish
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring fish cooked in a creamy coconut curry sauce, served with a fresh vegetable salad and peanuts for added crunch and nutrition.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Thinly slice cucumber and capsicum.
Peel carrot and courgette into ribbons.
Toss all salad ingredients in bowl.
Season to taste with salt.
Pat fish dry and remove any remaining scales or bones.
Cut any larger fillets in half.
Toss in a bowl with curry spices until evenly coated.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Fry fish for 2 mins on one side.
Flip over and add coconut milk.
Simmer for 2-3 mins further, until fish is cooked.
Gently stir through soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Season to taste with soy sauce.
Plate up your fish with rice and salad.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Coconut Curried Fish with Fresh Veg Salad & Peanuts
recipes.description: A flavorful coconut curry featuring pan-fried fish, served with a vibrant fresh vegetable salad and crunchy peanuts. This dish combines rich, creamy coconut flavors with a burst of fresh and nutty elements.

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Thinly slice cucumber and bok choy.
Peel carrot and courgette into ribbons.
Toss all salad ingredients in bowl.
Season to taste with salt.

instructions.heading: Cut It
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and remove any remaining scales or bones.
Cut any larger fillets in half.
Toss in a bowl with measure of spices until evenly coated.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Fry fish for 2 mins on one side.
Flip over and add coconut milk.
Simmer for 2-3 mins further, until fish is cooked.
Gently stir through soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Season to taste with soy sauce.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up your fish with rice and salad.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: CREAMY CHICKEN LINGUINE
recipes.description: A comforting and creamy pasta dish featuring tender chicken, vibrant vegetables, and a rich sauce made with sour cream, spinach, and lemon juice, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce & Pasta
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Finely dice onion, cut broccoli into small florets, pat chicken dry and slice into 1cm thick strips.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Season chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes, until golden.
Remove from pan and set aside.

instructions.heading: Cook Pasta
instructions.text: Add pasta to pot of boiling water for about 10 minutes, until tender.
Reserve 1½ cup pasta water, drain and return to pot with a little oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Cook Sauce
instructions.text: Return same fry-pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil (if needed).
Add onion and cook for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add garlic and linguine herbs and cook, stirring for a further 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add chicken and any resting juices, broccoli, stock and salt to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes.
Add peas and cook a further 2 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Remove from heat and stir through sour cream, spinach and lemon juice.
Pour chicken and sauce over pasta in pot, add first measure of cheese and stir through.
Season to taste.
If sauce is too thick, stir through reserved pasta water, a couple of tablespoons at a time until you reach desired consistency.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide creamy chicken linguine between bowls and sprinkle with remaining cheese.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Potato Salad with Tomato Feta Salsa
recipes.description: A creamy and refreshing potato salad featuring tender chicken, diced vegetables, and a zesty tomato feta salsa, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Dice potatoes 3cm.
Add potatoes to a pot, cover with hot tap water and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Remove lid, drop heat to medium and cook for about 15 mins, until just tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Set aside to cool.

instructions.heading: Poach It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Place in a pot with measure of spices, salt measure and measure of water.
Make sure chicken is submerged in water.
Cover with a lid and bring to a boil on medium heat.
Once boiling, turn off heat and leave, still covered, for 15 minutes.
The residual heat will cook chicken through.
After 15 minutes, remove chicken from poaching liquid.
When cool enough to handle, roughly shred chicken using two forks.

instructions.heading: Dice It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, thinly slice capsicum and set aside.
Dice tomato and cucumber.
Toss together in a bowl with vinegar.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Crumble over feta.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Add chicken to pot with potatoes and capsicum.
Toss with sour cream, mayo and mustard.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Stack up chicken and potatoes on plates.
Serve salsa on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Creamy Italian Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: A comforting and creamy pasta dish featuring tender chicken, fresh basil, and a rich sauce, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Coat with measure of spices and season with salt and pepper.
Dice onion.
Grate carrot.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Cook pasta in pot of boiling water for 8-10 mins, until tender.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Return pasta to pot with olive oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Brown It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Rest, covered, and reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in reserved pan on medium heat.
Cook onion and carrot for 3-4 mins, until softened.
Add stock and peas and cook for about 2-3 mins, until slightly reduced.
Remove from heat and add spinach, basil drizzle, sour cream and salt measure and stir to combine.
Roughly chop chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Add chicken, any resting juices and pasta to pan with a little reserved pasta water, if needed.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon pasta into bowls and top with Parmesan.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken
recipes.description: A comforting one-pot meal featuring tender chicken in a rich, creamy mushroom sauce, served with leeks and buttery potatoes for a hearty and satisfying dish.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Remove lid, then drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain well and return to pot with butter.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Thinly slice leek and mushrooms.
Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side, until golden and cooked though.
Set aside to rest for a few minutes and reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Return pan to medium-high heat with oil.
Cook leek, mushrooms and salt measure for about 5 mins, until softened.
Add measure of spices to pan and cook a further 1 min, until fragrant.
Add stock, sour cream, mustard and honey and reduce heat to low.
Cook for about 1 min, until warmed through.
Stir through spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Slice chicken thickly and add any resting juices to sauce.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Divide chicken between plates and top with sauce.
Serve potatoes on the side.
Soak up the goodness!

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken with Leek & Buttered Potatoes
recipes.description: A comforting one-pot meal featuring tender chicken in a rich, creamy mushroom and leek sauce, served with buttery potatoes for a hearty and satisfying dish.

instructions.text: Dice potatoes.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Remove lid, then drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain well and return to pot with butter.
Season with salt and pepper.
Thinly slice leek and mushrooms.
Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side, until golden and cooked though.
Set aside to rest for a few minutes and reserve pan.
Return pan to medium-high heat with oil.
Cook leek, mushrooms and salt measure for about 5 mins, until softened.
Add measure of spices to pan and cook a further 1 min, until fragrant.
Add stock, sour cream, mustard and honey and reduce heat to low.
Cook for about 1 min, until warmed through.
Stir through spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Slice chicken thickly and add any resting juices to sauce.
Divide chicken between plates and top with sauce.
Serve potatoes on the side.
Soak up the goodness!

recipes.name: Creamy Pulled Beef Stroganoff with Mash
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender beef in a rich, creamy sauce, served with a side of mashed potatoes. This meal combines savory flavors with a touch of sweetness from the sauce, making it perfect for a cozy dinner.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Finely dice onion.
Thinly slice carrot and mushrooms.
Set aside.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes and cook in pot of boiling water for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter.
Mash until smooth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high heat.
Cook onion, carrot and mushrooms for about 5 mins, until browned.
Reduce heat to medium, add measure of spices and cook for a further 1 min, stirring, until fragrant.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Add beef, stock, mustard and peas to pan, bring to a simmer and cook for about 3 mins, until sauce has thickened and beef and peas are hot through.
Stir through sour cream and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top mash with beef Stroganoff.

recipes.name: CREAMY TARRAGON CHICKEN
recipes.description: A comforting and flavorful dinner featuring tender chicken steaks served with a rich, creamy tarragon sauce and roasted potatoes. The dish combines earthy tarragon with savory mushrooms, leeks, and a hint of honey for a well-balanced and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot (with a lid) of salted water to the boil.
Dice potatoes 3-4cm.
Add potatoes to pot of boiling water, cover with a lid and cook for 16-18 minutes, until just tender.
Drain, return to pot with oil (if using), season and cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Yummy
instructions.text: While potatoes are cooking, thinly slice onion, white and pale green part of leek and mushrooms and set aside.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook chicken for 2-3 minutes each side, until golden and cooked though.
Set aside, covered, to rest while you make the sauce, Return pan to medium-high heat with a little more oil and cook onion, leek, mushrooms and salt for about 5 minutes, until softened.
Add tarragon mix and cook a further 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add water/stock, sour cream, mustard and honey and reduce heat to low.
Cook for about 1 minute, until warmed through.
Stir in spinach and season to taste.
Slice chicken thickly and add any resting juices to the sauce (if desired).
To serve, divide potatoes between plates and top with slices of chicken and tarragon sauce.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing salad featuring crispy chicken, tender buttered potatoes, and a creamy ranch dressing, perfect for a light and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of water.
Dice potatoes.
Add to pot of boiling water and cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain well and toss with butter.
Season with salt and pepper.
Set aside to cool, until ready to serve.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Add chicken to a bowl, along with measure of spices and flour, and toss to coat.
Add egg to same bowl, split the yolk and toss to coat chicken.
Place breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Place chicken into the crumbs, turn to coat each piece well and place on a plate/tray.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium.
Cook chicken for 4-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Peel carrot into ribbons.
Dice cucumber 1cm.
Place in a salad bowl.
Toss salad with first measure of ranch dressing and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Thickly slice chicken.
Top salad with potatoes, chicken and second measure of ranch dressing.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Crispy Crumbed Fish Fingers
recipes.description: A classic comfort food featuring golden, crispy fish fingers served with homemade chips and a side of smashed greens, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a pot of salted water.
Cut potatoes and carrot into chips.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays and spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.

instructions.heading: Coat It
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and cut into fingers, about 2cm wide.
Add to a bowl, along with flour and toss to coat.
Add egg and milk (S4 & S6 only) to same bowl.
Use a fork to split the egg yolk and toss to coat fish in mixture.
Place breadcrumbs and salt measure in a second bowl.
Place pieces of fish into the crumbs, turn to coat each piece well and place on a plate/tray.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Grate courgette.
Add courgette and peas to pot of boiling water.
Cook for 3-4 mins, or until soft.
Drain well, return to pot and roughly mash with butter.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium heat.
Cook fish, in batches, for 2-3 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until golden and just cooked through.
Wipe out pan between batches and add more oil, if needed.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate fish with chips, smashed greens and picklenaise.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Crispy Crumbed Fish Fingers with Chips & Broccoli Smash
recipes.description: A comforting and crispy meal featuring golden-breaded fish fingers served with a side of colorful chips and a creamy broccoli mash, perfect for a satisfying and family-friendly dinner.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a pot of salted water.
Cut potatoes and carrot into chips.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays and spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.

instructions.heading: Coat It
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and cut into fingers, about 2cm wide.
Add to a bowl, along with flour and toss to coat.
Add egg and milk (S4 & S6 only) to same bowl.
Use a fork to split the egg yolk and toss to coat fish in mixture.
Place breadcrumbs and salt measure in a second bowl.
Place pieces of fish into the crumbs, turn to coat each piece well and place on a plate/tray.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets and dice stalk.
Add broccoli and peas to pot of boiling water.
Cook for 6-8 mins, or until soft.
Drain well, return to pot and roughly mash with butter.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium heat.
Cook fish, in batches, for 2-3 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until golden and just cooked through.
Wipe out pan between batches and add more oil, if needed.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate fish with chips, broccoli smash and picklenaise.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Crispy Gnocchi & Beef Bolognese with Parmesan
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring crispy gnocchi paired with a rich beef bolognese sauce, topped with grated Parmesan cheese for a savory and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Finely dice onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion and carrot with a pinch of salt for about 3 mins, until browned and softened.
Add beef, measure of spices, and tomato paste, and cook for about 7 mins, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon.
Add canned tomatoes and stock to pan.
Bring to a simmer, drop heat to medium and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Stir through spinach, until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
While the beef is cooking, melt butter in a second frypan on medium-high.
Add gnocchi in a single layer and fry, tossing occasionally, for 6-8 mins, until golden and cooked through.
Add gnocchi to pan with beef and toss to coat.
Plate beef Bolognese gnocchi sprinkled with Parmesan.

recipes.name: CRUMBED CHICKEN
recipes.description: A comforting and satisfying meal featuring crispy crumbed chicken served with a creamy pumpkin and kumara mash, steamed broccoli, and a side of mayo for dipping.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot (with a lid) of salted water to the boil.
Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil.
Dice pumpkin 2cm; peel and dice kumara 2cm; dice carrots 1.5cm.
Cook pumpkin, kumara and carrots in large pot of boiling water for 18-20 minutes, until very soft.
Cover with lid and reduce heat if it boils over, Drain and return to pot with butter.
Mash until smooth and season to taste.
Set aside and cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Mmm Mash
instructions.text: While mash is cooking, pat chicken dry and cut into steaks, Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally, Season lightly with salt.
Mix flour and salt in a shallow bowl, whisk egg and milk in a second bowl and add breadcrumbs to a third bowl.
Coat chicken first in flour, then in egg mix, then in breadcrumbs, shaking off excess as you go.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken, in batches, for 3-4 minutes each side (depending on thickness), until browned and cooked through.
Wipe pan out between batches and add a little more oil as needed.
Set aside to rest for about 2 minutes, before slicing thickly.
Season.
While chicken is cooking, cut broccoli into small florets and cook in medium pot of boiling water for about 4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain and return to pot with a drizzle of olive oil, butter and garlic (if using).
Season to taste.
To serve, spoon mash onto plates with crumbed chicken and mayo for dipping.
Serve broccoli on the side,

recipes.name: Crunchy Baked Fish with Creamy Leek & Potato Mash
recipes.description: A comforting dish featuring crispy baked fish topped with a golden breadcrumb crust, served alongside a creamy mash of leeks and potatoes, perfect for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Set aside a baking dish.
Dice potatoes.
Place in a pot, cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with butter and milk.
Mash until smooth.
Stir through spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Cut leek in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Heat butter and oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook leek with measure of spices for about 5 mins, until tender.
Add salt and stock and simmer for about 3-4 mins, until slightly reduced.
Remove from heat and fold through sour cream.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and remove any remaining scales and bones.
Cut any larger fillets in half and place in baking dish.
Season with salt and pepper.
Pour sauce evenly over fish.
Zest lime and cut into wedges.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Combine lime zest, breadcrumbs, oil and salt measure in a small bowl.
Sprinkle over fish and sauce.
Bake for 8-10 mins, until fish is cooked through and breadcrumbs are golden.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top mash with fish.
Serve lime wedges on the side for squeezing.

recipes.name: DK Chicken Cheese Burgers
recipes.description: A hearty and indulgent burger featuring crispy chicken patties topped with melted cheese, fresh lettuce, and a creamy aioli, served with thick-cut potato chips for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes and carrot into thick chips and toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper and bake in the oven for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.

instructions.heading: Crumb It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Place chicken in a bowl with cornflour, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat.
Crack egg into same bowl and use a fork to toss until well coated.
Place breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Transfer chicken into bowl with crumbs, turn to coat each piece well and place on a plate/tray.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through and golden.
Remove from pan and rest on a wire rack to keep crispy.
Season with salt.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Cut rolls in half and set aside on a lined oven tray.
When chips are cooked, remove from oven and add rolls to oven to heat for 1-2 mins, until warmed through.
Slice cheese.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top base of rolls with chicken, cheese and lettuce.
Drizzle over aioli and top with roll lids.
Don't forget chips on the side!

recipes.name: Easy Beef Smash Burgers with Cheese & Pickle Mustard
recipes.description: A delicious and quick-to-prepare burger recipe featuring beef patties smashed to perfection, topped with melted cheese, crisp lettuce, juicy tomatoes, and a tangy pickle mustard sauce.

instructions.text: In a bowl, combine beef with measure of spices.
Season with salt and pepper and mix to combine.
Divide beef and roll into balls (S2: 3 balls, S4: 6 balls, S6: 9 balls).
Slice cheese.
Heat oil in a frypan on high heat.
Add beef to pan and flatten with a fish slice or the underside of a frypan, until they are just under 1cm thick.
Cook patties for 2-3 mins each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
In last 1 min of cook time, top patties with cheese and cook for 1 min, until cheese is melted.
Set aside, covered to keep warm.
Reserve frypan.
Cut buns in half.
Toast in reserved frypan, on high heat, for 1 min each side, until warmed through.
Shred lettuce.
Thinly slice tomato.
Build your burger!
Fill buns with mayo, patties, lettuce, tomato and pickle mustard.
Leftover fillings?
Serve on the side!

recipes.name: Fine Black Pepper with Egg Noodles (untitled scan)

instructions.text: If ramen isn't your thing, you can easily turn this dish into a stir-fry.
