Cook your pork and noodles the same way, before stir-frying the veggies with the spices and a little sweet chilli sauce instead.
1. COOK EGGS.
Bring a small pot of water and a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Once boiling, gently add eggs (with a slotted spoon) to the small pot.
Cook for about 6 minutes for soft-boiled or 10-12 minutes for hard-boiled.
Drain and refresh under cold water.
2. PREP & COOK PORK.
Pat pork dry, add to a medium bowl and mix with all remaining pork ingredients.
Heat a little oil in a large, deep fry-pan on medium heat.
Lift pork out of marinade and cook for about 3 minutes each side (depending on thickness), until just cooked through.
Set aside, covered to rest.
3. PREP VEGGIES.
Cut carrots in half lengthways, then thinly slice.
Thinly slice bok choy.
4. COOK BROTH.
Return same pan to medium-high heat with a little more oil (if needed) and cook carrots for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add corn and cook a further 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add broth spices, water, stock and soy sauce.
Bring to a simmer and remove from heat.
Stir in bok choy and season to taste with soy sauce.
5. COOK NOODLES.
Cook noodles in large pot of boiling water for about 5 minutes, stirring to separate noodles, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with a little oil, to prevent sticking.
Cover and set aside.
6. FINISH EGGS AND PORK.
Peel eggs and cut in half.
Thinly slice pork and add any resting juices to the broth.
7. TO SERVE.
Divide noodles between bowls, ladle over broth and veggies, then top with pork and eggs.

recipes.name: Fish Laksa
recipes.description: A flavorful Malaysian-inspired soup featuring tender fish fillets, vibrant vegetables, and a rich, creamy broth seasoned with aromatic laksa paste and coconut milk. Served with vermicelli noodles, this dish is a delightful fusion of spicy and savory flavors.

instructions.heading: Prep Fish & Veggies
instructions.text: Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Thinly slice onion; cut broccoli into small florets; thinly slice bok choy; pat fish dry, remove any scales or bones and cut into 3-4cm pieces.
Set all aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook Laksa
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large, deep fry- pan or pot (with a lid) on medium-high heat and cook onion for 3-4 minutes, until soft.
Add laksa paste and chilli flakes and cook, stirring for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Reduce heat to medium and add coconut milk and stock.
Bring to a simmer, add broccoli and fish, ensuring fish is submerged, then cover with lid and cook for 4-5 minutes, until broccoli is bright green and tender and fish is cooked through.

instructions.heading: Cook Noodles
instructions.text: While sauce is simmering, place noodles in a large, heat-proof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Cover and set aside to cook for 5 minutes.
Drain and return to bowl with a drizzle of sesame oil and cut noodles in places to make them easier to eat.

instructions.heading: Finish Laksa
instructions.text: Gently stir bok choy, spinach, soy sauce and fish sauce through laksa and season to taste with fish sauce and soy sauce or salt and pepper.
TO SERVE, divide noodles between bowls and top with fish laksa.

recipes.name: Fragrant Curry Stock Blend with Massaman Curry Paste (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Bring a kettle to the boil.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 mins.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 5 more mins.
Don't lift the lid during cooking.
Meanwhile, dice onion 1cm and carrot 2cm.
Thinly slice bok choy.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion, carrot and pumpkin with a pinch of salt for about 5 mins, until browned.
Add massaman curry paste, measure of spices and 1/4 cup coconut milk.
Add the curry paste to suit your spice preference.
If you want a mild curry, use half the amount specified.
If you like it a bit spicier, add an extra Tbsp.
Cook for 1-2 mins, until fragrant.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Add pulled beef, remaining coconut milk and water measure to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins.
Add bok choy and cook for a further 3 mins, until veggies are tender and sauce is thickened.
Stir through soy sauce and spinach and season to taste with sait and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top rice with curry.
Dig in!

recipes.name: French Onion Chicken
recipes.description: A comforting one-pot meal featuring tender chicken pieces baked with caramelized onions and melted cheese, served with creamy mashed potatoes and fresh greens.

instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm.
Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Cook on high heat for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Thinly slice onion.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and sugar with a pinch of salt for 8-10 mins, until soft and caramelised.
Transfer onion to a bowl and reserve pan.
Pat chicken dry and slice into 2cm strips.
Season with salt and pepper and toss with measure of spices and flour.
Grate cheese and set aside.
Return pan to medium-high heat with oil.
Cook chicken for about 2 mins on one side, until golden.
Turn chicken and return onion to pan along with beef stock.
Sprinkle with cheese and cook for about 5 mins, until chicken is cooked through and cheese is melted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Cut broccoli into florets and dice stalk.
Chop spinach.
Place broccoli in pot of boiling water and cook for 3 mins, until bright green and tender.
Drain, return to pot along with spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Top mash with chicken, greens and onions on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Fusion! 20-Min Tandoori Chicken Tacos with Coconut Slaw & Bombay Aioli
recipes.description: A fusion dish combining the bold flavors of tandoori chicken with the freshness of coconut slaw and a tangy Bombay aioli, served in soft tacos for a quick and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry.
Slice chicken 1cm thick.
Place in a bowl with tandoori paste.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss to coat well.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches if needed, for 3-5 mins each side until golden and cooked through.
Remove from pan and set aside, covered, to rest.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: In a salad bowl, mix vinegar, soy sauce and sweet chilli sauce.
Add slaw, spinach and coconut thread to bowl and toss to coat well.
Season to taste with soy sauce.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Place stack of tortillas on a plate and microwave for about 1 min to warm.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spread aioli on tortillas.
Fill with chicken and slaw.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Fusion! Crunchy 'Chicken Parmesan' Tacos
recipes.description: A creative twist on classic chicken parmesan, served in crispy tacos with a zesty salsa roja and fresh slaw, perfect for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to grill.
Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Toss with measure of spices and season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-4 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until almost cooked through.
Transfer chicken to baking dish and spread out in a single layer.
Sprinkle over breadcrumbs and Parmesan.
Grill in oven for about 3 mins, until browned.
Thinly slice chicken before serving.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Toss all slaw ingredients in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Heat It
instructions.text: Place stack of tortillas on a plate and microwave for about 1 min to warm.
Mix mayo and mustard in a bowl.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill tortillas with mustard mayo, slaw, chicken and smoky tomato sauce.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Garlic Bread-Topped Chicken Pot Pie with Parmesan
recipes.description: A comforting chicken pot pie topped with garlic bread and Parmesan cheese, perfect for a hearty and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
If you don't have an ovenproof frypan, set aside a baking dish.
Pat and dry chicken and dice 2cm.
Grate carrot.
Cut leek in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Heat oll in an ovenproof frypan on high.
Cook chicken with a pinch of salt for 3-4 mins, until browned.
Add leek and carrot for 5-7 mins, until softened.
Drop heat to medium-high.
Add butter, flour and measure of spices and cook, stirring, for about 2 mins, until fragrant.
Add milk, stock and peas, stirring until smooth and thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Transfer to baking dish, if using.
Meanwhile, mince garlic and mix in a bowl with a drizzle of olive oil Dice Vienna loaf 3cm and add to bowl.
Toss with a pinch of salt to combine.
Top chicken pot pie with bread topping in an even layer.
Sprinkle over Parmesan.
Bake in oven for about 5 mins, until golden.
Plate up chicken pot pie.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Glazed Pork Nuggets
recipes.description: A savory dish featuring crispy pork nuggets coated in a rich, glossy glaze, served over a bed of fluffy rice with a side of vegetables. The dish combines the flavors of savory pork, sweet glaze, and fresh vegetables for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Nuggets
instructions.text: Grate carrot and mix all nugget ingredients (except flour) in a medium bowl and season with pepper.
Shape 2-3 tablespoons of pork mixture into small nugget shaped patties, about 1.5cm thick.
Place flour in a small bowl and dip nuggets in flour to coat.

instructions.heading: Cook Nuggets
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook nuggets, in 2 batches, for 4-5 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Keep warm between batches, Mix nugget glaze and water together, FINISH RICE.
Thinly slice mushrooms.
Heat a little oil in a medium fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook mushrooms for about 2 minutes until starting to soften.
Add peas and stock and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for a further 1 minute, until spinach has wilted.
Add to cooked rice, mix to combine and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Glaze Nuggets
instructions.text: When second batch of nuggets are cooked, return first batch of to pan and pour over pork nugget glaze.
Turn off heat and let glaze bubble for 30-60 seconds, until glaze has thickened slightly and has coated nuggets.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Place vegetable rice onto plates and top with glazed pork nuggets.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring marinated chicken, served with a creamy potato mash and a fresh Greek salad, offering a burst of Mediterranean flavors.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Dice potatoes 2cm and cook in pot of boiling water for about 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter, mash until smooth and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Looks Good
instructions.text: While potatoes cook, pat chicken dry.
Combine in a bowl with oil, garlic (if using), lemon zest and juice, first measure of oregano, pepper, salt and flour.
Set aside to marinate.
Dice cucumber and tomatoes 1cm, thinly slice onion and dice or crumble feta.
Add all to a bowl with second measure of oregano (if using) and toss with oil and vinegar.
Season to taste and set aside.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken (and any marinade) for about 4-5 minutes each side, or until chicken is browned and cooked through.
To serve, divide mash between plates and top with Greek chicken.
Serve the Greek salad on the side.

recipes.name: Greek-Spiced Beef Flatbreads
recipes.description: A flavorful flatbread topped with spiced beef, fresh vegetables, and a tangy cucumber and honey yogurt sauce, perfect for a satisfying and healthy meal.

instructions.heading: Preheat It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Preheat 2 oven trays (or pizza stones if you have them).

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook beef, measure of spices, salt measure and chilli flakes (if using) or 5-6 mins, until browned.
Add tomato passata and honey.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 3-4 mins, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Thinly slice capsicum.
Grate cheese if needed.
Set aside separately.
Lay flatbreads out on a flat surface.
Divide cooked beef mix equally between breads and smooth out evenly to cover.
Sprinkle with capsicum and cheese.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Place flatbreads on oven tray.
Bake for about 14 mins, until bases are crispy and browned.
Switch tray positions halfway to ensure even cooking.
While baking, dice tomato and cucumber.
Toss in a bowl with vinegar and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Mix yoghurt and honey together in a small bowl.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top your flatbreads with cucumber, tomato and a drizzle of yoghurt.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Grilled Cajun Chicken Steaks with Creamy Avo Smash & Slaw
recipes.description: A flavorful dinner featuring grilled chicken steaks seasoned with Cajun spices, served with a creamy avocado mash and a fresh, colorful slaw. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ to medium-high, if using.
Dice potatoes 3cm and add to a pot.
Cover with hot tap water and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat and cook for 15-20 mins until tender and cooked through.
Drain and return to pot with butter.
Toss to combine and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Mash avocado in a bowl with sour cream.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Bbq It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and toss in a bowl with measure of spices.
Grease BBQ with oil and cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Set aside to rest for a few mins before slicing.
Alternatively, use same method to cook chicken in frypan with a drizzle of oil.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Toss slaw, mayonnaise and vinegar in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken, potatoes and slaw.
Dollop avocado smash on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Grilled Peri Peri Chicken with Spiced Bulgar
recipes.description: A flavorful grilled chicken dish seasoned with spicy peri peri sauce, served over a bed of aromatic spiced bulgar, and topped with a fresh rainbow slaw for a burst of color and crunch.

instructions.text: Dice onion and courgette.
Heat oil in a pot (with a lid) on medium-high.
Cook onion and courgette with first measure of spices and a pinch of salt for 3-4 mins, until softened.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 more min, until fragrant.
Add stock and bulgur and bring to a simmer.
Cover with a lid, drop heat to low and cook for 10 mins.
Take off heat, leave lid on and steam, for 10 mins.
There should be no liquid and the grains will be tender.
Fluff grains with a fork.
Once chicken is cooked, stir any resting juices from it through bulgur.
Dice onion and courgette.
Preheat oven to high grill.
Pat chicken dry and slice 2cm.
Toss on a foil-lined oven tray with oil, second measure of spices and peri peri sauce.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spread in a single layer and grill chicken for about 10 mins, until charred and cooked through.
Set aside to rest for a few mins.
Add slaw to a bowl with mayo and vinegar.
Toss and season to taste with salt.
Plate up bulgur topped with chicken and slaw.
Get stuck in!

recipes.name: Herbed Butterflied Lamb Roast with Honey-Glazed Sesame Carrots & Mint Sauce
recipes.description: A flavorful and tender butterflied lamb roast seasoned with herbs, served with vibrant honey-glazed sesame carrots and a refreshing mint sauce, perfect for a hearty and elegant meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut carrot into chips.
Toss carrots with sesame seeds, honey and olive oil in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper.
Place on a lined oven tray and roast on upper oven rack for 20- 25 mins, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Peel and dice potatoes.
Add potatoes to a second pot with pumpkin.
Cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on, then remove lid and drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with first measure of butter.
Mash until smooth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
High heat caramelises the lamb and locks in juices and flavour.
Season lamb with salt and cook, fat side down, for 3 mins.
Flip and cook a further 2 mins, then transfer to a lined oven tray.
Save pan for step 4.
Roast lamb on lower oven rack for 10-14 mins for medium or until cooked to your liking.
Set lamb aside to rest.
Thinly slice lamb just before serving.

instructions.heading: Stir It
instructions.text: Melt second measure of butter in saved pan on medium.
Add measure of spices and flour and cook for about 30 secs, until fragrant.
Slowly add stock, while whisking, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer for about 1 min, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and stir through any lamb resting juices.
Keep warm until ready to serve.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add to pot of boiling water along with peas.
Cook for 5 mins, until tender.
Once cooked, drain well and return to pot with olive oil.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Divide mash, lamb, greens and carrot onto plates.
Drizzle over gravy and mint sauce.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Herby Roast Chicken Drums with Creamy Leek & Roasties
recipes.description: A flavorful roast chicken dish featuring herb-seasoned chicken drumsticks served with a creamy leek sauce and roasted root vegetables, perfect for a hearty and comforting meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Dice potatoes and carrot.
Spread in a single layer on a lined oven tray and toss with oil.
Season with salt and pepper and roast on low rack for 25-30 minutes, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.
Pat chicken dry and place in a bowl with first measure of spices, mustard and salt measure.
Toss to coat and place chicken in a baking dish with a drizzle of oil.
Roast chicken in oven on rack above potatoes for 30-35 minutes, until cooked through.
Turn once during cooking.
Thinly slice leek.
Heat oil in a frypan on high heat.
Cook leek with second measure of spices for about 10 minutes, until softened and browned.
Add stock to pan with leek and simmer for about 3 minutes, until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir through baby spinach and sour cream.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve roasties with creamy veggies and chicken.

recipes.name: Indonesian Beef Fried Rice with Peanuts
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty dish featuring stir-fried rice mixed with tender beef, crunchy peanuts, and a medley of fresh vegetables, all seasoned with aromatic spices for a rich, savory taste.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Thinly slice bok choy.
Cut carrot in half and thinly slice.
Mince garlic (if using).
Set all aside separately.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook beef, garlic, chilli flakes (if you like it spicy) and soy sauce for about 5 mins, until well browned.
Set beef aside in a heatproof bowl.
Return pan to high heat and cook carrot for 3 mins.
Add bok choy and peas and cook a further 2 mins, until veggies are tender.
Add cooked rice and beef to pan with veggies along with first measure of kecap manis, sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce.
Cook for another 3-5 mins, until sauce is mixed through and rice is starting to crisp.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Fill up bowls with beef and veggie fried rice and top with peanuts.
Drizzle over remaining kecap manis.
Grab chopsticks or a fork and dinner is ready!

recipes.name: Indonesian-Style Beef Fried Rice with Peanuts
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty dish featuring stir-fried rice with tender beef, crunchy peanuts, and a medley of fresh vegetables, seasoned with aromatic spices for a rich, savory taste.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy.
Cut carrot in half and thinly slice.
Mince garlic (if using).
Set all aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook beef, garlic, chilli flakes (if you like it spicy) and soy sauce for about 5 mins, until well browned.
Set beef aside in a heatproof bowl.
Return pan to high heat and cook carrot for 3 mins.
Add bok choy and peas and cook a further 2 mins, until veggies are tender.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Add cooked rice and beef to pan with veggie along with first measure of kecap manis, sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce.
Cook for another 3-5 mins, until sauce is mixed through and rice is starting to crisp.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill up bowls with beef and veggie fried rice and top with peanuts.
Drizzle over remaining kecap manis.
Grab chopsticks or a fork and dinner is ready!

recipes.name: Italian-Style Mini Beef Meatloaves with Tomato Gravy & Mash
recipes.description: A comforting and flavorful dish featuring mini beef meatloaves baked to perfection, served with a rich tomato gravy and creamy mashed potatoes, complemented by steamed broccoli.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Grease a muffin tin (or small loaf tin).
Boil a pot of salted water for broccoli.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Dice first measure of onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium.
Cook onion and carrot for about 5 mins, until tender.
Add to a bowl along with beef, measure of spices, egg, breadcrumbs, salt measure, tomato sauce and half of the Parmesan.
Mix well to combine.
Save pan for step 4.
Press about 1/4 cup of mixture into each muffin cup or press it all into loaf tin.
Top with remaining Parmesan.
Bake for an initial 20 mins (muffins) or 30 mins (loaf).
Switch oven to high grill and cook for a further 2-3 mins, until golden.
Once cooked, rest for 5 mins, before thinly slicing (if made int

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Peel and dice potatoes.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Remove lid, then drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain well, return to pot and mash with butter and milk, until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, thinly slice second measure of onion.
Return saved pan to medium heat with butter.
Cook onion for about 5 mins, until softened.
Stir in flour and tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly for 2 mins.
Whisk in beef stock and cook a further 2-3 mins, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Cook in pot of boiling water for 3-4 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up mash topped with meatloaf and gravy.
Serve greens on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Japanese Sticky Ginger Beef Bowls with Green Salad
recipes.description: A flavorful and satisfying dish featuring tender beef coated in a sweet and savory ginger sauce, served over rice and topped with a fresh green salad. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: telegraph cucumber
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Grate carrot and put half aside for the salad.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Add beef and cook for about 5-7 mins, stirring, until beef is browned and cooked through.
Add first half of grated carrot and cook, stirring, for 2 mins.
Add ginger sauce and simmer for 2-3 mins, until reduced and sticky.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Cut cucumber in half and thinly slice.
Roughly chop lettuce.
Toss together in a bowl along with second half of carrot and vinegar.
Season to taste with salt.
Mix mayo and sesame oil in a bowl.

instructions.heading: Plate It
instructions.text: Plate up rice bowls topped with beef, salad and chilli flakes (if using).
Drizzle over sesame mayo.
Enjoy every bite!

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken Burgers
recipes.description: A flavorful burger recipe featuring chicken marinated in jerk spices, paired with fresh vegetables and served with crispy orange kumara chips. The dish combines bold, spicy flavors with a satisfying crunch.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Chips
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Cut kumara into 1cm thick chips and toss on a lined oven tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for 20- 25 minutes, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand on top and slice through horizontally.
Cut steaks into smaller pieces until you have at least 6 pieces.
Toss in a bowl with remaining jerk chicken ingredients and season with salt.
Set aside to marinate.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Thinly slice onion and mushrooms.
Roughly chop lettuce, cut tomato in half and thinly slice.
Set all aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 2-4 minutes each side, until just cooked through.
Set cooked chicken aside, covered, to rest.
Alternatively, cook chicken, veggies and buns on BBQ hot plate.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Wipe pan clean and return to high heat with little more oil.
Cook onion, mushrooms and second measure of jerk spices for 5-7 minutes, until golden and tender.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Toast Buns
instructions.text: While veggies cooks, cut buns in half horizontally, then place closed on a second lined oven tray and cook on rack below chips for about 5 minutes, until toasted.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Fill buns with butter, mayo, veggies and chicken.
Serve chips on the side.

recipes.name: Kids! Mini Beef Meatloaves
recipes.description: A fun and family-friendly dinner featuring bite-sized beef meatloaves served with creamy mashed potatoes and a tangy BBQ sauce, perfect for kids and adults alike.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Grease a muffin tin (S2: 6 cup; S4: 12 cup; S6: 18 cup) or a loaf tin, if making whole meatloaf.
Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion and carrot for about 4 mins, until softened.

instructions.heading: Assemble It
instructions.text: Grate cheese (S6 only).
In a bowl, combine cooked veggies, beef, measure of spices, egg, breadcrumbs, salt measure, half the cheese measure and half the tomato sauce measure.
Press about 1/4 cup of mixture into each muffin cup.
Alternatively, press all beef mixture into loaf tin.
Top with remaining cheese and tomato sauce.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Bake for 15-20 mins, until golden and cooked through If making whole meatloaf, bake for about 30 mins, until golden and cooked through.
Remove from oven and rest for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with butter and milk.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add to pot and cook for 3 mins.
Drain broccoli and add back to pot.
Stir through spinach, until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up mash, meatloaves, greens and a dollop of BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Kids! Mini Beef Meatloaves with Creamy Mash & BBQ Sauce
recipes.description: A fun and family-friendly meal featuring bite-sized beef meatloaves served with creamy mashed potatoes and a tangy BBQ sauce, perfect for kids and adults alike.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Grease a muffin tin (S2: 6 cup; S4: 12 cup; S6: 18 cup) or loaf tin.
Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion and carrot for about 4 mins, until softened.

instructions.heading: Assemble It
instructions.text: Grate cheese.
In a bowl, combine cooked veggies, beef, measure of spices, egg, breadcrumbs, salt measure, half the cheese measure and half the tomato sauce measure.
Press about 1/4 cup of mixture into each muffin cup.
Top with remaining cheese and tomato sauce.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Bake for 15-20 mins, until golden and cooked through.
Remove from oven and rest for 5 mins.
Alternatively, press all beef mixture into loaf tin.
Top with remaining cheese and tomato sauce.
Bake for about 30 mins, until cooked through.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add to pot and cook for 3 mins.
Drain broccoli and add back to pot.
Stir through spinach, until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up mash and topped with meatloaves with greens on the side and a dollop of BBQ sauce.

recipes.name: Kids' Fave Cheesy Chicken & Roasties with Tomato Jam
recipes.description: A comforting one-pan meal featuring tender chicken, roasted vegetables, and a cheesy topping, complemented by a tangy tomato jam for added flavor.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Dice potatoes and carrot 2cm.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with first measure of spices and oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake in oven for an initial 15-20 mins.
Cut broccoli into small florets and grate cheese.
Set both aside for later.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Toss in a bowl with second measure of spices.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches if needed, for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Set aside to rest, covered.
OR, AIR FRY IT To cook in the air fryer instead, preheat air fryer to 200°C.
Place chicken in air fryer basket in a single layer, drizzle with oil and cook for 12-14 mins, until golden and cooked through.
Set aside to rest, covered.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: When veggies have 10 mins remaining, remove from oven, add broccoli and sprinkle over cheese.
Return to oven to bake for a further 10 mins, until cooked through.
Thinly slice chicken just before serving.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken and veggies.
Don't forget to dollop with tomato jam!

recipes.name: Kids' Fave Pork Spag Bol with Parmesan
recipes.description: A hearty and kid-friendly pasta dish featuring tender pork, rich tomato sauce, and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese, perfect for a comforting family meal.

instructions.text: Boil a pot of salted water.
Finely dice onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in pot or frypan on high.
Cook onion and carrot for about 5 mins, until browned and softened.
Add pork, measure of spices and salt measure and cook for about 7 mins, stirring to break up pork, until browned.
Add flour and cook for about 1 min.
Add stock, canned tomatoes, tomato paste and milk to pan.
Scrape the pan with a wooden spoon to release any caramelisation on the bottom of the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low-medium and cook for about 8 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Stir through spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, cook pasta in pot of boiling water for 8-10 mins, until just tender.
Drain, return to pot and toss with oil to prevent sticking.
Add pasta to pan with Bolognese and stir to combine.
Pan not large enough to fit everything?
Add Bolognese to pot with pasta instead.
Plate up pasta in bowls and sprinkle over Parmesan.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Kiwi As Beef Patties
recipes.description: A creative twist on traditional beef patties, made with kiwi as the main ingredient, served with hand-cut chips and garlic aioli for a unique and flavorful meal.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into chips.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast until golden and tender, about 25-30 mins.
Swap trays halfway for evenly cooked chips.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Finely dice first measure of onion.
Mix in a bowl with remaining patties ingredients (except oil).
Divide mixture into balls (S2: 3 balls, S4: 6 balls, S6: 9 balls), then flatten into patties, about 1 cm thick.
Set aside on a plate/tray.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook patties in batches 4-5 mins each side, until brown and cooked through.
Add more oil between batches if needed.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Thinly slice remaining onion.
Heat oil in a second frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion about 5 mins, until softened.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Grate carrot and beetroot.
Add to a bowl with honey, vinegar and second measure of mustard.
Season with salt and pepper.
Thinly slice tomato and roughly chop lettuce.
Build your plate with patties, potato chips, salad and all the toppings.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Kiwi Classic Mince & Cheese Pie
recipes.description: A hearty and comforting pie filled with savory minced meat and melted cheese, perfect for game day or any occasion.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Seat aside a medium baking dish (measuring about 20 x 28cm) Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion and carrot for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add beef and cook for about 4 minutes, breaking up as it cooks, until browned.
Add first measure of stock and bring up to a simmer.
Mix cornflour with water and add to beef along with Worcestershire and tomato sauce and simmer for about 1 minute, until thickened.
Stir through second measure of stock, and season.
Transfer beef mixture into reserved dish and sprinkle over cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk egg.
Unroll pastry and place on top to fit snugly, cut pastry to fit the dish, if needed.
Prick pastry in a few places with a fork, then lightly brush with egg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until pastry is golden.

recipes.name: Kiwi Onion Dipped Chicken with Chips & Smashed Greens
recipes.description: A flavorful chicken dish coated in a tangy kiwi and onion marinade, served with crispy potato chips and creamy smashed greens, perfect for a hearty and refreshing meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Cut potatoes into rounds.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays.
Spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
If using 2 trays, swap halfway through to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Mix onion dip and sour cream in a bowl.
Let it rest for about 15 mins in the fridge.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry.
Cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Toss with measure of spices and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches if needed, for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Rest, covered.
Thinly slice just before serving.

instructions.heading: Smash It
instructions.text: Add peas to pot of boiling water.
Cook for about 3 mins, until bright green and tender.
Drain well, return to pot and roughly mash.
Add spinach to pot along with butter and stir to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken slices, chips and greens.
Serve onion dip on the side for dunking!

recipes.name: Korean Pork 'n' Noodle Bowls
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty Korean-inspired dish featuring tender pork, egg noodles, and a vibrant mix of fresh vegetables, all topped with a zesty sauce and crunchy peanuts.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies & Sauce
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Cut carrot into thin matchsticks or grate, cut cucumber into 1cm thick sticks and thinly slice lettuce.
In a small bowl, whisk all sauce ingredients together.

instructions.heading: Cook Noodles
instructions.text: Cook noodles in pot of boiling water for 5 minutes, add corn and cook for a further 2-3 minutes, until noodles are tender.
Drain and return to pot with a little oil and a pinch of salt.

instructions.heading: Cook Pork
instructions.text: While noodles are cooking, heat a little oil in a medium fry-pan on high heat.
Cook pork, stirring for about 4 minutes.
Add ginger and garlic and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until pork is cooked through.
Stir sauce and add to pan.
Allow to bubble and cook for about 1 minute, until slightly thickened.
SERVE noodles and pork topped with veggies and peanuts.

recipes.name: Korean Sticky Chilli Sauce with Sesame Seeds (untitled scan)

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Thinly slice cucumber into rounds.
Toss with slaw, vinegar and soy sauce in a bowl.
Season with salt.
Mix together mayo and sesame oil in another bowl.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Coat It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and slice 3cm.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add chicken, flour and cornflour to a bowl and toss to coat.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches If needed, for about 4 mins each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Dust off any excess flour as you go.
Running dry?
Add more oil between batches.
For extra crispy fried chicken, add enough oil to your pan for shallow frying.
Take extra caution when cooking with hot oil!

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: In a heatproof bowl, toss cooked chicken with Korean sticky chilli sauce and sesame seeds.
Top rice with Korean fried chicken, slaw and sesame mayo.
Dig in!

recipes.name: KUMARA FISH CAKES
recipes.description: A flavorful dish combining sweet kumara and flaky fish, seasoned with herbs and spices, served with a fresh salad and a zesty lemon aioli.

instructions.text: PREHEAT OVEN to 220°C.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).

instructions.heading: Prep Cakes
instructions.text: Peel and dice kumara 2cm.
Cook in pot of boiling water for about 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain and return to pot.
Pat fish dry and place on a lined oven tray.
Season and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
Finely dice onion and roughly chop spinach.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into very small florets and roughly chop lettuce.
Set lettuce aside.
Place broccoli and a pinch of salt in a medium, heat- proof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Cover with a plate and leave for 5-6 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain, refresh under cold water and leave to drain well before returning to bowl.

instructions.heading: Mix Cakes
instructions.text: Use a fork to flake cooked fish on tray and discard any bones.
Add fish with all remaining cake ingredients to pot with cooked and drained kumara (or to a large bowl if not big enough).
Mix well with a wooden spoon or lightly mash to break up kumara and fish, until well combined.
Scoop out 1/3 cup measures of mix and roll into balls.
Flatten into 2cm thick cakes.

instructions.heading: Cook Cakes
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large (preferably non-stick) fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook cakes, in batches, for about 2 minutes each side until browned.
Transfer to tray used for fish and place in oven for about 3 minutes to warm cakes through.
Alternatively, cook on BBQ hot plate for 4-5 minutes each side, until golden and hot through.

instructions.heading: Finish Salad
instructions.text: Add lettuce to bowl with broccoli.
Drizzle with a little oil and vinegar and season.

instructions.heading: Prep Aioli
instructions.text: Combine lemon juice, garlic and mayo in a small bowl.
Cut remaining lemon into wedges.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide kumara fish cakes and salad between plates, drizzle cakes with lemon aioli and sweet chilli sauce.
Serve lemon wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Glazed Chicken Stir-Fry with Jasmine Rice
recipes.description: A flavorful stir-fry featuring tender chicken and vibrant vegetables coated in a spicy, savory Kung Pao glaze, served with fluffy Jasmine rice.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 mins.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 5 more mins.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets and slice bok choy, carrot and spring onion.
Pat chicken dry, dice 2cm and season with salt and pepper.
Toss chicken in a bowl with first measure of garlic chilli blend and cornflour.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high heat and cook chicken for 6-7 mins, turning, until golden on all sides and cooked through.
Transfer to a bowl.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Return pan to high heat with a little more oil, if needed.
Cook broccoli and carrot for about 3 mins.
Add water measure and bok choy and cook a further 2-3 mins, until veggies are tender.
Return chicken, any resting juices, spring onion and kung pao sauce to pan and allow to come to a simmer.
Toss to coat and remove from heat.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate rice with stir-fry and second measure of garlic chilli blend.
Broccoli stalk is just as delicious and easy to cook as the rest of the broccoli.
Add it to a stir-fry, veggie bake or spiralise it!

recipes.name: LAMB RISSOLES
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful meal featuring tender lamb rissoles paired with a vibrant potato, broccoli, and pea salad dressed in a tangy honey mustard dressing. Perfect for a satisfying and comforting dinner.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Salad
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ hot plate (if using).
Dice potatoes 2cm, cut broccoli into small florets and thinly slice stalk.
Add potatoes to a large pot with a pinch of salt and cover with hot tap water.
Cover with a lid and cook on high heat for about 22 minutes, add broccoli and peas and cook for a further 3 minutes, until potatoes are just tender.
Drain well.

instructions.heading: Prep Rissoles
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and mix in a bowl with all remaining rissole ingredients.
Use a ¼ cup measure to scoop out mix and form into 2cm thick patties.

instructions.heading: Cook Rissoles
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry- pan on medium-high heat and cook rissoles for 4 minutes each side, until cooked through.
Alternatively, cook rissoles on BBQ hot plate.
MAKE DRESSING & FINISH SALAD.
In a large bowl, combine all dressing ingredients.
When potatoes, broccoli and peas are cooked, add to bowl along with spinach.
Toss to combine and season to taste.
SERVE potato salad topped with rissoles.
Crumble over feta.

recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Spices with Dijon Mustard (untitled scan)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays and spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.
Swap trays halfway to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Marinate It
instructions.text: Mince garlic.
Add to a bowl with lemon zest and first measure of lemon juice, honey, soy sauce, measure of spices and salt measure.
Cut chicken into 1-2cm strips.
Toss through marinade to coat.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy.
Grate carrot.
Chop spinach.
Toss in a bowl with remaining slaw ingredients.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, in batches if needed, for about 6 mins, stirring, until browned and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken with wedges and slaw.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: LOADED POTATO SKINS
recipes.description: A hearty and indulgent dish featuring crispy potato skins loaded with a savory pork filling, fresh spinach, sour cream, and sweet chili sauce. Perfect for sharing and enjoying as a comforting meal or appetizer.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line an oven tray with baking paper.
Cut a 2cm-thick slice off the edge of each potato and repeat, working around the outside of the potato until you have about 4 cheeks.
Slice the remaining centre pieces into 1cm thick chips.
Toss potatoes on prepared tray with first measure of loaded spice mix and a little oil, spreading out into a single layer.
Season and roast for 30-35 minutes, until golden and tender.
Turn once during cooking.

While potatoes are cooking, finely dice onion and grate carrot, Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat, Add onion, carrot and pork to pan and cook for 4-5 minutes, breaking mince up with a spoon, until browned.
Add second measure of loaded spice mix, salt, stock, canned tomatoes and tomato paste.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 6-8 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste and cover to keep warm.
To serve, place potato skins onto a large platter and top with pork, spinach, sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.
Place in the centre of the table and let everyone help themselves.

recipes.name: Low Carb Curried Chicken Laksa with Carrot Noodles
recipes.description: A flavorful low-carb version of the classic Malaysian soup, featuring tender chicken, vibrant vegetables, and a rich, creamy curry broth served with spiralized carrot noodles.

instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and dice 3cm.
Thinly slice onion and bok choy.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Set all aside separately.
Heat oil in a pot (with a lid) on high.
Cook onion, chicken and measure of spices for about 4 mins, until browned.
Add laksa paste, coconut milk, chicken stock and fish sauce to pot and simmer for about 3 mins.
Add bok choy and broccoli to pot, cover and cook for about 3 mins, until chicken is just cooked through and veggies are tender.
Add vinegar and gently stir to combine.
Season to taste with salt.
Fill bowls with julienned carrot and chicken laksa.
Sprinkle over chilli flakes (if you like it spicy).

recipes.name: Low Carb Middle Eastern Lamb
recipes.description: A flavorful lamb dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, served with a bed of garlic butter cauliflower rice and a tangy yogurt drizzle, perfect for a low-carb meal.

instructions.text: Mince garlic.
Finely chop cauliflower (or grate).
Heat butter in frypan on medium-high.
Add cauliflower and garlic and cook for 3-5 mins, stirring occasionally.
Stir through spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper.
Dice onion and grate carrot.
Mix yoghurt and honey in a bowl and set aside.
Heat oil in a second frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion and carrot with a pinch of salt for about 5 mins, until softened.
Add beef, measures of spices and salt.
Cook for about 6 mins, until browned.
Add passata and stock and simmer for 3-4 more mins, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Spoon cauli rice onto plates and top with lamb.
Dollop with yoghurt and hummus.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Low Carb Southern Chicken Drums with Cauli Rice & Gravy
recipes.description: A flavorful low-carb twist on classic Southern chicken, served with a creamy cauliflower rice and rich gravy, perfect for a hearty and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan bake).
Season chicken with salt and coat in measure of chicken flour.
Toss on a lined oven tray with oil.
Bake for 35-40 mins, until golden.
Turn once for crispy chicken.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Finely chop cauliflower.
Mince garlic.
Heat butter in frypan on medium-high.
Add garlic and cauliflower, cook for 3-5 mins, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Grate carrot.
Toss with beetroot, cabbage, yoghurt and vinegar in a bowl.
Season with salt.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Heat gravy in a pot on medium heat for 2 mins, until warmed.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Pile drums on cauli rice.
Smother in gravy.
Don't forget the slaw.
Yum!

recipes.name: Mango Slices with Malt Vinegar (untitled scan)

instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
Finely dice onion and cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2-3cm.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium- high heat and cook onion and carrot for about 3 minutes, until soft.
Add chicken, salt, garlic (if using) and ginger and cook for about 6 minutes, until chicken is browned but not cooked through.
Add curry spices and chilli flakes (if using) and cook for 1 minute, stirring until fragrant.
Add stock and cook a further 1-2 minutes, until reduced by half.
Stir through coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low-medium and cook for 5 minutes.
While sauce is simmering, drain mango and slice 1cm.
When curry has simmered for 5 minutes, add mango to curry and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until slightly thickened and reduced.
Stir though spinach and vinegar and season to taste.
Finely dice cucumber.
To serve, divide rice between plates and top with mango chicken curry.
Sprinkle over cucumber or serve on the side.

recipes.name: Medi-Spiced Chicken Pizzas with Feta & Courgette
recipes.description: These mini pizzas are topped with a medley of spices, juicy chicken, creamy feta cheese, and fresh courgette, offering a delightful blend of flavors and textures.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Add chicken to pan with measure of spices and a pinch of salt.
Cook for 5 mins, turning occasionally, until browned.
Add flour and tomato paste and stir.
Add water measure and bring to a simmer.
Cook for about 5 mins, until thick.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Thinly slice first measure of onion and courgette.
Place pita on an oven tray in a single layer.
Top with chicken, onion and courgette.
Grill pitas for about 5 mins, until cheese is melted.
Prefer things old school?
Fill your pitas instead!

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, thinly slice second measure of onion.
Peel second measure of courgette and carrot into ribbons.
Toss with spinach and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Divide pitzas between plates.
Serve salad on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Mexi Cheesy Chicken Loaded Wedges
recipes.description: A savory and indulgent dish featuring golden wedges topped with melted cheese, chicken, black beans, and salsa, served with a side of sour cream for dipping.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes into wedges.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with first measure of spices and oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for about 25 mins, until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, grate carrot.
Drain and rinse beans.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), or until cooked through.
Set aside to rest and save pan.
Return pan to heat with oil.
Cook carrot, second measure of spices and chilli flakes for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add stock, beans and canned tomatoes.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Chop tomato.
Roughly chop cooked chicken.
When wedges are cooked, remove from oven.
Top with beans, chicken, tomato and cheese.
Return tray to oven for about 3 mins, until cheese is melted.
Portion wedges topped with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Mexi Fried Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: A vibrant and flavorful bowl featuring crispy fried chicken, colorful vegetables, and a creamy sour cream topping, perfect for a satisfying and hearty meal.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a second pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Dice shallot.
Combine in a bowl with remaining pickled shallot ingredients.
Set aside for serving.
Toss slaw in a bowl with second measure of vinegar.
Season to taste with salt.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Toss in a bowl with chicken flour and a pinch of salt.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat a generous amount of oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Add chicken to pan, shaking off excess flour as you go.
Cook, in batches if needed, for about 8 mins, turning occasionally, until golden and cooked through.
OR, AIR FRY IT Want to cook chicken in the air fryer instead?
Preheat air fryer to 200°C.
Drizzle chicken with oil and cook, in batches if needed, for about 8 mins, until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Toss cooked chicken with measure of chipotle salt in a bowl.
Drain corn and cook in pot of boiling water for 3 mins, until tender Dice avocado.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill bowls with rice.
Top with fried chicken, pickled shallot, slaw, corn, and avocado.
Drizzle with sour cream and sprinkle over seeds.
Dig in!
Cooking in air fryer instead?
Preheat air fryer to 180°C.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Toss in a bowl with chicken flour and a pinch of salt.
Place chicken in air fryer basket in a single layer with a drizzle of and cook for 8-10 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Once cooked, toss with measure of Mexican chipotle salt in a bowl until coated.

recipes.name: Mexi Fried Chicken Bowl with Rice & Sour Cream
recipes.description: A flavorful bowl featuring crispy fried chicken, colorful vegetables, fluffy rice, and a tangy sour cream topping, perfect for a satisfying and hearty meal.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a second pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Dice onion.
Combine in a bowl with remaining pickled onion ingredients.
Set aside for serving.
Toss slaw in a bowl with second measure of vinegar.
Season to taste with salt.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Toss in a bowl with chicken flour and a pinch of salt.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat a generous amount of oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Add chicken to pan, shaking off excess flour as you go.
Cook, in batches if needed, for about 8 mins, turning occasionally, until golden and cooked through.
OR, AIR FRY IT Want to use the air fryer instead?
Preheat air fryer to 200°C.
Place chicken in air fryer basket in a single layer with a drizzle of and cook for 8-10 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Toss cooked chicken with measure of chipotle salt in a bowl.
Drain corn.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Fill bowls with rice.
Top with fried chicken, pickled onion, slaw and corn.
Drizzle with sour cream and sprinkle over seeds.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Mexi Pulled Pork
recipes.description: A flavorful fusion dish featuring tender pulled pork infused with Mexican spices, served with roasted kumara and a fresh salad. The dish is rich, savory, and perfect for a hearty meal.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Kumara
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Slice kumara into 1cm thick rounds, season and toss on a lined oven tray with first measure of pulled pork spices and a little oil.
Roast for about 20 minutes, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Pork
instructions.text: Finely dice shallot and drain and rinse beans.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook shallot and a pinch of salt for 2-3 minutes, until soft.
Add second measure of pulled pork spices and chilli flakes and cook a further 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add beans, pork, canned tomatoes and stock.
Bring to a simmer, reduce to low heat and cook for 7-8 minutes, until slightly thickened and reduced.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Dice tomatoes 1cm and peel carrot and courgette into ribbons.
Toss with a little red wine vinegar and oil just before serving and season to taste.
SERVE pulled pork with kumara, salad, sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Mexican-Style Pulled Beef Bowls
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty dish featuring tender pulled beef, served over rice and topped with fresh vegetables, salsa, and a dollop of sweet chili yogurt for a zesty twist.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Thinly slice onion and capsicum.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook onion, carrot and capsicum for about 5 mins, until browned.
Add tomato paste and measure of spices and cook for about 1 min, until fragrant.
Add beef and stock, bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and cook for about 6 mins, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Char It
instructions.text: Drain corn and dice tomato.
Add to a bowl and toss with olive oil and vinegar.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: In a bowl, mix yoghurt and sweet chilli sauce together.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top rice with beef.
Spoon on salsa and sweet chilli yoghurt.
Delish!

recipes.name: Mild Sweet Chilli Sauce with Ginger (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Steam It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Toss on a lined oven tray with oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 10 mins.
Slice bok choy.
After broccoli has had 10 mins cook time, add bok choy and sesame oil to tray.
Cook for a further 5-7 minutes, until tender.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and dice 3cm.
Toss in a bowl with cornflour and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6-8 mins (depending on thickness), or until cooked through and golden.
Turn often to ensure even cooking.
Set aside in a medium bowl and reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Grate ginger.
Combine in a bowl with soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, honey, sesame oil and water measure.
Return pan to low-medium heat and cook sauce for about 2 mins, until slightly reduced.
Return chicken and any resting juices to pan and toss to coat.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load bowls with rice with chicken, veggies, sauce and peanuts.

recipes.name: Moroccan Sizzling Chicken with Tomatoey Couscous
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring grilled chicken seasoned with Moroccan spices, served with a vibrant tomato-based couscous salad, perfect for a hearty and aromatic meal.

instructions.text: Preheat BBQ to medium (if using).
Boil a kettle.
Add couscous to a heatproof bowl.
Add salt and boiling water measures, cover and leave for 5 mins before fluffing up grains.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of the chicken and slicing through horizontally.
Combine in a bowl with all remaining chicken ingredients.
Cook chicken on BBQ for 3-5 mins each side (depending on thickness), until cooked through.
Rest for a few minutes before slicing thickly.
Reserve any resting juices.
Alternatively, use the same method to cook chicken in a frypan on medium heat.
Add all remaining couscous ingredients to bowl with couscous.
Mix and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Plate chicken on top of couscous.
Drizzle with any resting juices and yoghurt.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Mother's Day Salmon Risotto with Chocolate Pudding
recipes.description: A comforting and elegant risotto featuring tender salmon, creamy rice, and fresh greens, paired with a rich chocolate pudding for a delightful contrast in flavors.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Combine boiling water and measure of stock spices in a pot.
Bring back to the boil on medium heat.
Once boiling, remove from heat and keep warm.
Finely dice leek.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a second pot on medium.
Add leek with a pinch of salt and cook for about 4 mins, until soft.
Add rice and wine (or equal amount of stock or water) and cook, stirring to coat rice for about 1 min, until absorbed.
Once liquid is absorbed, reduce heat to low-medium.
Start adding stock, about 1/2 cup at a time, only adding more stock once the previous addition has been absorbed.
Continue this, stirring often for 18-20 mins, or until grains are tender and risotto is a porridge-like consistency.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium.
Add capers and cook for about 2 mins, until crispy.
Remove from pan and set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Warm It
instructions.text: Place salmon on a lined oven tray.
Warm in oven for 2-3 mins, until just heated through.
Gently flake smoked salmon away from the skin in large pieces and discard skin.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Roughly chop spinach.
When risotto is cooked, add spinach, first measure of sour cream and squeeze in first measure of lemon juice.
Mix well, until creamy and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Toss rocket in a bowl and squeeze in second second measure of lemon juice just before for serving.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon risotto into bowls and top with salmon.
Serve with a handful of rocket and sprinkle over capers.
MIX IT (DESSERT) Grease a baking dish (about 20 x 15cm).
In a bowl, whisk together milk, egg and melted butter.
Add chocolate pudding mix.
Whisk gently until smooth and combined.
Pour into prepared dish and smooth into an even layer with a spoon.
BAKE IT (DESSERT) Sprinkle chocolate sauce mix evenly over pudding.
Slowly pour boiling water measure onto the back of a large metal spoon over the pudding, to cover evenly.
Place baking dish on a baking tray (to prevent any spills while baking).
Bake for 25-30 mins, or until pudding bounces back when pressed gently in centre.
Serve immediately.
EAT IT (DESSERT) Dust pudding with icing sugar and serve with cream or vanilla ice cream (optional).

recipes.name: Mug Cake for Mum
recipes.description: A quick and delicious single-serve chocolate cake baked in a mug, perfect for a sweet treat or a special gift.

instructions.text: If you don't have a microwave, preheat oven to 180°C.
1. In a small bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa, baking powder, sugar and salt.
2. Melt coconut oil (if using).
Add the milk and oil and whisk to gently combine.
Gently stir through spread or chocolate chips.
Do not overmix.
3. Transfer to a mug (or ramekin, if baking) and microwave for 70-90 sec or bake for 18-22 minutes (depending on size of ramekin), until puffy on top but slightly gooey.
4. Once cooked, top with nuts and ice cream/cream and serve immediately.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Panko Crumbed Fish with Saucy Japanese Noodles
recipes.description: A crispy panko-crusted fish served over saucy Japanese noodles, topped with a creamy sauce and garnished with sesame seeds. This dish combines the flavors of Japanese cuisine with a satisfying crunch and rich sauce.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Thinly slice onion and bok choy.
Cut broccoli into florets and dice stalk.
Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
In a small bowl mix sesame oil and mayo.
Set aside separately.

instructions.heading: Crumb It
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and cut any larger pieces in half.
Season with salt and pepper.
Short on time?
Just pan-fry the fish without crumbing.
Otherwise, toss fish with plain flour in a medium bowl.
Add egg to bowl and toss to coat.
Place breadcrumbs in another medium bowl.
Dip fish into crumbs, turn to coat each piece and place on a plate or tray.
Set aside.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Use your hands to separate noodles and place in pot of boiling water.
Stir to separate strands and cook for 5 mins, until just tender.
Drain well, return to pot and drizzle with oil to stop sticking.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a large frypan or wok on high.
Stir-fry onion, carrot and broccoli for about 5 mins, until starting to soften.
Add bok choy and cook for a further 2 mins, until tender.
Add cooked veggies to pot with noodles.
Toss well with teriyaki sauce and soy sauce.
Wipe pan clean, then heat on medium-high.
Cook fish, in batches, for about 3 mins each side, until golden and cooked through.
Running dry?
Add more oil between batches if needed.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Load your bowl with noodles and fish.
Smother over sesame mayo and shower in sesame seeds!

recipes.name: Parmesan Crusted Fish
recipes.description: A comforting and flavorful dinner featuring crispy parmesan-crusted fish, golden potato wedges, and a side of steamed broccoli, all complemented by a tangy relish.

instructions.heading: Preheat Oven
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Relish
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a small pot on medium-high heat.
Finely dice onion and cook for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add relish spices and cook a further 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, sugar, salt, water and vinegar, bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low-medium.
Cook for about 15 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste and set aside.
Reserve half the relish for the sliders, store in an airtight container in the fridge.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Wedges
instructions.text: Cut potatoes into 1cm thick wedges and toss with flour and wedge spices (shake off any excess).
Drizzle with oil on a lined oven tray, season and cook in oven for about 25 minutes, until golden and tender.
Toss halfway to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Fish & Broccoli
instructions.text: Pat fish dry, season with salt and place on a second lined tray.
Roughly chop spinach and place in a medium bowl with breadcrumbs, cheese and lemon zest.
Spread mayo over fish, sprinkle with crumb and set tray aside.

instructions.heading: Cook Fish
instructions.text: When wedges have 10 minutes remaining, cook fish in oven, on rack above potatoes, for about 8 minutes.
Turn oven to high grill and cook a further 1-2 minutes until fish is cooked through and crumb is golden.

instructions.heading: Cook Broccoli
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets and cook in pot of boiling water for about 4 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain, return to pot and season.
Cut zested lemon into wedges.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide fish and wedges between plates.
Serve broccoli and a lemon wedge on the side.
Dollop with relish.

recipes.name: PeriPeri Chicken Pizzas
recipes.description: A flavorful pizza topped with chicken, spinach, and a spicy peri-peri mayo drizzle, served with a fresh beetroot and carrot slaw.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat two oven trays (or pizza stones).
Pat chicken dry and slice 0.5cm.
Thinly slice onion and both measures of spinach.
Mix together tomato paste, garlic (if using), oil and first measure of sweet chilli sauce and spread evenly over pizza bases.
Top with diced chicken, onion and first measure of spinach.
Season and sprinkle over cheese.

instructions.heading: Yummy
instructions.text: Cut one pizza in half and place one and a half pizzas onto each preheated tray and cook for 12-14 minutes, until base is crispy and golden and chicken is cooked through.
Swap trays halfway through to ensure even cooking.
While pizza is cooking, grate beetroot and carrots and cut cucumber in half lengthways then thinly slice.
Add all to a bowl with second measure of spinach, sweet chilli sauce, vinegar and salt.
Mix to combine and season to taste.
Mix periperi sauce, mayo and water together in a small bowl.
To serve, cut pizza into 6-8 pieces, drizzle with periperi mayo and divide between plates with slaw on the side.

recipes.name: Pesto Chicken Salad
recipes.description: A vibrant and hearty salad featuring roasted vegetables, grilled chicken, and a creamy pesto dressing, perfect for a satisfying and flavorful meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high (if using).
Preheat oven to 230°C.
Dice potatoes 2cm; cut carrots in half lengthways then slice 1cm; dice capsicum 2cm; cut pumpkin wedges in half.
Divide between 2 lined oven trays and toss with a little oil.
Season and roast for about 30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Swap position of trays halfway through cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Cut chicken into 1cm strips and toss in a bowl with chicken spices, garlic, chilli flakes, salt and a little oil.
Very thinly slice onion.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: When veggies have 15 minutes remaining, heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook chicken for 6-8 minutes, turning, until golden and just cooked through.
Alternatively, cook chicken on BBQ.

instructions.heading: Mix Salad
instructions.text: When veggies are cooked, toss in a bowl with onion, mayo, garden pesto and spinach.
SERVE salad with chicken and almonds.

recipes.name: Pineapple Pork Steaks
recipes.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring pork steaks glazed with a pineapple and BBQ sauce mixture, served with crispy chips and a fresh salad.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line two oven trays with baking paper (one with a lip).
Cut potatoes into 1cm chips, toss on prepared tray (without a lip) with a little oil and season.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, until golden and tender.
Drain pineapple and reserve juice.
2. Thinly slice celery on an angle and thinly slice cabbage until you have about 3 cups worth.
Place both in a bowl, along with baby spinach, first measure of pineapple juice, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.
Set aside.
Toss to combine just before serving and season.
3. Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Pat pork dry and season with salt.
Cook pork for about 2 minutes each side, until browned.
Transfer to second prepared tray (with a lip) and reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Sizzlin
instructions.text: 4. Return pan to high heat with a little more oil if needed.
Cook pineapple slices for about 1 minute each side, until caramelised.
In a bowl, combine BBQ sauce, second measure of pineapple juice and garlic (if using) then evenly spread over pork steaks.
Place a pineapple ring on top of each steak.
5. When chips have about 10 minutes cook time remaining, cook pork (on oven rack above chips) for about 5 minutes (depending on thickness), until just cooked through.
Set aside to rest for 3-5 minutes, then cut each steak into 2-3 slices, if desired.
6. In a small bowl, mix mayo and mustard together (if using).
Season.
7. To serve, divide chips between plates and serve pineapple pork steaks and salad on the side.
Serve with a dollop of mustard mayo (if using).

recipes.name: Pitted Dried Dates with Baking Soda (untitled scan)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 170°C, Grease an oven-proof dish (measuring about 20 x 20cm) with butter.
Place dates and water in a medium pot on medium-high heat.

Cook for about 6 minutes, stirring often, until dates are soft and water has evaporated, Remove from heat and stir through baking soda and first measure of butter, until combined and butter is melted, Set aside for about 10 minutes to cool slightly.
While date mixture is cooling, lightly whisk eggs in a large bowl.
Place cooled date mixture into bowl with eggs and add sugar, salt and vanilla essence.
Stir until combined then gently fold through sifted flour and baking powder, until just combined.
Transfer mixture into prepared dish and bake for about 45 minutes, until golden and a knife comes out clean.
Set aside for about 5 minutes.
When pudding has 5 minutes cook time remaining, prepare butterscotch sauce.
Combine all butterscotch sauce ingredients in a small pot on medium heat.
Bring sauce to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low to cook for a further 3-4 minutes, until sugar has dissolved and sauce has thickened slightly.
Poke about 15 holes in the top of the pudding, using the end of a spoon or skewer.
Pour over half the butterscotch sauce (reserving half to serve) and leave for about 1 minute to soak into the pudding slightly.
Serve with extra butterscotch sauce as well as ice cream on the side, or drizzle over runny cream (if using).

recipes.name: Pork 'n' Apple Burgers
recipes.description: A flavorful burger recipe featuring pork patties infused with the sweetness of apples, served with a fresh side salad. The combination of savory pork and tangy apples creates a unique and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Patties
instructions.text: Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium (if using).
Preheat oven to high grill.
Finely dice first measure of onion and grate first apple.
Mix all patty ingredients in a large bowl.
Use a 1½ cup measure to scoop out mix, roll into 7-8 balls and flatten into 1cm thick patties.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Peel carrot and courgette into ribbons, thinly slice second apple and second measure of onion.
Toss together with spinach, a little oil and a drizzle of red wine vinegar.
Season.

instructions.heading: Cook Patties
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook patties for 3-4 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Alternatively, cook patties and toast buns on

instructions.heading: Toast Buns
instructions.text: Cut buns in half horizontally and place open on an oven tray.
Place under grill for about 3 minutes each side, until toasted.
SERVE burgers with extra salad on the side.

recipes.name: Pork 'n' Apple Meatballs
recipes.description: A comforting dish featuring tender pork meatballs infused with the sweetness of apples, served with a creamy mash and a rich sauce made with peas and spinach. Perfect for a hearty and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Peel parsnips, then dice parsnips and potatoes 2-3cm.
Add to pot of boiling water and cook for 15-18 minutes, until very soft.
Drain and return to pot with salt, milk and butter and mash until smooth.
Season to taste and keep warm.
Grate apple and add to a bowl with all remaining meatball ingredients and mix to combine.
Using clean, wet hands, roll into golf ball-sized balls.

instructions.heading: Easy Peasy
