instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat and cook meatballs for 8-10 minutes, turning often to cook on all sides, until browned and just cooked through.
While meatballs cook, finely dice onion.
Remove cooked meatballs from pan and cover to keep warm, Return pan to heat with a little more oil (if needed).
Cook onion for about 2 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add peas and stock, bring to the boil and cook for 3-4 minutes, until liquid is reduced by half.
Add cream cheese and meatballs to pan (along with any resting juices), stir to combine and simmer gently for 1-2 minutes, stirring until sauce is combined and meatballs are warmed through.
Stir through spinach and season to taste.
To serve, spoon mash onto plates and top with pork 'n' apple meatballs and sauce.

recipes.name: Pork 'n' Pineapple Salad
recipes.description: A vibrant and flavorful salad featuring thinly sliced pork, fresh pineapple, and roasted vegetables, all tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce for a delightful mix of textures and tastes.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Dice kumara and carrots 2cm.
Toss on a lined oven tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for about 25 minutes, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce
instructions.text: Dice capsicum 1cm; roughly chop spinach; dice onion 2cm.
Set all aside.
Drain pineapple, reserving juices.
Add 2 tablespoons of pínepple juice to a small bowl and mix with ginger and sweet chilli sauce.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Pork
instructions.text: Pat pork dry and season.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook pork for about 3 minutes each side, until golden and just cooked through.
Set aside, covered to rest for about 5 minutes, COOK SAUCE.
Return fry-pan to a medium-high heat with a little more oil and cook onion for about 3 minutes, until just softened.
Add sauce mix and allow to bubble and reduce for about 30 seconds, then transfer to a large bowl.

instructions.heading: Mix Salad
instructions.text: Slice pork thinly against the grain and add to bowl with capsicum and onion, along with pineapple pieces.
When ready to serve, lightly toss kumara and spinach through pork and veggie mix.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Pile pork and pineapple salad into bowls.

recipes.name: Pork Enchiladas
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring pork, beans, and vegetables wrapped in tortillas, baked in a rich enchilada sauce, and topped with cheese, sour cream, and sweet chili sauce.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Grease a large casserole dish (measuring about 20 x 40cm) with a little oil.
Finely dice onion and grate carrot.
Drain and rinse cannellini beans.

instructions.heading: Too Easy
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion for 3-4 minutes, until soft.
Add garlic (if using), pork mince, enchilada spices, chilli flakes (if using) and carrot and cook for about 5 minutes, breaking up mince as it cooks, until browned.
Add cannellini beans, tomato paste, tomato passata, stock, soy sauce, sugar, salt and vinegar and mix well.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium and simmer for 7-9 minutes, until most of the liquid has been reduced.
While sauce cooks, roughly chop spinach.
When sauce is cooked, add spinach and cook for 1 minute to wilt.
Season to taste.
Spoon 3½ cup of pork sauce into each wrap, roll up and line side by side in prepared casserole dish.
Pour remaining purée down the middle of wraps, leaving about 5cm uncovered each side.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for about 15 minutes, until cheese is melted and wraps are golden brown.
To serve, spoon 1-2 enchiladas onto each plate and top with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Pork Noodle Salad
recipes.description: A refreshing and flavorful salad featuring stir-fried pork, tender vegetables, and egg noodles, all tossed in an Asian-inspired dressing for a satisfying and quick meal.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add noodles to pot of boiling water, stir to separate noodles and cook for 6 minutes.
Add broccoli and cook a further 3-4 minutes, until broccoli is bright green and noodles are tender.
Drain well and return to pot with a little oil to prevent sticking.

instructions.heading: Easy Peasy
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Cook pork, garlic and ginger for 5-6 minutes, breaking up mince with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and cooked through.
Stir through soy sauce and season to taste.
Thinly slice onion and bok choy and peel carrots into ribbons.
Place all in a large bowl.
Add cooked noodles and pork to bowl with salad vegetables.
Start by tossing with about half the Asian dressing, then taste and add more to suit your taste buds.
Season to taste with salt or soy sauce and pepper.
To serve, place pork noodle salad into bowls.

recipes.name: Pork Risotto
recipes.description: A creamy risotto made with Arborio rice, asparagus, and topped with crispy pork and feta cheese, offering a rich and comforting meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Risotto
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and slice asparagus 1cm.

instructions.heading: Cook Risotto
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large pot (with a lid) on medium heat.
Cook onion for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add butter, garlic, risotto herbs, salt, rice and lemon zest and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring until fragrant.
Add water and stock and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low-medium, cover with lid and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until nearly tender.

instructions.heading: Cook Topping
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat and cook sausages for about 6 minutes, turning, until browned.
Remove from pan and finely chop.
Use tongs to help with this, as sausages will be very hot.
Return sausages to pan and cook on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes, until cooked through and starting to crisp.
Crumble feta and set aside.

instructions.heading: Finish Risotto
instructions.text: When rice is nearly tender, remove lid, add asparagus and peas and increase heat to medium.
Cook a further 3-4 minutes, stirring often, until rice and asparagus are tender.
Stir through spinach and sour cream and add lemon juice to taste.
Season.
SERVE risotto topped with sausage and feta.

recipes.name: Pork Steaks 'N' Rice Salad
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring tender pork steaks paired with a refreshing rice salad made with jasmine rice, broccoli, corn, and a zesty dressing. The dish is quick and easy to prepare, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Cut broccoli into small florets and dice stalk 1cm and grate courgette.

instructions.heading: Too Easy
instructions.text: Cook rice in pot of boiling water for about 12 minutes, until grains are nearly tender.
Add broccoli and corn and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until broccoli is bright green and rice and veggies are tender.
Stir through courgette then leave to drain through a sieve for about 5 minutes.
While rice cooks, mix pork and BBQ spices together with a little oil and season.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium- high heat.
Cook pork for 3-4 minutes each side (depending on thickness), or until just cooked through.
Set aside, covered to rest, before slicing thickly against the grain.
Toss sliced pork back through resting juices.
Add all rice salad ingredients to a large bowl, mix to combine and season well to taste.
To serve, spoon rice salad onto plates and top with pork (and any remaining resting juices).

recipes.name: Pork Tacos
recipes.description: A flavorful and satisfying meal featuring tender pork tacos paired with a creamy bean smash and a fresh salad, all ready in about 30 minutes.

instructions.heading: Prep Tacos
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Preheat BBQ hot plate to medium-high if using.
Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven to warm for about 20 minutes, until warmed through.
Keep wrapped in foil until ready to serve.

instructions.heading: Cook Bean Smash
instructions.text: Rinse and drain kidney beans and place all bean smash ingredients (except oil) in a small pot on low-medium heat.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 3-4 minutes, until warmed through.
Add oil and mash until smooth.
Season to taste (if needed) and cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad & Pork
instructions.text: Add ranchslaw to a bowl with chipotle, first measure of sour cream, mayo and vinegar.
Mix to combine, season to taste and set aside.
Rub pork with first measure of taco spice and season with salt.

instructions.heading: Cook Pork
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook pork for 3-4 minutes each side (depending on thickness), until just cooked through.
Rest, covered on a plate for 2-3 minutes.
Thinly slice pork and toss back through resting juices.
Alternatively, cook pork and warm through tortillas on the BBQ hot plate as per method.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Place everything in the middle of the table for everyone to build their own tacos.

recipes.name: Potato Top Beef Pie
recipes.description: A comforting and hearty dish featuring a rich beef filling topped with a creamy potato mash, baked to golden perfection. Served with vibrant greens for a balanced meal.

instructions.text: PREP & COOK POTATO TOP.
Preheat oven to high grill.
Dice potatoes 2cm and add to a medium pot of hot tap water.
Season with salt and cook on high, covered, for about 25 minutes, until soft.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter, mash until smooth and season to taste.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Filling
instructions.text: Finely dice onion, dice carrots 1cm and slice leek 1cm.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook butter, onion, carrots and leek with a pinch of salt for about 5-6 minutes, until starting to brown.
Add flour and pie herbs and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef, stock, Worcestershire and soy sauce, bring to a simmer and cook for about 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Cook Pie
instructions.text: Transfer beef to a medium baking dish, top with potato mash and smooth out.
Use a fork to make grooves into the topping and sprinkle with cheese.
Grill for 3-5 minutes, until cheese is golden.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Greens
instructions.text: Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil and roughly chop broccoli florets and stalk.
When pie is grilling, cook broccoli and peas in pot of boiling water for about 3 minutes, until tender.
Drain, return to pot with a drizzle of olive oil and season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Divide the potato top beef pie and greens between plates.

recipes.name: Potato Top Fish Pie
recipes.description: A comforting and hearty dish featuring a creamy fish filling topped with a golden, cheesy potato crust. Perfect for a cozy meal with rich flavors and a satisfying texture.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil.
Set aside a large casserole dish (measuring about 20 x 25cm).
Dice potatoes 2-3cm.
Cook potatoes in pot of boiling water for about 15 minutes, until very soft.
Drain and mash with salt, first measure of butter and milk until smooth.
Season to taste and set aside.
While potatoes are cooking, melt second measure of butter in large pot on low-medium heat.
Add flour and cook for 2-3 minutes, until sandy in texture.
Whisk in milk, a little at a time and cook a further 2-3 minutes until smooth and thickened.
Set aside.
Pat fish dry and cut into 3-4cm pieces; finely dice onion; thinly slice leek and grate courgette.
Heat a drizzle of oil in large fry-pan on medium- high heat.
Add onion and leek and cook for about 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add courgette and spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes, until tender.
Add raw fish, cooked vegetables and salt to white sauce and stir to combine.
Season to taste.
Pour fish filling into casserole dish, top with potato top and sprinkle over cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes, until cheese is golden and fish is just cooked through.
If the top needs slightly more browning, turn the oven to high grill and cook for a further 2-3 minutes.

instructions.heading: Mmm Cheesy
instructions.text: To serve, allow pie to cool for a few minutes before spooning onto plates.

recipes.name: Potato Topped Pulled Beef Pie with Greens
recipes.description: A comforting and hearty dish featuring tender pulled beef topped with a creamy potato layer, served alongside vibrant greens for a balanced meal.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Dice potatoes 2cm.
Add to a pot and cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Cook on high heat on a rolling boil for 15-20 mins, until very tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Thinly slice leek.
Dice carrot 1cm.
Heat oil and butter in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook leek and carrot with a pinch of salt for about 5-6 mins, until starting to brown.
Add flour and measure of spices and cook for 1 min.
Add beef, stock and soy sauce.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Grill It
instructions.text: Transfer beef to a baking dish.
Top with potato mash.
Use a fork to make deep grooves into the topping.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Grill for 3-5 mins, until cheese is golden.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: While beef is simmering, boil a pot of salted water.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Add broccoli and peas to pot of boiling water for about 3 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up potato topped beef pie with greens on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Premium Kiwi Lamb Roast with Yorkshire Pud
recipes.description: A flavorful lamb roast infused with kiwi, served with a hearty Yorkshire pudding and a side of roasted vegetables, creating a unique and comforting dish.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan bake).
Whisk together Yorkshire pudding mix, eggs and milk in a bowl, until combined.
Set aside in the fridge.
Dice potatoes and carrot 2cm.
Toss with oil on a lined oven tray.
Season with salt and pepper.
Roast on upper oven rack for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.
Add first measure of oil to an ovenproof frypan or baking dish and place on lower oven rack to heat up for about 10 mins.
Once heated, very carefully remove from oven and pour in Yorkshire pudding batter.
Quickly return to oven and cook for about 25 mins, until risen and golden.
Heat oil in a frypan on high and cook lamb fat side down for 3 mins.
Flip and cook a further 2 mins, then transfer to a lined oven tray.
Save pan.
Bake lamb on lower oven rack for 10-14 mins for medium, or until cooked to your liking.
Set lamb aside to rest.
When roasties have 5 mins cook time left, melt first measure of garlic butter in saved pan on medium.
Add measure of spices and flour and cook for about 30 secs, until fragrant Slowly whisk in stock and bring to a simmer.
Cook for about 1 min, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt.
Stir through any lamb resting juices.
Keep warm until ready to serve.
Boil a pot of water.
Add peas to pot and cook for 3 mins, until tender.
Drain well and return to pot with second measure of garlic butter and spinach.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Thinly slice lamb.
Plate it up with roasties, Yorkshire pud and greens Pour over gravy and dig in!

recipes.name: Pulled Beef Massaman Curry with Pumpkin & Rice
recipes.description: A rich and aromatic Massaman curry featuring tender pulled beef, pumpkin, and a medley of vegetables, served with fluffy white rice. This dish combines savory, slightly sweet, and nutty flavors in a comforting, one-pot meal.

instructions.text: Bring a kettle to the boil.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 mins.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 5 more mins.
Don't lift the lid during cooking.
Meanwhile, dice onion 1cm and carrot 2cm.
Cut broccoli into florets and dice stalk.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion, carrot and pumpkin with a pinch of salt for about 5 mins, until browned.
Add massaman curry paste, measure of spices and 1/4 cup coconut milk.
Add the curry paste to suit your spice preference.
If you want a mild curry, use half the amount specified.
If you like it a bit spicier, add an extra Tbsp.
Cook for 1-2 mins, until fragrant.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Add pulled beef, remaining coconut milk and water measure to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 5 mins.
Add broccoli and cook for a further 3 mins, until veggies are tender and sauce is thickened.
Stir through soy sauce and spinach and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top rice with curry.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Pulled Beef Tacos
recipes.description: A flavorful and hearty taco dish featuring tender pulled beef, a tangy salad, and a variety of toppings, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Thinly slice onion.
Drain and rinse beans.
Wrap tortillas in foil and warm in oven for about 15 minutes.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook onion and garlic (if using) for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add taco spices and cook for 30 seconds, stirring until fragrant.
Add pulled beef, beans, canned tomatoes, soy sauce, vinegar, tomato sauce, honey and salt and bring to a simmer.
Gently break up beef with a wooden spoon and cook for about 8 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste.
Mix mayo, vinegar and mustard together in a large bowl.
Thinly slice lettuce and grate carrots.
Add to bowl with dressing and toss to combine.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Tangy
instructions.text: To serve, place everything in the centre of the table for everyone to make their own tacos.
Fill tortillas with pulled beef mix and salad.
Top with sour cream and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce (if using).

recipes.name: Pulled Pork with Red Kidney Beans (untitled scan)

instructions.text: PREHEAT oven to 230°C.
Cut potatoes in half lengthways and prick in a few places with a fork.
Toss on a lined oven tray with a drizzle of oil and season with salt.
Bake for about 30 minutes, until cooked through.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Thinly slice spring onions; peel courgette into ribbons; roughly chop lettuce.
Place courgette and lettuce in a bowl and set aside.
Just before serving, drizzle with a little oil and vinegar and lightly season.
Finely dice onion; grate carrot; rinse and drain beans.
When potatoes have about 12 minutes cook time remaining, heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat.
Cook onion, carrot and salt for about 3 minutes, until softened.
Add pork spices, chilli flakes and tomato paste and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add beans, stock and pork, bring to a simmer and cook for about 4 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Season to taste.

instructions.heading: Grill Potatoes
instructions.text: When potatoes are cooked, remove from oven and turn oven to high grill.
Use a fork to lightly crush open the top of each potato to open them up a little.
Top with pulled pork mixture and sprinkle with spring onions and cheese.
Grill for 3-4 minutes, until cheese is melted.
TO SERVE, divide potatoes between plates and dollop with sour cream.
Drizzle with sweet chilli sauce and serve salad on the side.

recipes.name: REWENA BREAD
recipes.description: A traditional Māori sourdough potato bread with a soft, slightly tangy flavor, perfect for enjoying with butter and jam.

instructions.text: Dice potato 1cm and to a small pot with the water.
Bring to the boil, reduce to a simmer and cook for 12-14 minutes, until potato is soft.
Set aside to cool for 30 minutes.
Add sugar and first measure of flour.
Mash together, place in a bowl and cover with a clean tea towel.
Leave in a warm spot for 24 hours.
When your starter is bubbling and almost double in size, make the dough.
Transfer to a large bowl and sift in second measure of flour.
Add water and salt and knead by hand for about 8 minutes, until it is silky and springy.
Place bread dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a clean tea towel and allow to prove in a warm spot for about 4 hours, until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to 220°C and line an oven tray with baking paper.
Gently tip bread dough out onto tray, lightly dust with a little flour and cut slits across the top.
Bake in the oven for about 35 minutes, reduce the temperature to 200°C and cook for a further 10 minutes, until golden brown and it sounds hollow when tapped on the base.
Slice, spread with butter and jam and enjoy!

recipes.name: Roast Pork Scotch
recipes.description: A classic roast dinner featuring tender pork scotch steaks, seasoned with aromatic spices, served with a rich gravy and a medley of roasted root vegetables and apples for a comforting and flavorful meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line two oven trays with baking paper.
Dice potatoes 2cm and toss on first prepared tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for about 30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Slice apple and onion into 1cm wedges; cut parsnip and carrot into 1cm sticks, slice leek 1cm.
Toss on second prepared tray with a little oil and season.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, until golden and tender.
While veggies are roasting, pat pork dry, season with salt and coat in first measure of roast spices.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook pork for 1-2 minutes each side, until well browned but not cooked through.
Reserve pan.
Transfer pork to tray with veggies and place on top, roast on rack above potatoes for about 5 minutes, until just cooked through.
Set aside, covered to rest while you prepare the gravy.
While pork is resting, melt butter in reserved pan on medium heat.
Add flour and second measure of roast spices and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Whisk in stock, 1½ cup at a time and cook for about 3 minutes, until thickened slightly.
Add mustard and any pork resting juices to the gravy and cook a further 1 minute, until thickened.
Season to taste.
Slice pork thickly just before serving.

instructions.heading: Too Easy
instructions.text: To serve, divide roasties between plates.
Serve slices of roast pork scotch on the side and spoon over gravy.

recipes.name: Satay Chicken Skewers
recipes.description: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in a rich, savory peanut sauce, served with fluffy jasmine rice and a fresh vegetable medley. This dish combines the bold flavors of Southeast Asian cuisine with a simple, satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Soak skewers in water for about 10 minutes.
Combine rice, water and salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
While rice is cooking, slice onion, courgette, and bok choy 1cm.
Set aside.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Thread chicken onto soaked skewers, season with salt and set aside.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally to cook on all sides, until golden and cooked through.
Remove from pan and set aside, covered.
Reserve pan.
While chicken is cooking, whisk all satay ingredients together in a small pot.
Bring to a gentle simmer on low-medium heat and cook for about 5 minutes, until thickened slightly and warmed through.
Set aside, covered to keep warm.
Return reserved pan to high heat with a little more oil and cook onion for about 2 minutes, until browned.
Add courgette and cook a further 2 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add bok choy and spinach and cook for 1 minute, until tender.
Season to taste.
To serve, spoon rice onto plates, top with veggies, chicken skewers and satay sauce.

recipes.name: Saucy Beef Korma with Basmati Rice & Cashews
recipes.description: A rich and flavorful beef korma dish, simmered in a creamy sauce with aromatic spices, served with fluffy basmati rice and crunchy cashews for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Meanwhile, dice onion and potato 1cm.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Pat beef dry and season with salt.
Stir-fry beef, in batches if needed, until just cooked, about 1-2 mins.
The edges of the beef should be just-seared and the middle should be slightly pink.
Set beef aside and keep warm.
Return pan to medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil.
Cook onion and potato with a pinch of salt for about 6 mins, until browned.
Add korma paste and 1/4 cup coconut milk and cook for 1-2 mins, until fragrant.
Add remaining coconut milk and stock measure to pan.
Bring to a simmer and cook for about 10 mins, until veggies are tender and sauce is thickened.
Cut broccoli into florets and dice stalk and add to pan.
Cook for a further 3 mins, until broccoli is tender.
Stir through soy sauce, spinach, cooked beef and resting juices, until warmed through.
Season to taste with soy sauce.
Plate up rice topped with curry.
Sprinkle over cashew nuts.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Sesame Fish Burgers
recipes.description: A delicious and easy-to-make burger featuring crispy fish fillets, fresh salad, and sesame shoestring fries. The burgers are paired with a flavorful mayo mixture and served with a side of crunchy fries.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line two oven trays with baking paper.
Cut potatoes into 0.5cm thick chips.
Toss chips on first prepared tray with a little oil.
Season with salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven, toss with sesame seeds and roast a further 10-15 minutes, until golden and tender.
Place fish on second prepared tray and lightly season.
Roast, on rack below chips for about 20 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Turn halfway through cooking.

instructions.heading: Too Easy
instructions.text: While fish is cooking, cut buns in half and set aside.
Roughly chop spinach; grate carrots; cut cucumber in half lengthways then thinly slice.
Add to a bowl with vinegar and oil.
Mix to combine and season to taste.
Mix mayo, sesame oil (if using) and soy sauce together in a small bowl.
When chips are cooked, move to one side of the tray and place buns next to them to toast for 3-5 minutes, until lightly toasted and warmed through.
To serve, spread a little butter (if using) on one side of bun, top with some salad and a piece of fish.
Spread the lid with a little mayo mixture and place on top.
Serve sesame shoestrings on the side.

recipes.name: Sesame Pork
recipes.description: A flavorful stir-fry featuring tender pork, crisp vegetables, and a savory sesame sauce, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Add A Crunch
instructions.text: If you have sesame seeds at home, add a sprinkling to the dish right before eating.

instructions.heading: Method
instructions.text: 1. COOK RICE.
Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
2. PREP VEGGIES & PORK.
Cut carrots in half lengthways and thinly slice, thinly slice onion, capsicum and bok choy and set all aside separately.
Pat pork dry and dice 2cm.
3. COOK PORK.
Toss pork and flour in a bowl.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook pork for about 3 minutes, turning regularly until golden on all sides.
Remove from pan and set aside.
4. COOK VEGGIES.
Return pan to heat, add first measure of water and cook about 1 minute, scraping pan until water has almost evaporated.
Reduce heat to medium and add a little more oil.
Add onion, carrots, chilli flakes and garlic and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
5. FINISH SESAME PORK.
Add second measure of water, sesame pork sauce, honey, pork and any resting juices and stir to combine.
Cook for about 2 minutes, until pork is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Stir through bok choy and season to taste.
6. TO SERVE.
Top rice with pork and veggies.
Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line a lipped oven tray with baking paper.
Dice kumara and onion 0.5cm; dice bacon 1cm; roughly chop both measures of spinach.
Toss kumara, onion, bacon and honey on prepared tray.
Season and roast for about 15 minutes, until kumara is tender and bacon is cooked.
Remove from tray and set aside.
Reduce oven temperature to 150°C (to keep fritters warm when cooked in step 4).
While kumara is cooking, add eggs, milk, flour and salt to a large bowl and whisk until smooth.
When kumara, bacon and onion are cooked, add to egg mix along with first measure of spinach and cheese.
Mix to combine and season with pepper.
Heat a little oil in a large (preferably non-stick) fry-pan on medium heat.
Use a ¼ cup measure to scoop mixture into pan and cook fritters, in batches, for about 2 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Transfer cooked fritters to oven tray and keep in the oven while the other batches cook.
While fritters cook, peel courgette and carrot into ribbons and thinly slice cucumber.
Add to a bowl with second measure of spinach, oil and vinegar.
Toss to combine and season to taste.
To serve, divide bacon 'n' kumara fritters between plates.
Top with salad, dollop with sour cream and drizzle over sweet chilli sauce (if using).

recipes.name: Singapore Laksa Paste with Malaysian Curry Powder (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a full kettle to the boil.
Add noodles to a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water.
Use a fork to separate strands, then cover.
Leave for 5 mins, then drain well and toss with oil to prevent sticking.
Cut in a few places with kitchen scissors to make them easier to eat.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan (or pot) on high.
Grate carrot.
Cook chicken and carrot for 5-6 mins, until chicken is sealed on the outside.
Add laksa paste and measure of spices and cook for 1 min, until fragrant.
Add coconut milk and water measure and bring to the boil.
Drop heat to low and simmer for 3-4 mins.
While cooking, slice bok choy 3cm.
Add bok choy and fish sauce and cook for 2-3 mins, until wilted.
Season to taste with fish sauce.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top bowls of noodles with chicken curry.
Don't forget mung bean sprouts and chilli flakes (if using) on top.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Spanish-Style Butterflied Lamb Leg with Oven Fries & Smoked Paprika Aioli
recipes.description: A flavorful dinner featuring tender butterflied lamb leg seasoned with Spanish spices, served with crispy oven fries and a zesty smoked paprika aioli. Perfect for a hearty and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Boil a pot of salted water.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Cut potatoes into chips.
Toss with oil on 1-2 lined oven trays and spread in a single layer.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for 25-30 mins, until tender and golden.
Turn once during cooking.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Chop broccoli.
Cook with peas in pot of boiling water for 5-6 mins, until tender.
Drain well and return to pot.
Smash using a potato masher.
Don't want to smash your greens?
Simply skip the mashing step.
Fold in baby spinach and butter.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Pat lamb dry, rub with measure of spices and season with salt.
Heat a frypan on medium-high.
Cook lamb fat side down for 3 mins.
Flip and cook a further 2 mins.
Transfer to a lined oven tray and bake for 10-14 mins for medium, or until cooked to your liking.
Rest, covered, before slicing.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate lamb with chips and broccoli smash on the side.
Top with smoked paprika aioli.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Spice-Rubbed Butterflied Lamb Leg with Feta Roast Veggies
recipes.description: A flavorful and tender butterflied lamb leg seasoned with a spice rub, served with a medley of roasted vegetables and feta cheese, creating a hearty and satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Dice carrot and potatoes 3cm.
Toss together on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil.
Season with salt and pepper and roast for 25 mins.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Mix mayo, mustard and honey together in a bowl.
Set aside for serving.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Pat lamb dry, coat with measure of spices and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook lamb fat side down for 3 mins.
Flip and cook a further 2 mins.
Remove one of the trays of vegetables from oven.
Place lamb on top of veggies, crumble over feta and return to oven to bake for 10-14 mins for medium, or until cooked to your liking.
Return vegetables for any remaining cook time.
Rest lamb, before slicing.
Toss spinach through veggies to wilt.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate feta roast veggies with lamb and mayo.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Spinach Crumbed Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring crispy chicken coated in a spinach, cheese, and breadcrumb mixture, served with roasted veggie chips. The meal combines savory and earthy flavors with a satisfying crunch.

instructions.text: PREP & COOK VEGGIE CHIPS.
Preheat oven to 220°C.
Cut kumara, potatoes and carrots into 1cm chips, toss on a lined oven tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for 20-25 minutes, until golden and tender.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat and cook chicken for 3-5 minutes each side, until golden.
Transfer to a second lined tray, with about a 2cm gap between pieces.
Roughly chop spinach and add to a bowl with cheese, breadcrumbs, butter and a pinch of salt.
Mix well to combine and scatter crumb evenly on tray with chicken (on top of and around chicken).
When chips have 10 minutes remaining, place chicken in oven (on rack above chips) to cook for about 8 minutes.
After 8 minutes, switch oven to high grill and grill for about 2 minutes, until crumb is golden, and chicken is cooked through.
Keep an eye on the crumb to ensure it doesn't burn.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Serve chips and chicken with a little tomato sauce or mayo for dipping.

recipes.name: Spring Onions with Chopped Roasted Peanuts (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Preheat oven to high grill.
Combine rice, water and salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 6 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
Fluff up cooked rice with a fork and allow to cool slightly.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and slice into 1cm strips.
Mix with garlic and first measure of soy sauce and place onto a lipped oven tray.
Cook under the grill for about 3 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Set aside.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Finely dice onion and broccoli florets and stalk; roughly chop spinach; grate courgette and carrot; thinly slice spring onions.
In a small bowl, whisk eggs and season.

instructions.heading: Cook Egg
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large (non-stick) fry- pan on medium-high heat.
Pour egg into pan and cook for about 2 minutes, until nearly set.
Flip and cook a further 30 seconds, remove from pan and set aside.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: When rice is steaming, return pan to high heat with a little more oil and cook onion for 2-3 minutes.
Add broccoli, courgette and carrot and cook a further 2-3 minutes, until veggies are tender.
Set aside.
Add a little more oil to pan and cook rice (in 2 batches) for 3-4 minutes stirring occasionally, until grains start to colour, scraping off the bottom of the pan if it sticks.
Thinly slice cooked egg and add with all fried rice ingredients to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until combined and hot.
Season to taste.
TO SERVE, spoon chicken fried rice into bowls and sprinkle with chopped, roasted peanuts and spring onions.

recipes.name: STUFFED BEEF SCHNITZEL
recipes.description: A hearty and flavorful dinner featuring crispy breaded beef schnitzel stuffed with a creamy spinach mixture, served alongside roasted root vegetables for a satisfying and comforting meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Line two oven trays with baking paper.
Dice carrots, parsnips, pumpkin and potatoes 3-4 cm and toss on first prepared tray with a little oil.
Season and roast for 30-35 minutes, until golden and tender.
Once cooked, toss through first measure of spinach.

instructions.heading: Yummy
instructions.text: While roasties are cooking, roughly chop second measure of spinach and mix in a small bowl with cream cheese.
Season and set aside.
Place flour and salt in a shallow bowl, whisk egg and milk together in another bowl and place breadcrumbs in a third bowl.
Pat beef dry, then lay out flat, Evenly divide cream cheese mix between pieces, placing on one half.
Fold over to close, Carefully coat each stuffed schnitzel first in flour, then egg mix, then breadcrumbs, shaking off excess as you go.
When roasties have about 15 minutes cook time remaining, heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook stuffed schnitzels, for about 2-3 minutes each side, until golden brown.
Transfer to second prepared tray, season and place on rack underneath roasties.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, until cooked through.
To serve, divide roasties and stuffed beef schnitzels between plates.
Dollop with your favourite tomato sauce or relish on the side (if using).

recipes.name: Sweet 'n' Sour Fish
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring tender fish fillets coated in a vibrant sweet and sour sauce, served with a medley of fresh vegetables and steamed rice. The dish combines tangy, sweet, and savory flavors for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Sauce & Veggies
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine pineapple pieces and juice, water, vinegar, tomato sauce, soy sauce, sugar, salt and first measure of cornflour.
Mix well until cornflour is dissolved.
Cut broccoli into small florets and thinly slice stalk, thinly slice onion and capsicum.

instructions.heading: Prep Fish
instructions.text: Place milk into a bowl.
In a seperate large bowl, place flour, second measure of cornflour and salt and mix to combine.
Pat fish dry, cut into 5cm pieces and place into the bowl of milk, then place all fish into flour and mix gently to coat.

instructions.heading: Cook Fish
instructions.text: Heat oil in a large fry-pan on medium- high heat.
Cook fish for 2-3 minutes each side, remove from pan and set aside.
Return pan to heat with a little more oil.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Add broccoli and onion to pan and cook for about 2 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add capsicum and cook a further 2 minutes.
Stir sauce ingredients, add to pan and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
Gently stir through fish and spinach and cook for a further 30 seconds, until warmed through.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon rice into bowls and top with sweet and sour fish.

recipes.name: Sweet Chilli Chicken
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring tender chicken in a sweet and spicy sauce, served over orzo pasta with vegetables, creating a satisfying and aromatic meal.

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks.
Place your hand flat on top of chicken and slice through horizontally.
Place chicken in a large bowl with all remaining chicken ingredients and mix to combine, season with pepper and set aside.
Cut broccoli into small florets and dice stalk 1cm.
Cook orzo in pot of boiling water for 7 minutes, until nearly tender.
Add broccoli and cook a further 3 minutes, until broccoli is bright green, and orzo is tender.
Drain well and return to pot with a drizzle of olive oil to prevent sticking.
Keep warm.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook chicken, in batches, for 2-4 minutes each side (depending on thickness), until golden and cooked through.
Rest, covered.
While chicken cooks, grate carrots and courgette.
Add all to pot with cooked broccoli and orzo, along with lime aioli, sweet chilli sauce, vinegar and salt.
Mix well and season to taste.
To serve, spoon orzo onto plates and top with sweet chilli chicken.

recipes.name: Takeaway Dupes! Crispy Chicken Nibbles, Mash & Gravy
recipes.description: A comforting and crispy homemade version of takeaway chicken nibbles served with creamy mashed potatoes and rich gravy, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan bake).
Pat chicken dry and season with salt.
Place chicken, measure of chilli powder and chicken flour in a bag or container with a tight-fitting lid.
Shake around, until chicken is coated.
Place chicken on a lined oven tray and drizzle with oil.
Roast for about 35 mins, until golden and cooked through.
Turn chicken halfway through cook time to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 3cm.
Add potatoes to a pot.
Cover with hot tap water and a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil with the lid on, then remove lid and drop heat to medium.
Cook for about 20 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with milk and first measure of butter.
Mash until smooth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Mix It
instructions.text: Peel and grate beetroot.
Add to a bowl with slaw, vinegar and mayo.
Mix to combine and season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Melt second measure butter in a second pot on medium heat.
Add gravy mix and cook for about 30 secs, until fragrant.
Slowly add water measure while whisking.
Simmer for about 1 min, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt pepper and transfer to a serving jug.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up chicken and mash with gravy.
Serve slaw on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Talofa Lava
recipes.description: A creamy and comforting Samoan banana sago pudding (Suafa'i) made with coconut milk, tapioca pearls, and ripe bananas, offering a sweet and satisfying dessert experience.

instructions.text: TOP TIP Don't leave the tapioca to simmer unchecked or the suafa'i might burn onto the bottom of your saucepan.
1. Add water and coconut milk to a large pot and bring to the boil then reduce heat to low.
2. While coconut milk heats, peel bananas, roughly chop and add to pot, along with tapioca.
3. Cook for 20-25 minutes, until tapioca turns completely clear, stirring often to separate the pearls and to keep them from sticking to the bottom of the pot.
4. Carefully taste the suafa'i and add sugar to taste.
Remove from heat and leave for about 30 minutes to cool.
5. To serve, divide between bowls or cups and top with a little toasted coconut and brown sugar (if desired).

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken Pizzas
recipes.description: A fusion of Indian and Italian flavors, these pizzas feature a spicy tandoori chicken topping paired with fresh vegetables and a creamy yogurt drizzle, perfect for a bold and satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Preheat Trays
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat two oven trays.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken
instructions.text: Mix chicken in a bowl with tandoori spices, salt, first measure of yoghurt and chilli flakes and set aside.
Roughly chop tomato.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken & Vege
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook pumpkin with a pinch of salt for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Increase heat to high, add chicken and cook a further 3 minutes, until seared.
Add tomato and cook 1-2 minutes further, until softened.

instructions.heading: Assemble Pizzas
instructions.text: Mix together tomato paste, sweet chilli sauce and garlic and spread evenly over naan breads.
Roughly chop spinach and sprinkle over top.
Use a spoon or tongs to evenly dollop chicken, pumpkin and tomato mix over each pizza and season.

instructions.heading: Cook Pizzas
instructions.text: Transfer pizzas to preheated trays and bake for 12-14 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and naans are crispy.
Switch trays halfway to ensure even cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Courgette
instructions.text: Peel courgettes into ribbons.
Just before serving, toss with a drizzle of vinegar and season with salt.

instructions.heading: Prep Drizzle
instructions.text: Mix second measure of yoghurt and honey together in a small bowl.
TO SERVE, top pizzas with courgette and drizzle with yoghurt.
Cut into 4-6 pieces and divide between plates.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Beef Bowls
recipes.description: A flavorful and satisfying meal featuring tender beef coated in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, served over fluffy rice and accompanied by a medley of stir-fried vegetables. Perfect for a quick and healthy dinner.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a good pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies & Beef
instructions.text: Thinly slice onion, cut carrots in half lengthways and thinly slice, thinly slice mushrooms and cut broccoli into small florets.
Pat beef dry and cut any larger pieces in half.

instructions.heading: Cook Beef
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Cook beef, in batches for about 1 minute each side, until browned.
Rest, covered.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Wipe pan clean and return to high heat with a little more oil, Cook onion and carrots for about 4 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add mushrooms, broccoli, ginger, water and soy sauce and cook a further 4 minutes, until tender.
While broccoli is cooking, thinly slice beef.

instructions.heading: Add Sauce
instructions.text: When veggies are cooked, return beef and any resting juices to pan, along with teriyaki sauce.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, tossing until beef is warmed through and coated.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon rice into bowls, top with teriyaki beef and sprinkle with sesame seeds and peanuts.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.description: A flavorful stir-fry featuring tender chicken, noodles, and fresh vegetables like bok choy and broccoli, all coated in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Separate bok choy leaves and cut any larger leaves in half lengthways.
Cut carrot in half and thinly slice.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Set aside separately.

instructions.heading: Flavour It
instructions.text: Mince ginger.
Pat chicken dry and slice 1cm.
Place chicken in a bowl with ginger.
Toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook chicken for 3-4 mins, tossing occasionally, until golden and just cooked through.
Transfer to a heatproof bowl and cover to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Finish It
instructions.text: Return pan to high heat with oil.
Cook carrot and broccoli for about 5 mins, until starting to soften.
Reduce heat to medium-high.
Add noodles, cooked chicken and bok choy and toss to combine.
Add teriyaki sauce and water measure and cook for about 2 mins, until sauce has thickened slightly and noodles are hot through.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Portion stir-fry into bowls.
Enjoy!
Tip The best stir-fries are ones you cook quickly over a high heat.
So make sure you do all you prep first to speed up the cooking!

recipes.name: Teriyaki Pork Pizzas
recipes.description: A savory pizza topped with a sweet and tangy teriyaki sauce, pork mince, and fresh vegetables, paired with a refreshing salad for a balanced meal.

instructions.heading: Prep Pizza
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Preheat two oven trays.
Thinly slice capsicum and onion.
Mix pork together with soy sauce and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Mix sweet chilli sauce and tomato paste together in a small bowl.
Spread sweet chilli mixture evenly over pizza bases and sprinkle with cheese.
Scatter over capsicum and onion and dot with small amounts of pork.
Drizzle with teriyaki sauce and season.

instructions.heading: Cook Pizza
instructions.text: Cut one pizza in half.
Place one and a half pizzas on each tray and cook for about 15 minutes, until bases are crispy and golden, and the pork is cooked through.
Swap position of trays halfway through cooking so they cook evenly.

instructions.heading: Prep Salad
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy and apple.
Grate carrots and add all veggies to a large bowl with mayo, sesame oil and vinegar.
Mix to combine and season to taste.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Cut pizza into 6-8 slices and divide between plates.
Serve salad on the side.

recipes.name: Thai Green Chicken Curry with Green Beans
recipes.description: A flavorful Thai-inspired curry featuring tender chicken, vibrant vegetables, and a rich green curry paste, served with fluffy white rice.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.prep: cut in half & thinly sliced on an angle

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Finely grate ginger.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Set aside separately.

instructions.heading: Cook It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a pot on medium-high.
Cook ginger, measure of spices and green curry paste (use 1/2 the amount for mild or an extra tsp for a spicier curry) for 2-3 mins, until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, stock, soy sauce and fish sauce (if using) and bring to a simmer.
Add chicken and simmer for about 6 mins, until chicken is almost cooked through.

instructions.heading: Simmer It
instructions.text: Meanwhile, trim ends from green beans and cut in half.
Cut carrot in half and thinly slice on an angle.
Separate bok choy leaves.
Add green beans, carrot, bok choy and peas to pot and cook for about 3 mins, until tender.
Season to taste with salt.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Spoon rice into bowls and top with chicken curry.
Feed the team!

recipes.name: THAI GREEN FISH CURRY
recipes.description: A flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring tender fish fillets, vibrant vegetables, and a rich green curry sauce, served over steamed jasmine rice.

instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: No Peeking
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy; thinly slice onion; cut broccoli into small florets; cut carrots in half lengthways then thinly slice; pat fish dry and cut into 3-4cm pieces.
Heat a little oil in a large, deep fry-pan or pot (with a lid) on medium heat and cook onion and carrots for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add curry paste and chilli flakes (if using) and cook, stirring for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add stock, coconut milk, soy sauce and fish sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer then add broccoli and fish.
Cover with a lid and cook for about 4 minutes, until broccoli is tender and fish is cooked through.
Season to taste with soy sauce or fish sauce.
Fluff up cooked rice with a fork, stir through bok choy and season to taste.
To serve, divide rice between bowls and top with Thai green fish curry.

recipes.name: THAI PORK PATTIES
recipes.description: A flavorful dish featuring crispy pork patties seasoned with Thai spices, served with a vibrant vegetable salad and coconut rice. The dish is infused with aromatic herbs and a hint of sweetness from the chili sauce.

instructions.text: PREHEAT BBQ hot plate to high (if using).
Bring a full kettle to the boil.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, coconut milk, water and salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, stir, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 10 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: No Peeking
instructions.text: PREP PATTIES (or see step 6).
Mix all patty ingredients in a large bowl until combined.
Use a 1/4 cup measure to scoop out mixture and then roll into balls.
Flatten to about 1.5cm thick.

instructions.heading: Cook Patties
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-highheat.
Cook patties, in batches, for 2-3 minutes each side, until browned and cooked through.
Alternatively, do this on BBQ hot plate.
Set aside, covered to keep warm between batches.

instructions.heading: Prep Veggies
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets and place in a heat-proof bowl.
Cover with boiling water and leave for 5 minutes, until tender.
Drain and return to bowl.
Thinly slice capsicum and peel carrot into ribbons.
Add all to bowl with broccoli along with spinach and Thai dressing.
Mix to combine and season to taste.
Cut lemon into wedges.

instructions.heading: Alternatively
instructions.text: Stir-fry pork, garlic, ginger and Thai spice mix on high heat for about 4 minutes, until browned.
Set aside and return pan to heat.
Stir-fry broccoli and capsicum for about 3 minutes before adding carrot, spinach, cooked pork, soy sauce, lemon zest, sweet chilli sauce and Thai dressing to cook for a further 1 minute.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon cooked coconut rice onto plates.
Divide Thai pork patties and veggies between plates.
Drizzle sweet chilli sauce over patties and serve with a lemon wedge on the side.

recipes.name: Thai Yellow Chicken Curry with Bok Choy Rice
recipes.description: A flavorful Thai-inspired curry featuring tender chicken, vibrant vegetables, and a rich yellow curry sauce, served over aromatic bok choy rice.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 mins.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 5 more mins.
Don't lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Thinly slice bok choy.
Cut broccoli into florets.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken for about 5 mins, until browned.
Add curry paste and soy sauce, then cook for 30 secs, until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, broccoli and stock to pan and bring to a boil.
Drop heat to low-medium and simmer for about 5 mins, until the sauce is thickened and creamy.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Wilt It
instructions.text: Add bok choy to pot with rice and stir through, until wilted.
Cut lemon into wedges.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Top rice with chicken curry.
Serve lemon wedges on the side for squeezing.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Ultimate Butter Chicken
recipes.description: A rich and creamy butter chicken curry with tender chicken, aromatic spices, and a smooth sauce, served with steamed rice and a side of vibrant vegetables.

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, still covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Curry
instructions.text: Bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil.
Thinly slice onion.
Pat chicken dry, dice 2cm and place in a bowl with butter chicken spices, chilli flakes, ginger and salt.
Mix to combine and season with pepper.

instructions.heading: Cook Curry
instructions.text: Heat butter in a large fry-pan on medium heat.
Cook onion for 4-5 minutes, or until soft but not coloured.
Add garlic and cook for a further 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook for 3-5 minutes, until golden brown and nearly cooked through.
Add cream, milk, tomato paste, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low-medium and simmer for about 5 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and the sauce is slightly thickened.

instructions.heading: Prep & Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into small florets, cut carrot in half and thinly slice.
Cook broccoli, carrot and peas in pot of boiling water for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Drain well, toss with a little olive oil and season.

instructions.heading: To Serve
instructions.text: Spoon ¾ cup cooked rice per person onto plates and top with butter chicken.
Serve veggies on the side.

recipes.name: Ultimate Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice & Veggies
recipes.description: A rich and creamy butter chicken dish served with fluffy basmati rice and a side of colorful vegetables, perfect for a comforting and flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.prep: cut in half lengthways & thinly sliced

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in another pot and bring to the boil with the lid on.
Once boiling, reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 mins.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 5 more mins.
Don't lift the lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Finely dice onion.
Mince garlic.
Place chicken in a bowl with measure of spices and salt measure.
Mix to combine and season with pepper.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat butter in a frypan on medium heat.
Cook onion for 4-5 mins, until soft.
Add garlic and cook for a further 1 min.
Add chicken and cook for 3-5 mins, turning occasionally, until golden brown and nearly cooked through.
Add cream, milk, tomato paste, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce to pan.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low-medium and simmer for about 5 mins, until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Cut broccoli into florets.
Cut carrot in half lengthways and thinly slice.
Cook broccoli, carrot and peas in pot of boiling water for 4-5 mins, until tender.
Drain well and season with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate up rice with butter chicken.
Serve veggies on the side.
Enjoy!

recipes.name: ULTIMATE FISH PIE
recipes.description: A comforting and hearty fish pie made with flaky fish, creamy sauce, tender spinach, and golden-baked potato chips, perfect for a cozy dinner.

instructions.text: PREHEAT oven to 220°C.
Line an oven tray with baking paper.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Set aside a large casserole dish (about 20 x 25cm).

instructions.heading: Cook Potatoes
instructions.text: Cut potatoes into 1.5cm thick chips and cook in pot of boiling water for 10 minutes, until tender.
Drain and return to pot.

instructions.heading: Cook Leek
instructions.text: Cut leek in half lengthways then thinly slice (discard tough green part).
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium heat and cook leek and salt for about 5 minutes, until softened.

instructions.heading: Prep Fish
instructions.text: Pat fish dry and cut into 5cm pieces.

instructions.heading: Make Sauce
instructions.text: Add butter to leek and cook for 1 minute, until melted.
Add flour and pie herbs and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add milk, stirring, ½ cup at a time until sauce is smooth.
Season.

instructions.heading: Bake Pie
instructions.text: Stir in fish and spinach then pour mix into casserole dish.
Top with drained potatoes, season with pepper and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake in oven for about 14 minutes, until cheese is melted and fish is cooked through.
Switch oven to high grill to cook for 1-2 minutes, if your cheese needs more browning.

instructions.heading: Cook Peas
instructions.text: While pie is cooking, bring a medium pot of salted water to the boil.
When pie has 5 minutes remaining, cook peas for about 3 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain and season.
TO SERVE divide pie between plates and serve peas on the side.
Preheat oven to 200°C (or 180°C fan bake).
Dice onion.
Grate carrot.
Heat oil in a frypan on high.
Cook onion, carrot and salt measure for about 5 mins, until soft.
Add measure of spices, beef and tomato paste and cook a further 5 mins, until browned.
Add canned tomatoes and stock to pan, bring to a simmer and cook for 4-5 mins, until thickened.
Stir through sugar.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cut pita bread into wedges (6-8 pieces per bread) and toss on a lined oven tray with oil.
Bake for 8-10 mins, until golden.
Grate first measure of cucumber Mix in a bowl with yoghurt and olive oil.
Season with salt.
Set aside to serve.
Dice tomato and second measure of cucumber.
Chop spinach.
Toss in a bowl with vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cover pitas with beef and top with salsa and tzatziki.
Serve in the middle of the table and let everyone help themselves.
Yum!

ingredients.name: vanilla OR lemon juice OR espresso

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Grease or line a muffin tray with 6 muffin cases.
2. Using electric beaters, cream first measure of butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
3. Add egg and vanilla and beat until combined.
4. Add cupcake mix and milk and use a spatula to very gently combine.
5. Transfer to prepared tray and bake for 16-18 minutes until a skewer inserted comes out clean.
6. To make icing, use electric beaters to beat butter until very pale and fluffy, add icing sugar 1/3 at a time and beat to combine.
Continue to beat until pale and fluffy.
Add milk and flavour option.
If mixture becomes too thick, add 1 teaspoon of milk at a time to loosen.
7. Allow cupcakes to cool completely before icing.
Top with decorations of your choice.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-Style Beef & Rice Bowl
recipes.description: A flavorful bowl featuring tender beef stir-fried with aromatic spices, served over steamed rice and topped with fresh vegetables, sweet chili mayo, and crunchy peanuts. This dish offers a delightful blend of savory, spicy, and sweet flavors.

instructions.text: Boil a kettle.
Thinly slice onion.
Peel carrot into ribbons.
Thinly slice bok choy.
Set veggies aside.
Combine rice, boiling water measure and a pinch of salt in a pot.
Cover with lid and bring to the boil.
Drop to lowest heat and cook for 12 mins.
Turn heat off, leave lid on and steam for 5 mins.
Whisk together second measure of sweet chilli soy dressing and mayonnaise in a bowl.
Set aside.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion for 2-3 mins, until starting to soften.
Add beef and cook for about 7 mins, breaking up beef as it cooks, until just cooked through.
Stir through first measure of sweet chilli soy dressing, peanuts and fish sauce.
Remove from heat, season to taste with fish sauce and pepper and keep warm.
Toss veggies in a bowl with vinegar and chilli flakes, if using.
Spoon rice into bowls.
Top with beef, veggies and sweet chilli mayo.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Whole Peanuts with Chicken Thighs (untitled scan)

instructions.heading: Cook Rice
instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a pot and bring to the boil.
Once boiling, cover with a lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat and steam, covered, for 8 more minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.

instructions.heading: Prep Chicken & Veggies
instructions.text: Thinly slice onion, capsicum and bok choy.
Cut carrots in half and thinly slice.
Pat chicken dry and slice into 1cm strips.
Set aside separately.
In a small bowl or jug, whisk all sauce ingredients together.

instructions.heading: Cook Chicken
instructions.text: Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on high heat.
Toss chicken with cornflour in a bowl and season.
Shake off excess cornflour, add chicken to pan and cook for 6-8 minutes, turning to cook on all sides, until browned and cooked through.
Set chicken aside and season.
Reserve pan.

instructions.heading: Cook Veggies
instructions.text: Return pan to heat with a little more oil.
Stir-fry onion, capsicum and carrots for 5-6 minutes, until starting to soften.
Stir sauce again, then add to pan along with bok choy and peanuts.
Reduce heat to low, allow to bubble and reduce for about 1 minute, until slightly thickened and veggies are tender.
Season to taste.
SERVE rice topped with chicken and peanut veggies.

recipes.name: Winning Fried Chicken & Chips with Crunchy Slaw
recipes.description: A classic comfort food pairing of crispy fried chicken tenders served with golden chips and a refreshing crunchy slaw, perfect for a satisfying meal.

instructions.heading: Roast It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (210°C fan bake).
Cut potatoes and carrot into chips.
Toss on 1-2 lined oven trays with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 25-30 mins, until golden.
Swap trays halfway through cooking, if needed, so chips cook evenly.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Pat chicken dry, slice into 1cm strips and season with salt and pepper.
Add chicken to a bowl.
Add egg to same bowl, crack yolk with a fork and toss to coat.
Add chicken flour to a second bowl.
Place marinated chicken into flour mixture, turn to coat each piece well and place on a plate/tray.

instructions.heading: Toss It
instructions.text: Toss slaw with vinegar in a bowl.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Fry It
instructions.text: Heat a generous drizzle of oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Add chicken to pan in batches, shaking off any excess flour.
Cook for about 4 mins each side, until golden and cooked through.
Add more oil between batches if needed.
Rest on a paper towel.
For extra crispy chicken, set it on a wire rack for a few minutes.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Serve up fried chicken and chips.
Dollop over garlic aioli.
Serve slaw on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Winter Nostalgia Buttery Stuffed Chicken Kyiv with Mash & Garlicky Cream
recipes.description: A comforting and classic dish featuring tender chicken rolls stuffed with a creamy filling, served with mashed potatoes and garlicky cream sauce, perfect for a cozy winter meal.

instructions.heading: Mash It
instructions.text: Dice potatoes 2cm.
Add to a pot with a pinch of salt.
Cover with hot tap water and cook, covered, on high heat for about 20 mins.
Drain and return to pot with milk and butter.
Mash until smooth and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Set aside covered to keep warm.

instructions.heading: Prep It
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 230°C (or 210°C fan bake).
Finely chop first measure of spinach.
Add softened butter, spinach and salt measure to a bowl.
Mix well.
Pat chicken dry and cut into steaks by placing your hand flat on top of chicken and slicing through horizontally.
To make a pocket for the filling, make a horizontal slice into each piece of chicken, about 3/4 of the way through.
Be careful not to cut all the way through.
Fill chicken breast pocket with butter filling.
Press down lightly to seal.

instructions.heading: Crumb It
instructions.text: Add chicken to a bowl, along with flour and toss to coat.
Crack egg into same bowl and use a fork to toss until well coated.
Place breadcrumbs in another bowl.
Place chicken into the crumbs, roll to coat well and place on a lined oven tray.

instructions.heading: Bake It
instructions.text: Bake chicken for 20-25 mins on middle oven rack, until cooked through (juices will run clear when thickest part is cut into).
Rest before thickly slicing chicken.

instructions.heading: Sauce It
instructions.text: Thinly slice garlic.
Heat oil in a small pot on low- medium heat.
Add garlic and measure of spices and cook for 30 secs.
Add remaining sauce ingredients to pot Simmer for 5 mins until slightly thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

instructions.heading: Boil It
instructions.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil.
Cook peas in pot of boiling water for 3 mins.
Drain and toss second measure of spinach until wilted.

instructions.heading: Eat It
instructions.text: Plate mash topped with sliced chicken Kyiv and greens and creamy sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Winter Nostalgia Cheesy Beef Mince On Toast
recipes.description: A comforting dish featuring beef mince topped with melted cheese, served on toast and accompanied by greens, perfect for a cozy winter meal.

instructions.text: 1. PREP IT Preheat oven to high grill.
Boil a pot of salted water.
Finely chop onion.
Grate cheese if needed.
2. COOK IT Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook onion for about 3 mins, until soft.
Add measure of gravy mix and beef to pan.
Cook for a further 5-6 mins, until cooked through.
Add stock and simmer for 2-3 mins, until thickened.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Sprinkle over cheese and cook with a lid on for 1-2 mins, until cheese is melted.
3. BOIL IT Meanwhile, cut broccoli into florets.
Cook in pot of boiling water along with peas for 3-4 mins, until tender.
Drain and return to pot with butter.
Toss to combine and season to taste with salt and pepper.
4. GRILL IT Thickly slice bread on an angle (2 slices per person).
Place on a foiled lined oven tray.
Grill for 1 min each side until toasted.
5. EAT IT Serve up beef on toast with tomato sauce.
Don't forget greens on the side!
Enjoy!

recipes.name: Winter Nostalgia Creamy Chicken Alfredo with Greens
recipes.description: A comforting and creamy chicken Alfredo dish, enhanced with fresh greens, perfect for a cozy winter meal.

instructions.text: Boil two pots of salted water.
Cook pasta in first pot of boiling water for about 10 mins, until just tender.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water.
Drain, return to pot and toss with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Thinly slice garlic (if using).
Add to second pot of boiling water along with peas.
Cook for 3-5 mins, until bright green and tender.
Drain and return to pot with garlic (if using) and olive oil.
Set aside, covered to keep warm.
Pat chicken dry and dice 2cm.
Heat oil in a frypan on medium-high.
Cook chicken, with a pinch of salt for about 5 mins, tossing occasionally, until browned.
Add butter and measure of spices and cook for another 1-2 mins, until fragrant.
Add stock and cream to pan.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 3-4 mins, until cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Add cooked pasta and Parmesan to pan with chicken.
Add measure of reserved pasta water and stir to combine.
If alfredo is looking too thick, add another splash of pasta water.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Plate up chicken alfredo.
Don't forget the greens on the side.
Dig in!

recipes.name: Zingy Crumbed Fish
recipes.description: A crispy and flavorful fish dish coated in a zesty breadcrumb mixture, served with a refreshing cucumber and spinach salad and a creamy coconut sauce.

instructions.text: Combine rice, water and a pinch of salt in a medium pot and bring to the boil.
As soon as it boils, cover with a tight-fitting lid and reduce to lowest heat to cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off heat and leave to steam, still covered, for a further 8 minutes.
Do not lift lid during cooking.
While rice is cooking, whisk first measure of crumbed fish spices, coconut cream, lemon zest (if using) and a pinch of salt in a small pot.
Bring to a gentle simmer on medium heat, then remove from heat and set aside.
Whisk egg and milk together in a small bowl, add flour and salt to another bowl and mix breadcrumbs, almonds and second measure of crumbed fish spices in a third bowl.
Pat fish dry and cut any larger pieces in half.
Place fish first in flour, then egg mix, then breadcrumbs, shaking off excess as you go.
Set aside.
Heat a little oil in a large fry-pan on medium-high heat and cook fish, in batches, for about 3 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through.
Wipe pan out between batches and add more oil as needed.
While fish cooks, thinly slice bok choy and dice cucumber 1-2cm.
Toss in a bowl with spinach and vinegar.
Season to taste.
Cut remaining lemon into wedges.
To serve, spoon rice onto plates, top with veggies, a drizzle of coconut sauce and zingy crumbed fish.
Squeeze over a lemon wedge, ZINGY!
